title: SEO Specialist – Local/Technical SEO & Client Strategy
description:
**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST**



## About the Role



HeyPearl is looking for an experienced **SEO Specialist / Customer Success Manager (SEO/CSM)** to manage and improve the organic and local search performance of our clients, primarily real estate professionals in the United States.



This is **not a purely back-end SEO role**.



You will be responsible for executing SEO strategies, monitoring performance, working inside **GoHighLevel (GHL)**, managing client communication, and helping clients understand their SEO performance, recommendations, and next steps.



We're looking for someone who is **technically strong, organized, proactive, client-focused, and confident communicating with U.S.-based clients.**



You should be able to independently manage SEO tasks, work inside GHL client accounts, identify problems and opportunities, prioritize recommendations, and clearly communicate results to clients.



---



# NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



**Please do not apply if you cannot meet these requirements.**



### Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST



You must be available to work **Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Central Standard Time (CST)**.



This is a full-time position with a consistent U.S. business-hours schedule.



### Daily 8:00 AM CST Huddle



You must be available to attend our **daily team huddle at 8:00 AM CST, Monday through Friday.**



### GoHighLevel Experience



You must have **intermediate to advanced, hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).**



**Beginner-level GHL experience is not sufficient for this role.**



You must be comfortable navigating and working independently inside GHL client accounts, including websites, funnels, CRM, pipelines, forms, workflows, automations, and tracking.



---



# What You'll Be Responsible For



## SEO & Technical Optimization



* Conduct technical SEO audits and implement or coordinate fixes

* Monitor Google Search Console for indexing, crawling, and performance issues

* Perform keyword research and competitor analysis

* Optimize titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, and internal linking

* Identify and resolve duplicate content, canonical, redirect, sitemap, and robots.txt issues

* Implement and validate schema markup

* Improve Core Web Vitals and website performance

* Develop local SEO and location-page strategies

* Optimize Google Business Profiles

* Monitor rankings, organic traffic, local visibility, and conversions

* Analyze SEO performance and identify opportunities

* Develop SEO recommendations based on actual performance data

* Prioritize SEO tasks based on potential impact and business value

* Track the results of implemented SEO strategies and adjustments



## GoHighLevel (GHL)



You will work directly inside client GHL accounts.



You should be comfortable independently working with:



* GHL websites and funnels

* Forms and lead capture

* CRM/contact records

* Pipelines

* Automations and workflows

* Triggers and actions

* Tracking and attribution

* Basic troubleshooting

* Basic integrations

* Website and funnel settings

* Managing and troubleshooting common GHL issues



You do **not** need to be a GHL developer, but you must be able to confidently navigate the platform and complete tasks without requiring basic GHL training.



---



# Client Success & Communication



This is a **client-facing position**, so strong Customer Success experience is highly valuable.



You will:



* Join client meetings and strategy calls

* Present SEO performance and monthly results

* Explain rankings, traffic, leads, and SEO opportunities in plain English

* Recommend next steps based on data

* Answer client SEO questions confidently

* Set realistic expectations around SEO timelines and results

* Proactively identify client needs and opportunities

* Follow up on SEO-related client requests

* Help clients understand the value and impact of SEO

* Coordinate with our internal content, development, and client-success teams

* Maintain clear and professional communication with clients

* Help ensure client issues and requests are properly tracked through completion



You should be comfortable speaking with **U.S.-based clients on Zoom** and communicating professionally through
 and messaging platforms.



---



# Must-Have Qualifications



* **3+ years of hands-on SEO experience**

* Strong Local SEO experience

* Strong technical SEO knowledge

* **Intermediate to advanced GoHighLevel (GHL) experience**

* Experience working directly with clients

* Strong Customer Success, account management, or client-facing experience

* Google Business Profile optimization experience

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

* WordPress

* Keyword research

* On-page SEO

* Schema markup

* Internal linking and site architecture

* Indexing and crawl troubleshooting

* Strong spoken and written English

* Comfortable presenting reports and recommendations on Zoom

* Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously

* Strong organization and follow-through

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of results

* Ability to prioritize tasks based on urgency and business impact

* **Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST**

* **Ability to attend the daily 8:00 AM CST team huddle**



---



# Preferred / Bonus Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



* Search Atlas

* Screaming Frog

* Ahrefs

* Semrush

* BrightLocal

* Local Falcon

* Looker Studio

* Basic HTML/CSS

* Real estate SEO

* SEO agency experience

* Customer Success Management

* Account Management

* AEO / GEO / AI Search Optimization

* ChatGPT

* Claude

* Gemini

* Perplexity



Experience working with **real estate agents, local businesses, agencies, or U.S.-based clients** is highly preferred.



---



# What We're Looking For



We're not looking for someone who simply runs SEO reports and sends them to the team.



We want someone who can:



**Find the problem → determine the priority → implement or coordinate the solution → measure the result → explain it clearly to the client → follow through until the issue is resolved.**



You should be able to look at an SEO account and tell us:



* What's working?

* What's not working?

* Why?

* What should we do next?

* What's the priority?

* What impact should we expect?

* How should we explain this to the client?



You should also be comfortable taking ownership instead of waiting to be told exactly what to do.



---



# Schedule



* **Full-time, 40 hours per week**

* **Monday–Friday**

* **8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST**

* Remote — Philippines

* **Daily team huddle at 8:00 AM CST**

* Client meetings will take place during U.S. business hours

* Consistent availability during the required shift is **non-negotiable**



---



# How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your updated resume

2. Your SEO portfolio or examples of websites you've worked on

3. **2–3 examples of measurable SEO results you've personally helped achieve**

4. Your level of experience with **GoHighLevel (GHL)** and the specific GHL features you have worked with

5. Your experience working directly with clients

6. Your Customer Success / Account Management experience, if applicable

7. Your favorite SEO tool and why

8. Your confirmation that you can work **Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST**

9. Your confirmation that you can attend the **daily 8:00 AM CST team huddle**



### Application Code Word



Please start your application with the word:



**PEARLSEO**



This confirms that you've read the entire job post.



Applications without the code word and requested information may not be considered.

title: Wedding Sales Support & Client Care Coordinator
description:
Wedding Sales Support & Client Care Coordinator



WORK HOURS: Monday–Friday, 12:00 PM–8:00 PM Toronto Time (NON-NEGOTIABLE)

PAY: Php 25,000/month + performance bonuses

JOB TYPE: Full-time, long-term

LOCATION: Remote (Philippines only)



ABOUT US



Snaptique is one of Canada’s leading photo booth and experiential event companies. We provide unique photo booth experiences for weddings, private parties, corporate events and brand activations across Canada.



This role focuses primarily on weddings and private events.



Couples often need time, reassurance and thoughtful follow-up before selecting their wedding vendors. Strong communication, warmth, organization and follow-through are extremely important in this role.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is not a task-only Virtual Assistant position.



We are hiring a Wedding Sales Support & Client Care Coordinator to support our Wedding Sales Coordinator by keeping conversations active and ensuring interested couples receive consistent follow-up.



You will communicate with warm leads who have already contacted Snaptique or received information from us. This is not a cold-calling role.



Your job is to make sure promising opportunities are not forgotten simply because a couple needs another reminder, conversation or helpful nudge before making a decision.



You must be comfortable communicating through
, text messaging and phone calls. Excellent spoken and written English is required.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Follow up with couples who have requested information or received a quote

- Communicate through
, text messaging and phone calls

- Re-engage couples who stopped responding

- Answer routine questions about our services and booking process

- Help keep couples engaged while they consider their options

- Schedule follow-ups based on each couple’s wedding date and decision timeline

- Identify couples who are ready to continue with the Wedding Sales Coordinator

- Provide complete notes when returning a sales-ready opportunity

- Keep lead statuses, notes and follow-up dates accurate

- Ensure every assigned lead has a clear next action

- Help organize and qualify older wedding inquiries

- Identify duplicate, expired, unqualified or lost opportunities

- Keep the Wedding Sales Coordinator informed about warm and urgent leads

- Maintain a friendly, patient and professional client experience



The Wedding Sales Coordinator remains responsible for detailed recommendations, pricing, quote revisions, negotiation and closing the booking.



REQUIREMENTS (NON-NEGOTIABLE)



- 2+ years of client-facing sales, sales support or customer service experience

- Previous experience working with Canada- or US-based companies

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Confident and natural when speaking with clients by phone

- Comfortable communicating through
 and text messaging

- Comfortable following up consistently

- Warm, patient and reassuring communication style

- Organized, proactive and detail-oriented

- Able to manage many client conversations at once

- Comfortable using a CRM and updating detailed notes

- Able to recognize when a client is ready to speak with the Sales Coordinator

- Reliable internet and a quiet home workspace

- Available Monday–Friday, 12:00 PM–8:00 PM Toronto time



THIS ROLE IS NOT



- Not a cold-calling position

- Not a task-only VA role

- Not the primary role responsible for creating complex quotes or negotiating

- Not a “wait for instructions” position

- Not suitable for someone uncomfortable with follow-ups

- Not suitable for someone who avoids phone conversations

- Not suitable for someone who regularly leaves CRM records incomplete



PAY & PERKS



- Php 25,000/month + performance bonuses

- Paid via Wise twice monthly

- 100% remote

- Stable, long-term position

- Opportunity to grow with the company

- Work with warm leads who have already shown interest



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. Your resume/CV

2. Written answers to ALL questions below



Applications without thoughtful answers will not be considered.



QUESTIONS



1. Tell us about a time you followed up multiple times before receiving a response or achieving a positive outcome.

2. How would you follow up with a couple who received a wedding quote but stopped responding for seven days?

3. How would you remain persistent without making a client feel pressured?

4. Are you comfortable communicating through
, text messaging and phone calls? Please explain your experience.

5. Have you worked with Canada- or US-based clients? If yes, describe your role.

6. What information should always be recorded in a CRM after speaking with a prospective client?

7. Why are you interested in working with wedding clients?

8. Confirm that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 12:00 PM–8:00 PM Toronto time.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT



We are not looking for someone to simply send repetitive messages.



We are looking for someone who can build trust, keep conversations moving, maintain organized records and help couples feel confident taking the next step with Snaptique.

title: Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)
description:
Full-Time Dispatcher (Remote)



Company: Eveready Express

Engagement Type: Independent Contractor (Full-Time)

Location: Remote



About the Role



Eveready Express is seeking a highly motivated, detail-oriented, and experienced Dispatcher to join our growing logistics team.



The ideal candidate must have at least two (2) years of experience working in the U.S. logistics or transportation industry and possess strong dispatching, route planning, and load coordination skills. You should thrive in a fast-paced environment, be able to effectively multitask, possess intermediate English communication skills, demonstrate expert computer skills, and have a growth mindset with a willingness to continuously learn and improve.



As a Dispatcher, you will be responsible for coordinating daily transportation operations, negotiating rates, assigning drivers, monitoring shipments, communicating with customers, and ensuring deliveries are completed safely, efficiently, and on time while maintaining compliance with DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched

26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb. weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans

Cargo Vans

Ram ProMaster (High Roof)

About Eveready Express



Founded in 1984, Eveready Express is a trusted leader in trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution services. We proudly serve businesses throughout the Northeast by providing dependable transportation solutions backed by honesty, integrity, urgency, teamwork, and exceptional customer service.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatch Operations

Dispatch vehicles based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.

Negotiate rates with drivers while maintaining a target minimum 40% gross margin.

Assign loads efficiently to maximize profitability and operational performance.

Coordinate pickups and deliveries to ensure customer service expectations are met.

Driver Communication

Maintain continuous communication with drivers throughout their routes.

Provide dispatch instructions, updates, route changes, and operational support.

Ensure drivers follow company procedures and customer requirements.

Routing & Scheduling

Plan efficient delivery routes to minimize transit time, fuel consumption, and operating costs.

Adjust schedules quickly as operational needs or unforeseen circumstances arise.

Balance driver availability with customer delivery requirements.

Shipment Tracking

Monitor shipments in real time using GPS and dispatch software.

Proactively identify delays and coordinate solutions to minimize service disruptions.

Provide timely shipment updates to customers and internal teams.

Customer Service

Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch.

Respond professionally to customer inquiries.

Resolve delivery concerns while maintaining exceptional customer service.

Documentation & Compliance

Maintain accurate dispatch records, driver logs, shipment notes, Bills of Lading (BOLs), and Proofs of Delivery (PODs).

Ensure compliance with DOT regulations, ELD requirements, Hours of Service (HOS), company policies, and customer-specific procedures.

Problem Solving

Resolve logistical challenges including traffic delays, vehicle breakdowns, weather disruptions, missed appointments, and last-minute schedule changes.

title: Influencer Operations & Executive Virtual Assistant
description:
Chris Michaels Management (CMM), a talent management company working with creators and influencers, is looking for a highly organized Virtual Assistant to manage creator communications, follow-ups, scheduling, CRM updates, and daily operations.



This is not a basic data-entry role. You will take responsibility for keeping conversations and tasks organized so the owner does not have to personally track everything.



YOUR MISSION

Recruit → follow up → onboard → track → remind → organize → report.



MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

- Monitor and organize business
 and Instagram creator/influencer messages.

- Track business text-message conversations when access is provided.

- Follow up with creators, models, clients, photographers, contractors, and vendors.

- Keep creator and client records updated in HubSpot or our central CRM.

- Track applications, onboarding, agreements, product purchases, campaign deadlines, and content deliverables.

- Schedule Zoom meetings, office meetings, calls, and photoshoots.

- Use approved templates for routine replies.

- Identify conversations that need the owner's decision or approval.

- Maintain a daily task/follow-up list and send a short daily executive summary.



HOW WE WORK

, Instagram, and texts are inboxes—not our management system. Important information must be captured in one central system with a clear status, next action, responsible person, and follow-up date.



Statuses include Needs Chris, VA Can Handle, Waiting on Creator, Waiting on Client, Follow-Up Needed, and Completed.



You will capture, organize, follow up, update, schedule, escalate, and report. The owner handles creator approvals, negotiations, budgets, financial decisions, important client relationships, campaign direction, creative approval, and hiring decisions.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong written English and clear, professional communication.

- Excellent organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

- Confidence following up politely with creators and business contacts.

- Initiative and good judgment about when to act and when to escalate.

- Ability to work independently after training and learn new systems quickly.

- Comfort with Gmail, Google Docs/Sheets, Instagram, calendars, and CRM software.

- HubSpot experience is a plus.

- Influencer marketing, social media inbox, customer service, or executive assistant experience is a plus.



COMPENSATION AND START

Starting target: $4–$5 USD per hour, depending on experience.

This role starts part-time at 25–32 hours per week, with the potential to grow to full-time at 40 hours per week. We will begin with a paid trial before considering a long-term arrangement. Trial scope, hours, and payment will be agreed before work begins. Please share your availability in Eastern Time.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with DEFIANT OPS and answer:

1. Tell us about a previous role where you managed many conversations or follow-ups at the same time. What system did you use, and how did you prevent missed follow-ups?

2. Which CRM systems have you used, and what did you do in them?

3. Have you managed Instagram or other social-media inboxes for a business?

4. If 20 creators are waiting on different next steps, how would you keep track of them?

5. How do you d
 which messages to escalate to the business owner? Give an example.

6. What hours are you normally available in Eastern Time?

7. What is your expected hourly rate?



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a paid fictional exercise: organize 12 creators in a tracker, assign statuses and next actions, write three follow-up messages, and prepare a short executive summary. We value organization, judgment, follow-through, and clarity more than fancy formatting.



Please apply through OnlineJobs.ph.

title: Outbound Sales & Logistics Coordinator
description:
Apply thru this link : 





 Position Overview:



 At Ready Roles, we don’t just fill positions—we build lasting, impactful careers. As an **Outbound Sales & Logistics Coordinator**, you’ll serve as a dedicated sales and operations partner for U.S.-based moving companies, with your **primary responsibility focused on outbound calling and lead conversion**.



 This is not an admin or back-office role. Your job is to **create opportunities, engage potential customers, book moving estimates, and drive revenue through strategic outbound communication**.



 Your moving-industry experience will allow you to understand the customer journey, moving operations, scheduling, dispatch, and the urgency involved in coordinating a move.



 The core mission of this role is simple: **turn outbound conversations into booked moving opportunities while supporting the moving company's day-to-day logistics when needed.**



---



 ## Why Join Ready Roles?



 ### A Career Path, Not Just a Job



 This role is designed for growth-minded professionals who want to contribute directly to revenue and become an essential part of a U.S.-based moving company's sales and operations team.



 ### Independence and Opportunity to Lead



 You’ll take ownership of daily outbound calling, lead follow-up, appointment setting, and customer communication. You’ll be expected to manage your pipeline proactively and work the leads like they’re your own book of business.



 ### Respectful, Growth-Focused Clients



 You’ll support clients who value proactive, performance-driven team members who can generate opportunities, communicate professionally, and help the business grow.



---



 # Key Responsibilities:



 ## 1\. Outbound Calling & Lead Generation



 - Conduct daily outbound calls to homeowners, prospects, leads, and potential moving customers.

- Follow up consistently with leads to identify and create moving opportunities.

- Re-engage prospects who previously inquired but did not book.

- Qualify leads and identify customers with potential upcoming moving needs.

- Build rapport and establish trust with potential customers.

- Ask effective questions to understand the customer's moving requirements.

- Communicate the moving company's services clearly and professionally.

- Maintain consistent calling and follow-up activity throughout the day.

- Work toward daily and weekly outbound calling and appointment-setting goals.



 ## 2\. Appointment Setting & Sales Follow-Up



 - Book qualified moving estimates and appointments.

- Follow up with customers who have received estimates or have not yet scheduled.

- Confirm appointments and ensure customers have the correct information.

- Maintain a consistent follow-up schedule for active prospects.

- Track conversations, outcomes, and next steps in the CRM.

- Identify opportunities to move prospects further through the sales process.

- Communicate qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales or operations team.



 ## 3\. Realtor Outreach & Referral Development



 - Conduct outbound calls to local realtors within the client's market.

- Introduce the moving company and establish professional relationships.

- Follow up with realtors to create referral opportunities.

- Maintain a consistent pipeline of potential referral partners.

- Track realtor conversations, follow-ups, and referral opportunities.

- Develop long-term relationships that can generate moving leads.



 ## 4\. Lead Management & Data Activation



 - Work through provided lead and homeowner data to identify potential moving opportunities.

- Prioritize leads based on potential value and likelihood of needing moving services.

- Maintain accurate and organized lead records.

- Remove or flag invalid, inactive, sold, or otherwise unusable leads.

- Update CRM records after calls and customer interactions.

- Ensure every active lead has an appropriate next step or follow-up date.



 ## 5\. Moving Logistics & Customer Coordination



 While **outbound calling is the primary responsibility**, your moving-industry experience will also be used to support logistics and customer coordination.



 - Assist with move scheduling and coordination.

- Communicate with customers regarding move details, confirmations, delays, and updates.

 ## 6\. Tracking & Reporting

- Track daily outbound activity and appointment-setting performance.

- Provide clear updates on lead activity and pipeline progress.

- Prepare daily or weekly reports as requested.

- Identify patterns and opportunities that can improve outbound performance.



---



 # What We’re Looking For:

 This role is for someone who naturally takes initiative and actively looks for ways to create opportunities.



 You should not need constant reminders to make calls, follow up with leads, update the CRM, or complete your daily responsibilities.



 ### Confident Outbound Communicator



 You are comfortable picking up the phone and speaking with homeowners, customers, prospects, and realtors.



 You can handle rejection professionally, maintain energy throughout the day, and continue making calls without losing motivation.



 ### Moving Industry Experience



 You understand how a moving company operates.



 You should have experience working for a moving company and understand concepts such as estimates, customers, crews, scheduling, dispatch, and move coordination.



 ### Results-Oriented



 You understand that outbound calling is not simply about making calls—it is about **creating conversations, generating opportunities, booking estimates, and contributing to revenue**.



 ### Commitment to Long-Term Growth



 Ready Roles is built on loyalty and stability. We’re looking for someone who values a long-term commitment, seeks stability, and is motivated to grow with the business they support.



 ### Aligned with Our Values



 Ready Roles believes in accountability, respect, and integrity. We’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, consistently shows up with purpose, and is eager to create a lasting impact.



---



 # Qualifications:



 ### Must Have:



 - Must be based in the Philippines.

- 18 years old and above.

- **Minimum 2 years of experience working for a moving company.**

- Previous experience as a Dispatcher, Logistics Coordinator, Move Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, or similar moving-industry position.

- Strong outbound calling and phone communication skills.

- Strong spoken and written English communication skills.

- Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls every day.

- Experience communicating directly with customers.

- Experience with scheduling, coordination, or moving operations.

- Strong follow-up and relationship-building skills.

- Ability to handle rejection and remain persistent and professional.

- Strong organizational and time-management skills.

- Ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

- Familiarity with CRM systems and scheduling software.

- Willing to work from home with a stable internet connection.

- Must have your own reliable laptop or PC and noise-cancelling headset.

- Available to work full-time, 40 hours per week.



 ### Preferred Experience:



 - SmartMoving

- Supermove

- Movegistics

- RingCentral

- Google Workspace

- CRM systems

- Outbound calling platforms or dialers

- Lead-generation systems

- Scheduling software



---



 # What You Can Expect from Ready Roles:



 ### Clear Growth Path and Scalable Compensation



 As the business grows and you take on additional responsibilities, the business owner is committed to scaling your compensation. Your role and earning potential can grow as your impact on the business increases.



 ### Supportive, Stable Environment



 Ready Roles partners with respectful, growth-focused clients who are committed to creating positive, long-term working relationships.



 Our goal is to give you the support and resources needed to succeed while helping you become an important part of the client's business.



 ### Training and Development



 You’ll receive onboarding, training, and ongoing support to help you understand the client's business, improve your outbound performance, and develop into a stronger sales and operations professional.



---



 # Why Our Clients Depend on Us



 Our clients are ambitious business owners who trust Ready Roles to help them grow and succeed.



 They need someone who can **pick up the phone, create opportunities, follow up consistently, book appointments, communicate with customers, and take ownership of the sales pipeline.**



 At the same time, they value someone who understands the moving industry and can support logistics and operations when needed.



 We’re looking for someone who is motivated by the opportunity to **generate business, solve problems, build relationships, and become an essential part of a growing company.**



---



 # Important: This Is an Outbound Calling Role



 **Outbound calling is the primary responsibility of this position.**



 If you are looking for a data-entry, administrative, or quiet back-office position, this role is not for you.



 You should be comfortable spending a significant portion of your workday:



 - Making outbound calls

- Following up with prospects

- Speaking with customers

- Calling realtors

- Qualifying opportunities

- Booking moving estimates

- Updating the CRM

- Driving leads toward conversion



 Your moving-industry experience is what allows you to understand the business and speak confidently with customers—but **your primary mission is to generate moving opportunities through outbound calling.**



---

title: SALES STRATEGIST / COPYWRITER – LOW-TICKET OFFERS
description:
# SALES STRATEGIST / COPYWRITER – LOW-TICKET OFFERS



**Work Type:** Full-Time

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST

We are looking for a **Sales Strategist / Copywriter** who knows how to sell.



This is **NOT a lead generation or general VA position.**

We need someone who understands how to turn attention into sales through strong messaging, compelling hooks, persuasive copy, and strategic content.



You should be someone who can look at an offer and say:



**"Here's the angle. Here's the hook. Here's what we should say. Here's why people will buy."**



We're looking for someone who has **actually sold low-ticket digital products/offers before** and can show us measurable results.



## WHAT YOU'LL DO

, Instagram,

We want someone who can **think strategically and contribute ideas.**

 copy

* Social proof

* Benefits vs. features

* Risk reversal

* Emotional triggers

* Offer positioning

* Conversion psychology



### 4. Strategic Thinking



We don't want someone who simply waits for instructions.



We want someone who can say:



> "I think this offer will sell better if we position it this way."



You should be comfortable testing ideas, analyzing results, and making recommendations.



### 5. Excellent English



You must be able to write **clear, natural, persuasive English**.



Your copy should sound human — not generic, robotic, or AI-generated.



## BIG PLUS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH:



* Selling $5–$20 digital products

*
/Instagram marketing

* Organic social media sales

* Paid ads

*
 marketing

* Funnels

* Info products

* Direct-response marketing

* A/B testing

Please do NOT apply if your experience is primarily:

* Appointment setting

* Basic social media posting

* Administrative work

* Generic content writing

Being a good writer is **not enough** for this position.



We need someone who understands **how to sell.**

Your success will ultimately be measured by your ability to help us generate sales.



Our immediate target is:



### **5,000+ sales of our $7 Starter Kit**



We want someone who is excited by that kind of goal and wants to be accountable for the messaging and strategy that helps make it happen.



## WORK SCHEDULE



**Monday–Friday**

**8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST**



There is a **daily team huddle at 8:00 AM CST**, and attendance is required.



You must be able to consistently work this schedule.



## HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send a generic application.



Answer the following questions:

Include:

title: Codex Virtual Assistant
description:
# Codex Virtual Assistant



## AI Project Coordination & Quality Support



MS² — My Story Studio is developing an innovative application that transforms family photos, videos, voices and memories into meaningful stories, photo books and films.



A substantial part of the product is being developed with OpenAI Codex. We are looking for a careful, reliable and analytically minded Virtual Assistant who can help the founder prepare, supervise and verify this work.



**Programming experience is not required.**



What matters most is your ability to think logically, follow instructions accurately, maintain a clear overview and recognise inconsistencies.



## Your role



You will work directly with the founder and help manage the daily collaboration with Codex.



Codex performs and explains the technical work. You ensure that assignments are properly started, monitored, documented and completed.



Your responsibilities will include:



* Preparing clear and structured assignments for Codex

* Ensuring that every assignment has a defined objective, scope and expected result

* Starting Codex runs using provided instructions and templates

* Monitoring active runs and responding when Codex requires additional input

* Carefully reading Codex reports and completion summaries

* Checking whether every question and requirement has been addressed

* Comparing completed work with the original assignment

* Identifying contradictions, missing information and unresolved issues

* Verifying that conclusions are supported by evidence

* Ensuring that Codex follows the agreed procedures

* Recording decisions, progress, blockers and follow-up actions

* Keeping planning sheets and project documentation accurate and current

* Starting the next approved assignment when a run is complete

* Escalating warnings, unexpected results and discrepancies to the founder

* Maintaining a reliable overview of several parallel activities



You will receive clear procedures, checklists, templates and instructions.



## Who we are looking for



You are someone who:



* Thinks logically and analytically

* Works in a highly structured and careful way

* Reads instructions completely before taking action

* Pays close attention to details

* Notices inconsistencies that others may overlook

* Can distinguish between facts, assumptions and conclusions

* Asks precise questions when something is unclear

* Follows agreed procedures consistently

* Keeps accurate records

* Can manage several related tasks without losing the overview

* Communicates clearly and concisely in written English

* Follows up reliably without needing constant reminders

* Is curious and comfortable learning new AI tools

* Stops and asks for guidance when instructions and actual results do not match



Experience in administration, project coordination, quality control, auditing, research, legal files, financial files or another accuracy-sensitive environment can be highly relevant.



## No programming experience required



You do not need experience with Python, coding or software development.



You should feel comfortable working with:



* Written procedures and checklists

* Structured reports and project documentation

* Google Sheets or similar tools

* ChatGPT, Codex or comparable AI applications

* English-language instructions

* Several open applications and tasks at the same time



Training in the MS² working method and the practical use of Codex will be provided.



## Working with Windows PowerShell and Azure Cloud Shell



Some assignments will involve **Windows PowerShell** and **Microsoft Azure Cloud Shell**.



You may be asked to:



* Open Windows PowerShell or the authorised Azure Cloud Shell environment

* Copy and run commands supplied by Codex

* Return the complete output to Codex

* Check that the displayed repository, branch, account, subscription or starting conditions match the instructions

* Capture and record the requested evidence

* Keep a session open while an authorised operation is running

* Stop and report any warning, error or unexpected difference



Previous PowerShell, command-line or Azure experience is not required. Clear instructions and training will be provided.



You must follow the supplied commands and boundaries exactly. You may never improvise commands, expand the scope of an assignment, create cloud resources, change permissions, approve spending or perform destructive actions without explicit authorisation.



## Working time and daily availability



The role involves approximately **two active working hours per day**.



These active hours will generally be spread across a broader agreed availability period. Codex assignments often include periods during which the system works independently. These waiting periods do not count as active working time.



You must be available at regular intervals during the agreed working day to:



* Check the progress of active Codex runs

* Respond when Codex requests input

* Report questions or unexpected results

* Record completed work

* Start the next approved assignment



Reliable follow-up throughout the day is essential. The two active working hours will generally be divided into several shorter interventions because Codex may require input at different moments.



The precise daily availability window will be agreed before the assignment begins.



## Remuneration



The remuneration is intended to combine:



* A **fixed base payment** for the agreed availability and core responsibilities

* A **variable component** linked to the quality, reliability and successful completion of the agreed work



The variable component will reward:



* Careful and complete execution

* Reliable daily follow-up

* Accurate reporting

* Correct use of the agreed procedures

* Timely identification of errors, inconsistencies and blockers

* Successful completion of approved assignments



Speed alone will not determine performance. Quality, care and reliability remain essential.



The exact fixed payment, variable component and evaluation method will be agreed before the assignment begins.



## Minimum computer requirements



You must have your own reliable working equipment, including:



* A Windows 11 computer

* At least 16 GB of RAM

* A modern Intel Core i5, AMD Ryzen 5 or equivalent processor

* An SSD with sufficient free storage

* A stable and sufficiently fast internet connection

* A reliable webcam and headset

* A screen setup that allows you to work comfortably with Codex, instructions, PowerShell and Google Sheets simultaneously



Two monitors are strongly preferred because several documents, shells and Codex sessions may need to remain visible at the same time.



Your computer must:



* Be protected with a secure password

* Use current Windows and security updates

* Have active antivirus protection

* Be used in a private and secure working environment

* Never be shared with unauthorised persons while MS² accounts or information are accessible



## About MS²



MS² — My Story Studio helps people transform scattered memories into stories worth preserving.



The product brings together photographs, videos, voices, people, relationships, events and personal context. Its Director uses this information to create meaningful story experiences and physical or digital products.



Our guiding journey is:



**Your memories. → Your story. → Your WOW.**



MS² is being built around quality, privacy, human dignity and practical ownership of family memories.



## What makes this role interesting



You will work closely with the founder on an ambitious new product and gain practical experience with an emerging way of building software through artificial intelligence.



Your contribution will come from logical thinking, careful execution, organisation and quality control. Your work will directly influence the reliability and progress of the product.



This is a remote Virtual Assistant position.



## How to apply



Please send:



* A short personal introduction

* Your CV or LinkedIn profile

* A description of your current computer and screen setup

* Your normal daily availability

* Your experience with ChatGPT, Codex or other AI tools

* An example of work in which accuracy and structured thinking were important

* A short example of a situation in which you noticed an error or inconsistency that others had missed



You are welcome to use AI when preparing your application. We are especially interested in seeing how carefully and logically you think.

title: Legal Assistant
description:
We are a growing U.S.-based law firm seeking a Legal Assistant to join our team and provide hands-on support with client matters and the firm's day-to-day legal operations.



This is an opportunity for someone who is highly organized, exceptionally detail-oriented, and interested in learning a specialized area of law. We are interested in finding someone who is intelligent, organized, curious, dependable, and capable of learning complex processes.



This position will begin at 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time, with the potential for additional hours and increased responsibility as the firm's needs grow.



We are looking for someone interested in developing a long-term relationship with the firm and becoming someone we can rely on to help move client matters forward.



About the Role



The Legal Assistant will work closely with firm leadership and assist with a variety of legal, administrative, and client-related matters.



Because our practice is highly specialized, you will learn our processes and systems over time. The successful candidate does not need to know the answers when they start, but they must be willing and able to learn, research, follow detailed instructions, ask thoughtful questions, and become increasingly independent.



The role may include:



- Assisting with client applications and renewals

- Preparing and organizing documents for regulatory filings

- Reviewing applications and supporting documentation for completeness and accuracy

- Organizing client information and documentation

- Maintaining client files and electronic folders

- Preparing forms, spreadsheets, trackers, and other work product

- Reviewing documents carefully for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information

- Conducting legal research at the direction of the attorney

- Preparing research summaries and internal notes

- Tracking applications, submissions, corrections, deadlines, and outstanding items

- Communicating with clients regarding administrative and document requests

- Drafting routine client correspondence based on instructions or templates

- Following up with clients regarding missing information or documentation

- Assisting with submissions to government agencies

- Monitoring the status of pending applications and regulatory matters

- Organizing correspondence and documentation received from government agencies

- Maintaining internal databases, spreadsheets, and matter trackers

- Following established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and drafting new ones

- Assisting with the development and improvement of firm processes

- Providing general support to firm leadership

- Scheduling and setting appointments

- Taking on additional projects and responsibilities as the candidate becomes more familiar with the firm



The work requires a high level of attention to detail. A seemingly small discrepancy in a name, address, ownership document, application response, or supporting document can matter, so we are looking for someone who naturally double-checks their work rather than simply checking a box.



What We Are Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who is:



- Exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable and consistent

- A strong written and verbal communicator in English

- Comfortable working with detailed information

- Able to follow written and verbal instructions carefully

- Comfortable working independently

- Willing to ask questions when something is unclear

- Proactive about identifying missing information or potential problems

- Able to manage multiple matters and competing priorities

- Comfortable working with confidential client information

- Curious and genuinely interested in learning

- Comfortable conducting internet and regulatory research

- Able to learn new software, systems, and procedures

- Responsive and professional in communications

- Able to receive feedback and incorporate it into future work

- Someone who takes ownership of assignments and follows them through to completion



We are particularly interested in candidates who are analytical and naturally curious. You may be given a regulatory question or an unfamiliar application and need to figure out where to look, identify the relevant information, and organize what you find for the attorney.



You should not be someone who needs every step of every assignment spelled out indefinitely. As you become familiar with our practice and systems, we expect you to become increasingly comfortable recognizing what needs to be done next.



Experience



Prior experience as a legal assistant, paralegal, regulatory assistant, compliance assistant, or administrative professional is helpful but not required. Law firm experience is preferred but not required.



Experience working in a regulated industry, professional services environment, government agency, compliance role, or another detail-oriented position may be particularly helpful.



Most importantly, we are looking for someone with the ability and willingness to learn. We will teach you our practice.



A candidate who has excellent organizational skills, strong writing abilities, good judgment, and a demonstrated ability to learn may be a much better fit than someone with years of legal experience who lacks those qualities.



Hours



- Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

- 20 guaranteed hours per week

- Must be consistently available during the stated Eastern Time hours

- Long-term position; this is not intended to be a short-term or temporary assignment



There is potential for the position to grow in both hours and responsibility for the right person.



How to Apply



Please read the instructions carefully before applying. Attention to detail is an important part of this position, and failure to follow the application instructions may result in your application not being considered.



Please provide:



1. A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in the position and why you believe you would be a good legal assistant.

2. A summary of your relevant experience, including legal, administrative, regulatory, compliance, customer service, or professional services experience.

3. Your current resume.

4. A link to a 2–3 minute introductory video telling us about yourself, your professional background, and why you are interested in this position.

5. Your expected hourly rate in USD.

6. Your availability, including confirmation that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time.

7. At least five (5) Apply Points. Applications submitted with fewer than five Apply Points will not be considered.

8. Include the word DESIGN in the subject line of your application.



Who Will Succeed in This Role?



This position is best suited to someone who enjoys learning how things work and making sure things are done correctly.



You will be working in a specialized legal practice where you will encounter unfamiliar terminology, government forms, regulatory requirements, and client situations. We do not expect you to know these things when you begin. We do expect you to be willing to learn them.



Over time, our goal is for you to become someone who understands our systems well enough to anticipate what is needed, identify missing information, keep matters organized, and help ensure that nothing falls through the cracks.



If you are dependable, highly detail-oriented, intellectually curious, and take pride in producing accurate work, we encourage you to apply.

description:

This is not an entry-level sales position and not a customer-service/order-taking role. We are looking for someone who is exceptionally persuasive, organized, competitive, and disciplined about follow-up—but who also believes that integrity and doing what is right for the customer come before commissions.

We want a salesperson who can sell at a very high level without compromising honesty or trust. The goal isn't to pressure people into buying something they don't need. It's to help customers understand the value of a high-quality service, confidently recommend the right solution, and earn their business.



THE ROLE

You will primarily handle warm inbound leads from customers already interested in our services and turn those opportunities into booked jobs.

Services include windshield replacement, rock chip repair, automotive window tint, and headlight restoration.

The position may also include outbound business development, primarily working warm leads and opportunities with fleets, dealerships, and automotive businesses.

Your job is to maximize every lead: build trust quickly, identify what the customer needs, handle objections, confidently ask for the sale, keep excellent notes, and follow up at exactly the right times.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Exceptional sales ability. Ideally, you have measurable evidence that you've been among the top performers in a previous sales organization.

Exceptional integrity. You sell honestly, keep your word, put the customer's best interests first, and never sacrifice integrity for a commission.

Near-native spoken English. Your English must be exceptionally fluent, natural, and effortless for U.S. customers to understand over the phone.

Excellent organization and follow-up. You reliably track opportunities, maintain accurate notes, and don't let valuable leads fall through the cracks.

GoHighLevel experience is a plus, but not required.

Auto glass or automotive tint sales experience is preferred, but not required.

We would rather hire an exceptional salesperson with integrity and teach them auto glass than hire someone with years of industry experience who is only average at sales.



COMPENSATION

A successful salesperson will have the opportunity to earn approximately $10–$30+ USD/hour in total compensation. Exceptional performers may earn more.

Starting base: approximately $5–$6 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability, plus uncapped commissions and performance bonuses.

This is a full-time position, with meaningful availability required during U.S. Mountain Time business hours.

International applicants are welcome.



HOW TO APPLY

Please send your résumé/work history and measurable evidence of your sales performance.

Tell us what you sold, your results, quota performance, awards, and—where possible—your ranking compared with other salespeople.

For example: “I ranked #2 out of 47 sales representatives and averaged 138% of quota.”



60-SECOND VOICE AUDITION

Imagine you work for Hunt Glass. You give a customer a windshield replacement quote, and the customer says:

“Thanks. I'm going to call around and get a few more prices before I d
.”

Respond exactly as you would if you were actually speaking with that customer.

Don't tell us how you would handle the objection. Actually sell us.



Also tell us:

Where you're located

What hours you can work in U.S. Mountain Time

Your best measurable sales achievement

Whether you've used Omega EDI

Whether you have experience with GoHighLevel

Whether you've sold auto glass or automotive tint

We're looking for an exceptional salesperson who can produce exceptional results without compromising integrity.

title: Website Builder & SEO
description:

Budget: $350 USD fixed price

Platform: Squarespace

Business: Commercial Janitorial / Office Cleaning

Location: Santa Monica / West Los Angeles, California



I am launching Ocean Park Commercial Cleaning, a commercial janitorial company serving small and mid-sized businesses in Santa Monica and West Los Angeles.



I am looking for someone experienced with Squarespace website design and local SEO to build a professional, modern website and properly optimize the site for Google search.



This project has two parts.



PART 1 — BUILD THE SQUARESPACE WEBSITE

I will provide the business name, logo, brand colors, service information, contact information, and general direction.

The website should be clean, professional, trustworthy, mobile-friendly, and easy for a business owner or office manager to navigate.



The design should use the colors from my logo:

Navy blue

Turquoise

Yellow/gold accent

White



The website should look appropriate for a professional B2B service company, not a residential house-cleaning business.

I like the structure and conversion-focused approach of these commercial cleaning websites:



Jani-King:





AMR Janitorial:





Janitorial LA:





Stratus Building Solutions:





I do NOT want these websites copied. They are examples of the type of navigation, page structure, service presentation, and quote-generation approach I want. I want a blog set up where I can post regularly. 



Homepage Requirements

- The homepage should immediately communicate:

- Ocean Park Commercial Cleaning

- Professional commercial cleaning and janitorial services for Santa Monica and West Los Angeles businesses.

- A prominent Request a Quote form or CTA should appear above the fold.

- About page

- Room for me to upload certifications towards the bottom of the page 

- Navigation to a blog where I can begin to build SEO



The quote form should collect information such as:

- Name

- Company

-

- Phone

- Business address / ZIP code

- Approximate office size

- Cleaning frequency needed

- Message / additional information





At minimum, I expect the site to include:

- Home

- Services we offer

- About Us

- Service Areas / Santa Monica & West LA

- Request a Quote / Contact + how we quote 

- Blog 



The exact architecture can be adjusted if you have a better recommendation for SEO.

The site must be completely responsive and look professional on desktop, tablet, and mobile.



PART 2 — ON-PAGE SEO + LOCAL SEO SETUP

SEO experience is required.

I do not want someone who simply enters a few keywords into Squarespace.

The website should be structured from the beginning around local commercial-cleaning search intent.



Primary target geography includes:

- Santa Monica

- Ocean Park

- Venice

- Marina del Rey

- West Los Angeles

- Culver City

- Brentwood

- Playa Vista

- Nearby Westside Los Angeles business districts



Primary service/search themes include terms such as:

- Commercial cleaning Santa Monica

- Janitorial services Santa Monica

Office cleaning Santa Monica

- Commercial cleaning West Los Angeles

- Janitorial services West Los Angeles

- Office cleaning West LA

- small business janitorial 

- small business cleaning 

- Commercial janitorial services

- Business cleaning services



I expect you to perform appropriate keyword research rather than blindly using these exact phrases.



SEO Deliverables



For every important page, configure:

- SEO page title

- Meta description

- Proper H1 / H2 structure

- SEO-friendly URL slug

- Relevant local keywords

- Internal linking

- Image alt text

- Image/file optimization where appropriate

- Page descriptions

- Social sharing metadata

- Mobile optimization

- Basic technical Squarespace SEO settings

- Also configure or verify:

- Google Search Console readiness

- Google Analytics / GA4 readiness

- XML sitemap

- SSL / HTTPS

- Proper indexing settings

- Favicon

- Social sharing image

- Business name, address/service area, and phone consistency

- LocalBusiness / relevant schema if supported or appropriately implemented

- Basic conversion tracking setup where practical

- I also want recommendations for the structure of my future Google Business Profile and additional location/service pages that could improve local search visibility.



CONTENT



I can provide information about the business, but I expect the person I hire to be comfortable helping structure and improve website copy with SEO best practices.



You should understand how to write or organize service-business website content around both:

- Conversion: getting business owners and office managers to request a quote.

- SEO: helping Google understand what services we provide and where we provide them.

WHO I AM LOOKING FOR: You must have demonstrated experience with:

- Website design

- Local SEO

- On-page SEO

- Service-business websites

- Mobile-responsive design

- Conversion-focused landing pages

HOW TO APPLY, Please include:

This role is ideal for someone who can take company goals and turn them into organized campaigns, clear assignments, published content, measurable results, and consistent follow-through.



This is not simply a social media posting position. You will be responsible for coordinating the people, content, systems, deadlines, and reporting behind our marketing efforts.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



MARKETING PLANNING AND EXECUTION

, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms

, CRM, AND CONTENT MARKETING

 campaigns

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

 marketing, and lead generation

-marketing platform

Experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, podcast distribution, SEO, Zapier, or marketing automation is a bonus.

You must be available for a consistent overlap with U.S. Eastern Time for team communication, approvals, and meetings. The exact schedule will be discussed during the interview.

**Part Time | 10 to 20 Hours/Week | $8/Hour to Start**



### Quick Summary

• Main focus is building and customizing websites and funnels



• Help us create the systems and SOPs we use to onboard and fulfill new clients



• Experience building client onboarding systems and repeatable processes is important

• Experience with GHL automations, forms, review automation, workflows and follow up



• You will work directly with me as the owner of the company



• Hours will fluctuate between 10 and 20 hours per week depending on how many clients we are onboarding



• We expect to grow quickly over the next 30 to 45 days and are targeting 1 to 3 new clients every week



• As the number of clients increases, this has the potential to become a full time position



• Starting pay is $8/hour



• You must apply through OnlineJobs.ph, complete the VideoAsk and send a resume and portfolio



## About the Role



We are looking for someone who knows GoHighLevel well and can help us build a better system for onboarding and fulfilling new clients.



Right now, we are still developing that system.



Our goal is to be able to sign a new client, collect everything we need from them, get their website and GoHighLevel account set up, complete the necessary SEO and Google Business Profile work, set up their automations and get everything launched as quickly and efficiently as possible.



I want someone who can help me build that process.



This is not a position where I want to hand you a checklist and have you follow it forever. I want you to help create the checklist.



If something takes too long, find a better way to do it.



If something needs to be done for every client, figure out how we can standardize it.



If a process can be turned into an SOP, document it.



If something can be automated, help us automate it.



The goal is to build a fulfillment system that we can use over and over as the company grows.



### What You Will Work On



Most of your work will be inside GoHighLevel and related marketing platforms.



You will be building and customizing websites, working with templates, changing branding, setting up forms, connecting domains, making revisions and getting websites ready to launch.



You will also help with:



• Client onboarding systems and SOPs



• GoHighLevel workflows and automations



• Form submission and lead follow up automations



• Automated review requests



• Calendars and pipelines



• Snapshots and Custom Values



• Website troubleshooting



• Google Business Profile optimization



• Local SEO



• On page SEO



• Schema and structured data



• AEO and GEO



• Making websites easier for Google and AI search platforms to understand



SEO is an important part of this position. We want someone who understands how to build websites and online profiles that are set up properly from an SEO standpoint, especially for local businesses.



Google Business Profile experience is also important. You should understand how to optimize a profile, improve the information on it and help support local search visibility.



### What I Care About Most



The biggest thing I am looking for is someone who can think independently and help build systems.



I want someone who looks at a process and asks:



“How can we make this faster?”



“How can we make this easier for the next client?”



“How can we build this once and reuse it?”



You will be working directly with me as the owner, so communication, reliability and taking ownership are very important.



Client facing experience is a plus.



## Hours and Growth



For now, the workload will generally be **10 to 20 hours per week**.



The exact number of hours will depend on how many clients we are signing and how much fulfillment is needed.



We expect the company to grow quickly over the next **30 to 45 days**, with a goal of signing approximately **1 to 3 new clients every week**.



As the client base grows, we expect this role to grow with it and potentially become a **full time position**.



Starting pay is **$8/hour**.



## How to Apply



There are three required steps.



**1. Apply through OnlineJobs.ph**



**2. Complete the VideoAsk**







**3. Send your resume and a portfolio of websites you have personally built**



Please send 3 to 5 website examples if possible. GoHighLevel websites are preferred.



You must complete all three steps to be considered.



We are looking for someone who can become our GoHighLevel expert and help us build the systems that will allow us to fulfill clients quickly as the company grows.

!!! IMPORTANT !!!

Please also complete the Google Form and attach your updated resume as part of your application. 



About the Schedule



The shift is 12:00 AM to 8:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. That's 9am–5pm in Vancouver, Canada, where we're based.

This is a permanent work from home and graveyard schedule, not a rotating one. If that doesn't work for your life, please don't apply — we'd rather you skip this than quit in two months.



!! About Call Hero



Call Hero is a fast-growing SaaS company based in Canada. We build AI-powered communication tools that help healthcare clinics improve the way they manage patient calls, appointments, and front desk operations.



Our customers include physical therapy clinics, chiropractic offices, dental practices, and other healthcare providers. Our mission is simple: help clinics deliver a better patient experience while increasing bookings and reducing missed opportunities.



!! The Role



You are not cold calling. You'll work warm inbound: people who have booked a demo, started a trial, missed a scheduled call, or gone quiet.



Your job is to get on the phone with a clinic owner, understand how their practice actually runs, show them what we do, and close them. You will spend at least 4 hours a day on the phone. The rest is CRM notes, follow-up, and prep.



This is NOT a virtual assistant job. No admin, data entry, design, or social media. If you don't genuinely enjoy talking to people on the phone, this role will make you miserable and we'd both regret it.



??What You'll Do



> Run scheduled demo calls with clinic owners in Canada, the US, and Australia

> Follow up with trial users and no-shows until you get a decision either way

> Handle objections about price, timing, and existing phone systems

> Keep your pipeline clean in our CRM — every call logged, every next step dated

> Hit a monthly closed-deal target



?? What We're Looking For



> At least 2 years of phone sales experience carrying a real quota. Customer support alone is not enough.

> Experience with North American customers, preferably in a BPO or similar environment

> Excellent, natural spoken English with a neutral or North American accent. You'll be speaking with clinic owners who need to feel they're talking to a colleague.

> Proven graveyard shift experience — tell us how long you did it

> Comfortable handling objections and closing, not just presenting

> A real headset and stable wired internet (25 Mbps+)

> Coachable. We record calls and review them together weekly.



!! Nice to Have



> Any healthcare background — our customers are clinicians, and speaking their language helps enormously

> Experience selling software or a subscription product

> Any background where you've been trained on how you sound



** Compensation

Php80,000–Php100,000 per month guaranteed base depending on experience, plus uncapped commission on every deal you close.



On-target earnings are Php80,000–Php150,000; the top of that range is what a strong closer actually earns hitting target, not a ceiling.



You'll also receive paid training, weekly coaching on your recorded calls, and a long-term full-time seat on a small team where you'll talk to the founder directly.



HOW TO APPLY — FOLLOW THIS EXACTLY (Send all completed application requirements to: 



Applications missing any of these five items will not be opened. This is not a soft preference.



1. Subject Line



Write the name of the city we're based in, then a dash, then the minimum number of hours per day you'd spend on the phone in this role. Both are stated above.



Format example: Toronto - 6



2. Send the Link to Your 2-Minute Audio Recording



Please send us the link to your 2-minute audio recording covering the 3 parts below. You can use Loom, Google Drive, or an unlisted YouTube video. (Three parts, about 2 minutes total)



-> We don't need a video, just the audio. We want to hear how you sound. Please make sure to check the sharing settings so we can actually open the recording.



Part A : Read this out loud, exactly as written:



"Hi, this is [your name] from Call Hero. Thanks for booking time with me. Before we jump into the demo, I want to make sure I understand your clinic. How many physiotherapists do you have on staff right now, and roughly how many calls does your front desk field on a busy Monday? The reason I ask is that most clinics we work with are losing five to fifteen bookable calls a week without realizing it — voi
s nobody returns, people who hang up after four rings, patients calling at seven in the evening when everyone's already gone home. Our system picks those up. It's about a two-week setup, and you'd keep your existing numbers."



Part B: NO SCRIPT for this one



You're live on a call and the clinic owner says:



"We already have a phone system through our practice software and honestly it works fine. What makes yours different?"



(respond the way you actually would on the phone. Don't write it out first, just talk. We're listening for how you think, not for a perfect answer.)



Part C: At the end, say today's date out loud and the phrase "for Call Hero."



3. Answer These Three Questions below: (short answers preferred)



a. Have you worked a graveyard shift before, and for how long?



b. Go to 
. In one sentence: what do you think we do, and who is our customer?

title: Marketing Assistant

What you need

Tools

Meta Ads Manager, Pinterest Ads, TikTok Ads Manager; Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest; Shopify; Klaviyo; Canva, Affinity, Photoshop; CapCut; Google Sheets.

CV plus short answers:

s and client submissions

s

s to clients, agencies, planners, venues and production partners to clarify or confirm event information.

- Ability to organize complex information from multiple sources

- Reduction in missing operational information

- Reduction in discrepancies between communications and itineraries

- Accuracy of branding, venue and timing requirements

title: SEO Specialist / SEO Manager
description:
*************Only candidates who submit an introduction video will be considered.***************



************* This is an inhouse position only************** 



Kitchen & Bath Authority has been serving the home improvement industry for over 23 years. As we continue to grow our digital presence, we are looking for a results-driven SEO Specialist / SEO Manager with hands-on experience in modern search, backlink acquisition, content strategy, and AI-driven optimization.



This is a full-time position with some scheduling flexibility. Core availability and reliable communication are expected during agreed-upon working hours, but we are open to accommodating your time zone on certain days of the week.



This role is ideal for someone who can both execute SEO initiatives independently and take ownership of projects, priorities, and potentially other team members or external partners as our digital team continues to grow.



What You'll Do



• Manage and improve on-page SEO across product, category, and content pages, including title tags, meta descriptions, heading structure, internal linking, schema markup, and content optimization



• Develop and execute backlink acquisition strategies through outreach, editorial placements, guest posting, partnerships, and digital PR



• Optimize content and site structure for emerging AI-powered search experiences, including AI Overviews (AIO), generative search surfaces, and image/search optimization opportunities



• Conduct keyword research and competitive analysis across our kitchen, bath, lighting, and home improvement product categories



• Plan, assign, review, and optimize SEO-focused blog and landing-page content; AI writing tools are welcome, but strong human editing, fact-checking, and optimization are required



• Identify technical SEO issues and work with developers or internal team members to prioritize and implement improvements



• Monitor rankings, organic traffic, conversions, backlink growth, and other key SEO KPIs using GA4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, SEMrush, and related tools



• Prepare clear monthly performance reports and translate SEO data into actionable recommendations



• Take ownership of SEO priorities, timelines, and deliverables while helping coordinate writers, developers, freelancers, agencies, or other digital team members when necessary



• Help establish SEO processes, documentation, quality standards, and best practices as the department grows



Requirements



• Minimum 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in e-commerce



• Demonstrated ability to manage SEO projects from strategy through execution and reporting



• Some managerial, team-lead, project-management, or vendor-management experience preferred



• Must submit at least 2 case studies or documented examples of past SEO success showing where you started, what actions you took, and the measurable results



• Proven backlink acquisition experience with a clear and repeatable outreach process



• Working knowledge of AI-powered search optimization, structured data, and emerging search experiences



• Proficiency with Google Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs and/or SEMrush, and technical SEO auditing tools



• Strong understanding of on-page SEO, internal linking, keyword strategy, content optimization, and technical SEO fundamentals



• Ability to work independently, prioritize effectively, meet deadlines, and clearly communicate results and recommendations



• Strong written and verbal English communication skills



Nice to Have



• Experience in home improvement, kitchen and bath, lighting, furniture, or home décor e-commerce



• Experience managing writers, SEO contractors, outreach specialists, or other digital marketing team members



• Basic HTML/CSS knowledge



• Experience with large e-commerce catalogs and product/category-page optimization



Compensation & Benefits



• Full-time position



• Paid Time Off (PTO)



• Paid U.S. holidays



• Scheduling flexibility with agreed-upon core availability



• Potential flexibility to accommodate your local time zone on certain days of the week



• Opportunity to take on greater ownership and managerial responsibility as the digital team grows



To Apply



Please send:



• Your resume



• At least 2 SEO case studies or documented examples of measurable SEO results



• A brief introduction video telling us about yourself, your SEO experience, and why you believe you would be a strong fit for this role



Only candidates who submit an introduction video will be considered.



Bonus points if you also include a Loom walkthrough of a site audit, SEO project, backlink campaign, or ranking win. Candidates who provide a strong walkthrough will receive priority consideration.



We are looking for someone who can do more than follow an SEO checklist. We want someone who can identify opportunities, take ownership, execute effectively, measure results, and help lead our SEO efforts as we continue to grow.

title: Bookkeepper
description:
## Bookkeeper – Ocean World Travel



Ocean World Travel is an established UK travel business specialising in cruises. We are looking for an experienced, reliable and highly accurate **Bookkeeper** to join our team on a long-term basis.



The role will involve maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the day-to-day bookkeeping of the business.



### Main Responsibilities



* Maintain accurate bookkeeping records and financial transactions.

* Record and reconcile bank and credit card transactions.

* Reconcile customer and supplier payments.

* Monitor invoices, payments and outstanding balances.

* Maintain purchase and sales ledgers.

* Prepare regular financial reports and summaries for management.

* Assist with monthly management accounts and year-end information.

* Prepare information and supporting schedules for our UK accountant.

* Check transactions and investigate discrepancies or unusual items.

* Maintain organised digital financial records and supporting documentation.

* Assist with cash-flow monitoring and payment schedules.

* Help ensure transactions are correctly allocated and recorded.

* Support the management team with financial information and ad-hoc bookkeeping tasks.



### What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* An experienced bookkeeper, ideally with experience supporting a UK business.

* Highly accurate and detail-oriented.

* Trustworthy and comfortable dealing with confidential financial information.

* Organised and able to manage their own workload.

* Confident identifying discrepancies rather than simply entering figures.

* Comfortable working independently with regular communication with the UK team.

* A strong communicator with excellent written English.

* Experienced with accounting/bookkeeping software and Excel/Google Sheets.

* Proactive and willing to suggest improvements to processes.



Experience within **UK accounting, VAT, travel, retail, hospitality or another transaction-heavy business** would be advantageous.



### Important



This is a **long-term position**, not a short-term data-entry role. We are looking for someone who will become a trusted member of our team and develop a good understanding of our business and financial processes.



Accuracy, confidentiality and integrity are extremely important to us.



The successful candidate will receive training on our systems and processes. They will initially work closely with the UK team and, once fully trained, will be expected to manage their regular bookkeeping responsibilities independently.



Applicants should provide a CV and details of their bookkeeping experience, accounting software used, experience with UK businesses/VAT and their expected monthly salary in PHP.
