title: Administrative & Client Support Assistant
description:
About the role:

We're a digital marketing agency serving home service businesses (electricians, garage door companies, pressure washers, coatings and window cleaning contractors). About 150 accounts and growing.



This role is the front door. You're the first person a client reaches when they call,
, or hit the chat widget. Most of what comes in is routine and you'll handle it start to finish. The rest you'll route to the right account manager, ad buyer, or automation specialist and then make sure it actually gets closed out.



We're looking for someone who takes ownership of the small stuff so nothing slips. If you like clean inboxes, tidy records, and closing loops, you'll do well here.



What you'll be doing:



Phone and communication

- Answer inbound calls during business hours — clients, vendors, and occasional prospects

- Take clear messages, route calls to the right person, and follow up so nothing dies in a voi

- Return missed calls and respond to inbound leads quickly (speed matters in this industry)





 and inbox management

- Own shared inboxes: triage, sort, label, respond, escalate

- Draft and send routine client communications

- Track outstanding threads and chase down responses (internally and externally)



Chat and support

- Monitor and respond to live chat messages with in 1 minute

- Resolve Tier-1 support inquiries: login and access issues, contact and record lookups, basic "how do I" questions about our platform, small requests for changes or updates

- Write up anything you can't resolve with enough detail that the next person doesn't have to ask twice

- Flag recurring issues so we can fix the root cause instead of answering the same question forty times



Data entry and records

- Enter and update records in our CRM (GoHighLevel)

- Clean up imports, catch and merge duplicates, fix bad or missing data

- Help maintain client-facing spreadsheets and reporting docs

- Basic QA: if something looks wrong, say so before it goes to a client



Coordination

- Schedule and confirm client calls and internal meetings

- Keep tasks updated in ClickUp so status is visible without anyone having to ask

- Document what you do as you do it



What we're looking for

- 1+ years in an administrative, customer service, virtual assistant, or support role

- Excellent written and spoken English - you'll be on the phone and in writing with US business owners every day

- Comfortable on the phone. Not scared of it, not robotic on it

- Genuinely organized. You use lists, systems, and follow-ups because you want to, not because someone makes you

- Solid with Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs, Gmail) and quick to pick up new software

- Detail-oriented with data entry (accuracy over speed)

- Helps point out things that could be better rather than just going with the flow. You like to be a part of the growth

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, and a headset for calls

- Available the full 9–6 EST window, consistently



Bonus points

- GoHighLevel experience: this is our CRM. Familiarity is a real advantage

- ClickUp, Zapier, or similar tools

- Experience in the home services or trades industry

- Prior work at a marketing agency or with US-based small business clients

- Any support ticketing or help desk background



Why work with us

- Small team, you'll talk to and work directly with leadership

- Clear expectations and honest feedback, not surprise performance reviews

- Real room to grow. Our best people started narrow and expanded into account management, automation, and operations. Many of our team members have been with us for 3+ years are not in the same position they started in.

- We fix broken processes instead of asking people to work around them



If you've read this far, you're already a step ahead of most applicants. Do not apply through this job board. Applications submitted here will not be reviewed. Instead, complete our hiring form: 
/to/bk2L949U



It takes about 5 minutes. It asks about your experience with phones,
, and chat support, your CRM background, and your availability.



This is the only way to be considered. If you don't complete the form, your application won't move forward. To be direct about it, this role lives and dies on attention to detail. Following instructions here is the first test.



We look forward to chatting with you!

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Pro Coffee Gear | Full-Time | Remote



About Pro Coffee Gear



Pro Coffee Gear is a fast-growing coffee equipment company serving home enthusiasts, cafés, restaurants, and hospitality businesses across the U.S. We sell professional espresso machines, grinders, brewers, and related equipment, while also supporting customers through technical troubleshooting, warranty, installation, and service.



About the Role



We’re looking for a *Technical Support Specialist* to join our Customer Support team and become the first technical point of contact for customers experiencing equipment issues.



This is a *technical support and troubleshooting role, not a field technician position*. You’ll work remotely with customers by phone,
, and messaging to understand equipment issues, walk customers through troubleshooting, identify likely causes, and determine when a case needs to be escalated to our service technicians or manufacturers.



The right person is naturally curious, comfortable troubleshooting mechanical/electrical equipment, and able to explain technical information clearly to customers who may have little technical experience.



What You'll Do



- Provide technical support for espresso machines, grinders, brewers, and related coffee equipment

- Handle technical calls and support requests through Front and Quo

- Troubleshoot equipment issues by asking the right diagnostic questions through video calls

- Guide customers through basic troubleshooting steps remotely (good written english)

- Identify likely causes of issues and determine the appropriate next step

- Review product manuals, technical documentation, diagrams, and internal resources to find solutions

- Determine when an issue can be resolved by CS vs. when it requires technician or manufacturer escalation

- Create clear technical notes and document troubleshooting steps and outcomes

- Coordinate with senior technicians, Service, Warehouse, Sales, and manufacturers when escalation is required

- Follow up on open technical cases and make sure customers know what to expect next

- Help prevent unnecessary technician visits by gathering the right information before escalation

- Identify recurring equipment issues and communicate trends to the team

- Continue developing knowledge of espresso equipment, parts, diagnostics, and common failure points

- Contribute to improving technical support workflows, documentation, and troubleshooting guides



What We're Looking For



- Experience in technical support, equipment support, appliance repair, coffee equipment, or a similar field

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills

- Comfortable diagnosing problems through questions, symptoms, photos, and customer descriptions

- Strong written and verbal English communication

- Able to explain technical concepts in simple, customer-friendly language

- Comfortable speaking with customers by phone

- Highly organized and able to manage multiple technical cases at once

- Strong attention to detail when documenting technical issues

- Comfortable learning new equipment, systems, and technical information

- Able to recognize when you have enough information to troubleshoot vs. when something needs to be escalated

- Customer-focused, patient, and calm when dealing with frustrated customers

- Comfortable working independently in a remote environment



 Nice to Have



- Espresso machine or coffee equipment experience

- Experience with commercial espresso equipment

- Mechanical, electrical, plumbing, or appliance troubleshooting experience

- Experience working with parts diagrams or technical manuals

- Experience with Front, Quo, Shopify, Jobber, or similar support/service platforms

- Barista training, coffee shop, café, or specialty coffee experience



Why Join PCG?



You’ll be joining a growing team where technical support has a direct impact on the customer experience. This role offers the opportunity to develop deep knowledge of professional coffee equipment while helping build a more structured and scalable technical support operation.

title: All-in-One Content & Social Media Manager for a Family Brand
description:
We're a Texas family looking for one person to take over content and posting across four connected channels. We have years of footage, photos, and podcast recordings already sitting in the vault. We need someone who can learn our family's voice, pull from that archive, and keep everything running week to week without us managing every post.



What you'd own:

Nellie May's Sweet World — YouTube channel and social accounts for our daughter's content- she has reviewed candy from all of the world. Her grandmother is a flight attendant and brings her new candy weekly. 

Canopy Learning Collective — social media for our homeschool collective based on the Lake. 

Stefnie Howley — personal brand social media, focused on international family travel, homeschooling, and clean living

Spouse Podcast editing — turning raw recordings into polished, published episodes



What we're looking for:

Skilled in video editing (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar) and audio editing for podcasts

Experience managing YouTube, Instagram,
, and TikTok for a brand or creator

Strong sense of tone and storytelling. Warm, real, family first. Not overly polished or corporate

Comfortable repurposing a large existing content library into new posts across platforms

Reliable, self-directed, and able to keep a consistent posting calendar

Good written and spoken English for occasional captions, community replies, and calls



Bonus: experience with youth or family YouTube channels, homeschool or education content, or travel and lifestyle brands



How this works:

We'll hand off our footage, photos, and past episodes. You bring the editing skill, platform know-how, and a feel for how our family talks and shows up online, and you handle posting on a consistent schedule across all four accounts.

If you're organized, creative, and want a long-term role with a family that has a real story to tell, we'd love to hear from you. Please share examples of past content work, especially anything involving family, kids, education, or travel brands.



We're looking for a long-term working relationship, not a short-term project. If you're organized, creative, and excited to help tell a real family's story, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
Compliance Virtual Assistant

description:
ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON



Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories. Founded in 2019, Scriveiner has grown to serve millions of customers worldwide, with products available through major online marketplaces and more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.



Applications are only accepted through our official application form — see "How to Apply" at the end of this ad. CVs or messages sent by
, LinkedIn, or any other channel will not be reviewed.



THE OPPORTUNITY



As Inventory Assistant, you will work at the operational heart of the Inventory team, keeping stock records accurate, Amazon FBA running cleanly, and our third-party logistics partners on track. This is not a passive role. You will be the person who catches discrepancies before they become customer problems, flags low stock before it becomes a lost sale, and ensures that every shipment entering or leaving the warehouse is accounted for correctly.



The role covers the full operational breadth of inventory management: from daily stock reconciliation across the IM Sheet and Power BI dashboards, to managing Amazon Seller Central shipments and processing FBA reimbursements, to coordinating with 3PL partners on inbound and outbound fulfilment. New product launches, including wallets, notebooks, and leather accessories targeting Q3 2026, will add meaningful scope and pace to the role over the coming months.



If you are someone who finds genuine satisfaction in a clean reconciliation, who catches errors others walk past, and who wants to understand how a premium e-commerce brand actually operates end-to-end, this role will give you exactly that.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



Stock Management and Control



- Maintain accurate, up-to-date inventory records across the IM Sheet, Power BI dashboards, and all active e-commerce platforms — these records are the operational source of truth for the business

- Update and manage stock levels on the Faire and Turis wholesale platforms, ensuring availability is always reflected correctly for trade buyers

- Conduct regular cycle counts, spot checks, and full stocktakes; investigate and resolve discrepancies, variances, and shrinkage before they escalate

- Monitor stock levels proactively and flag low-inventory or overstock situations to the Inventory Manager



Order Management and 3PL Coordination



- Import and process orders into 3PL partner systems, double-checking previous orders for unfulfilled or incomplete items

- Prepare and coordinate retail orders for dispatch, liaising with 3PL partners to ensure timely and accurate fulfilment

- Process incoming shipments from suppliers and freight carriers, verifying quantities and quality, resolving delivery discrepancies, and updating stock records accurately



Amazon Seller Central and FBA Operations



- Create and manage Amazon FBA shipments end-to-end in Seller Central, including video verification, status tracking, and updating the Shipment Status File

- Process FBA reimbursement claims for missing or lost units, maintaining accurate dispute records



Reporting and Compliance



- Prepare and distribute the OD Weekly Report; update, file, and manage OD dispute records for compliance charges and discrepancies

- Generate inventory reports and variance summaries using the IM Sheet and Power BI

- Support the Inventory Manager with inventory data for seasonal demand forecasting and buying decisions

- Perform other ad hoc tasks as directed by the Inventory Manager or wider Operations team



WHO YOU ARE



Essential



- Hands-on experience in an inventory, warehousing, or retail operations role — you have worked with stock, reconciled records, and managed order processes in a real operational environment

- Confident working with inventory management tools and reporting platforms, whether that is a WMS, ERP, IM Sheet, or Power BI in combination

- Practical experience with Amazon Seller Central and FBA processes, including shipment creation and account management

- Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail — you catch errors in data that others overlook, and you find reconciliation satisfying rather than tedious

- Competent in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting, data management, and variance analysis

- A proactive communicator who flags issues early rather than waiting to be asked



Desirable



- Experience with wholesale platforms such as Faire and/or Turis

- Familiarity with 3PL order management, fulfilment workflows, and inbound shipment processing

- Experience handling Amazon compliance charges, disputes, and FBA reimbursement claims

- Understanding of FIFO stock rotation principles and inventory control best practices

- Experience using AI tools to improve operational workflows or reporting efficiency



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In this role, you will be successful when:



- Inventory records across all platforms are accurate and current, with discrepancies investigated and resolved promptly

- Amazon FBA shipments are created, verified, and tracked without errors, and reimbursement claims are filed on time

- 3PL orders are processed accurately, with fulfilment issues identified and escalated before they affect customers

- The OD Weekly Report and compliance records are maintained consistently and without prompting

- The Inventory Manager can rely on your data to make confident stock and buying decisions



HOW TO APPLY



Applications are only accepted through our official application form:

title: Short-Form Video Editor - Running Cinematic / Aesthetic Edits
description:
About the role



I'm growing a personal Instagram account in the running and fitness space — lifestyle-driven, cinematic content. Early mornings, good light, real moments.



I'm looking for an editor who can take raw footage and make it feel like something. Not a template. Not a preset pack. Edits that look intentional and make people watch twice.



If your work is clean, well-paced, and you understand why short-form trends work rather than just copying them, I want to see it.



What I'm looking for

Real short-form mastery. You understand pacing, retention, and how the first second d
 everything. Reels and TikTok specifically, not repurposed long-form.

A cinematic eye. Color, framing, rhythm. You know when to hold a shot and when to cut.

Clean over cluttered. Effects should serve the video. If every transition is a whip pan, that's not style, that's a crutch.

You know the trends — audio, formats, editing styles — and more importantly, you know when to use one and when to ignore it.

Strong on-screen text. Typography, timing, and natural native-sounding English. A great edit dies on a stiff hook.

Comfortable with AI tools where they actually improve the work: upscaling, cleanup, audio enhancement, speed-ups on the tedious parts. I care about the output, not the process — but I don't want AI slop. It should be invisible.



Software: Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci, or CapCut. I care about what you produce, not what you produce it in.



What you'll do

Edit short-form vertical video from an organized library of my raw footage.

Deliver consistently and at volume. This isn't one hero video a month.

Bring ideas. If you see a better cut than the one I asked for, make it and show me.

Take notes well and turn them around quickly.



You'll send me work for review, I'll approve or give notes, and we'll keep a steady loop going. Async is fine — I don't need you online at set hours, but I do need you responsive and consistent with deadlines.



Bonus points:



Motion graphics and custom text animation.

Color grading beyond a LUT.

Sound design — most editors ignore it and it's half the feel.

You run or you're into fitness. You'll be in this footage daily.

Details

Part-time to start — roughly 15–20 hours per week, with room to grow.

Pay based on experience. Tell me your rate. I'd rather pay well for someone genuinely good than hire cheap and redo the work.

Long-term intent. I want to build something with someone over time, not fill a one-off gig.

Paid test project before any ongoing commitment, so we both know it's a fit.

How to apply



Please include all of the following. Applications missing any of these won't be reviewed:



Your portfolio or reel. Lead with short-form vertical work.

Which AI tools you use in your workflow, if any, and what for.

Your rate, weekly availability, and software.



Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
Part-Time | Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time | Remote



We are a growing company looking for an exceptionally organized, dependable, and proactive Executive Administrative Assistant to work closely with firm leadership and help keep the business organized and running smoothly.



This is not a position for someone who simply wants to complete a list of tasks and move on to the next one. We are looking for someone who naturally thinks one step ahead, notices when something needs attention, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of getting things done.



The position will begin at 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time, with the potential over time for additional hours and expanded responsibilities as the relationship develops. Our goal is to find someone interested in becoming a long-term and trusted member of the team.



The Opportunity



You will work directly with firm leadership and will be involved in the day-to-day administrative and operational side of the business.



Some days may involve routine administrative work. Other days may involve researching an unfamiliar topic, organizing information, preparing documents, following up on an outstanding item, troubleshooting a process, or helping with a project that has never been done before.



We value someone who can take instructions and execute them accurately, but who can also eventually look at a situation and think:



“I see what needs to happen next.”



As you learn the firm, our systems, and our preferences, we expect you to become increasingly independent and proactive.



- Responsibilities may include:

- Managing calendars, meetings, appointments, and scheduling

- Preparing, editing, proofreading, and formatting documents and correspondence

- Drafting routine
s and other communications using instructions, templates, or established firm practices

- Organizing and maintaining electronic files and folders

- Managing information in Google Drive and other cloud-based systems

- Preparing forms, applications, spreadsheets, and administrative materials

- Maintaining trackers, databases, spreadsheets, and internal records

- Reviewing documents carefully for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and formatting

- Conducting online research and turning information into clear, organized summaries

- Assisting with client onboarding and administrative follow-up

- Monitoring deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding items

- Coordinating with vendors, service providers, and other third parties

- Assisting with internal projects and process improvements

- Following established Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and helping keep them organized and up to date

- Learning new software, systems, and processes

- Providing general administrative and organizational support to firm leadership

- Taking on additional projects as the firm's needs evolve



This position will involve both recurring responsibilities and unexpected projects, so the ability to adapt, prioritize, and learn quickly is important.



The Person We Are Looking For



The strongest candidate will be someone who is naturally organized and takes pride in doing things correctly.



You should be someone who:



- Pays close attention to details and catches mistakes before they become problems

- Is exceptionally reliable and follows through on commitments

- Can manage several priorities without becoming overwhelmed

- Communicates professionally and confidently in written and spoken English

- Can follow detailed instructions but also knows when to use good judgment

- Is comfortable working independently

- Asks thoughtful questions when something is unclear rather than making assumptions

- Takes initiative rather than waiting to be told about every next step

- Keeps track of open items and follows them through to completion

- Is comfortable working with confidential and sensitive information

- Learns new technology and processes without becoming frustrated

- Responds well to constructive feedback

- Is interested in improving rather than simply doing things the way they have always been done

- Takes genuine ownership of their work



Reliability and judgment are particularly important to us. We are looking for someone we can trust to handle responsibilities carefully and to tell us when something requires attention.



Prior experience as an executive assistant, administrative assistant, legal assistant, office manager, customer service professional, or in another professional services environment is ideal, but strong organizational skills, professionalism, attention to detail, and work ethic are more important than a specific job title.



We are willing to train the right person on our industry, systems, and processes.



Hours 

- Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time

- 20 guaranteed hours per week

- Additional hours may become available as the firm's needs grow

- You must be consistently available during the stated Eastern Time hours

- We are seeking someone interested in a long-term position, not a short-term or temporary role



The position has the potential to grow in both hours and responsibility for someone who demonstrates strong performance, initiative, and reliability.



How to Apply



Please read the instructions carefully before applying. Following instructions is an important part of this position, and applications that do not include the requested information may not be considered.



Please submit the following:



- A brief introduction explaining why you are interested in this position and what makes you a strong candidate for an executive administrative role.

- A summary of your relevant experience, including administrative, executive assistant, legal, customer service, or other professional experience.

- Your current resume.

- A link to a 2–3 minute introductory video. Please tell us a little about yourself, your professional background, and why you are interested in working with our firm. We are interested in hearing you speak and learning a little about the person behind the application.

- Your expected hourly rate in USD.

- Your availability, including confirmation that you can consistently work Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–1:00 PM Eastern Time.

- At least five (5) Apply Points. Applications containing fewer than five Apply Points will not be considered.

- Include the word NORTHSTAR in the subject line of your application.



What Success Looks Like



We are ultimately looking for someone who can become a trusted extension of firm leadership.



In the beginning, you will receive more direction as you learn how we work. Over time, the goal is for you to understand our systems and preferences well enough that you can anticipate needs, keep track of moving pieces, identify issues, and handle responsibilities with increasing independence.



If you are the type of person who enjoys bringing order to chaos, takes pride in being dependable, notices the little things, and likes being the person others can count on, we would love to hear from you.

title: Deal Sourcing & Acquisitions Analyst - Real Estate Development
description:
About the Role

We are a Chicago-focused real estate development company seeking a highly resourceful, analytical, and persistent person to help us find and evaluate development opportunities. This role combines deal sourcing, owner research, direct outreach, zoning research, and real estate underwriting. It is not a traditional administrative VA role.

Your job is simple to describe but difficult to master: find properties that may be valuable development opportunities, reach the decision makers, and learn how to determine whether the economics make sense.



What You Will Do

• Search for on-market and off-market development opportunities throughout targeted Chicago neighborhoods.

• Identify vacant land, parking lots, underutilized commercial properties, redevelopment sites, distressed buildings, and properties with substantially more development potential than their existing use.

• Research property ownership and find the actual decision maker, including phone numbers,
s, mailing addresses, related entities, debt information, tax information, and other useful data.

• Conduct targeted phone,
, and direct-mail outreach to owners on behalf of a real estate developer.

• Track follow-ups persistently and professionally.

• Research Chicago zoning and calculate lot area, FAR, buildable area, approximate unit potential, parking, ARO/TOD considerations, and potential rezoning scenarios.

• Screen deals using land cost per unit, location, zoning, physical feasibility, achievable rents, and development economics.

• Use our underwriting model to analyze rents, NOI, development cost, financing, yield on cost, refinance proceeds, and cash recycling.

• Maintain a clean CRM/pipeline of every property, owner interaction, next action, and underwriting result.

• Identify smaller deals that may be appropriate to wholesale to other developers.



How You Will Spend Your Time

This is a full-time, eight-hour-per-day role. When there are real deals to analyze, you will analyze them. When there are not, you will source. There should always be another productive action: research a property, find an owner, send an
, make a targeted call, follow up, review zoning, research debt/taxes, or improve the pipeline.



What We Are Looking For

• Excellent analytical ability and comfort with numbers.

• Strong internet research skills and persistence in finding hard-to-locate information.

• Ability to learn complicated rules and apply them to real situations.

• Strong written and spoken English.

• Comfort speaking with property owners by phone and
.

• Organized, detail-oriented, and disciplined about follow-up.

• Independent problem solver who does not stop when the first search fails.

• Comfort with spreadsheets and willingness to learn real estate underwriting.

• Good judgment: you should be able to understand that a cheap property is not always a good deal and an expensive property is not always a bad deal.



Helpful but Not Required

• Real estate, finance, underwriting, brokerage, property research, or acquisitions experience.

• Experience with zoning, GIS/maps, property databases, skip tracing, CRM systems, or cold outreach.

• Experience analyzing multifamily, land, or development deals.



What Success Looks Like

• You progressively learn to look at an address and recognize whether it deserves attention.

• You bring ownership qualified opportunities instead of simply sending random listings.

• You know when a property should be rejected, followed up, wholesaled, fully underwritten, or escalated immediately.

• Your pipeline stays active because every viable owner is followed up until there is a definitive answer.

• Over time, you require less direction because you learn how we think about location, zoning, price, unit potential, rents, and development returns.

description:
# SEO Specialist / Customer Success Manager



**Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST**



## About the Role



HeyPearl is looking for an experienced **SEO Specialist / Customer Success Manager (SEO/CSM)** to manage and improve the organic and local search performance of our clients, primarily real estate professionals in the United States.



This is **not a purely back-end SEO role**.



You will be responsible for executing SEO strategies, monitoring performance, working inside **GoHighLevel (GHL)**, managing client communication, and helping clients understand their SEO performance, recommendations, and next steps.



We're looking for someone who is **technically strong, organized, proactive, client-focused, and confident communicating with U.S.-based clients.**



You should be able to independently manage SEO tasks, work inside GHL client accounts, identify problems and opportunities, prioritize recommendations, and clearly communicate results to clients.



---



# NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



**Please do not apply if you cannot meet these requirements.**



### Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST

You must have **intermediate to advanced, hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL).**



**Beginner-level GHL experience is not sufficient for this role.**



You must be comfortable navigating and working independently inside GHL client accounts, including websites, funnels, CRM, pipelines, forms, workflows, automations, and tracking.



---

## GoHighLevel (GHL)

You should be comfortable independently working with:

* Triggers and actions

You do **not** need to be a GHL developer, but you must be able to confidently navigate the platform and complete tasks without requiring basic GHL training.



---



# Client Success & Communication



This is a **client-facing position**, so strong Customer Success experience is highly valuable.



You will:



* Join client meetings and strategy calls

* Present SEO performance and monthly results

* Explain rankings, traffic, leads, and SEO opportunities in plain English

* Recommend next steps based on data

* Answer client SEO questions confidently

* Set realistic expectations around SEO timelines and results

* Proactively identify client needs and opportunities

* Follow up on SEO-related client requests

* Help clients understand the value and impact of SEO

* Coordinate with our internal content, development, and client-success teams

* Maintain clear and professional communication with clients

* Help ensure client issues and requests are properly tracked through completion



You should be comfortable speaking with **U.S.-based clients on Zoom** and communicating professionally through
 and messaging platforms.



---



# Must-Have Qualifications



* **3+ years of hands-on SEO experience**

* Strong Local SEO experience

* Strong technical SEO knowledge

* **Intermediate to advanced GoHighLevel (GHL) experience**

* Experience working directly with clients

* Strong Customer Success, account management, or client-facing experience

* Google Business Profile optimization experience

* Google Search Console

* Google Analytics 4 (GA4)

* WordPress

* Keyword research

* On-page SEO

* Schema markup

* Internal linking and site architecture

* Indexing and crawl troubleshooting

* Strong spoken and written English

* Comfortable presenting reports and recommendations on Zoom

* Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously

* Strong organization and follow-through

* Ability to work independently and take ownership of results

* Ability to prioritize tasks based on urgency and business impact

* **Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST**

* **Ability to attend the daily 8:00 AM CST team huddle**



---



# Preferred / Bonus Experience

* BrightLocal

* Local Falcon

We want someone who can:



**Find the problem → determine the priority → implement or coordinate the solution → measure the result → explain it clearly to the client → follow through until the issue is resolved.**

title: MANUAL QA ANALYST – MOBILE & WEB APPLICATIONS
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are a growing U.S.-based software company seeking a meticulous, experienced Manual QA Analyst to join our product-development team full-time.



You will be embedded in the development workflow. You will review requirements, prepare test coverage, test exact staging and TestFlight builds, report defects in Jira, verify fixes, maintain regression coverage, and provide evidence-based release-readiness recommendations.



This is a manual testing position. You will not be expected to work as a software developer. 



Company and product details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Development workflow and Jira



- Review feature requirements and acceptance criteria before development is completed.

- Identify unclear requirements, missing edge cases, and areas that may be difficult to test.

- Prepare or update manual test cases while features are being developed.

- Pick up work in Jira when a developer moves it to Ready for QA.

- Move assigned work into QA In Progress when testing begins.

- Record all testing against the exact staging URL, TestFlight build, application version, device, and operating-system version used.

- Return failed work to Changes Required with complete supporting evidence.

- Retest fixes when the developer submits a new build.

- Move passing work to Ready for Release with a concise QA summary.

- Keep Jira statuses and defect records current without needing repeated reminders.



Manual mobile and web testing



- Manually test iPhone, iPad, and browser-based application workflows.

- Test complete end-to-end processes that cross between the mobile application and web platform.

- Install and test prerelease iOS/iPadOS builds through TestFlight.

- Perform functional, frontend, usability, exploratory, regression, integration, and release testing.

- Verify screens, buttons, forms, navigation, loading states, permissions, validation, error handling, and responsive layouts.

- Test different account states, user roles, network conditions, permissions, devices, and operating-system versions.

- Look beyond the happy path and actively search for edge cases and unintended behavior.

- Run smoke and regression testing before releases.

- Perform limited post-release verification using authorized test accounts and fictional data.



Bug reporting and verification



Every bug report should include:



- A concise, descriptive title

- The exact build and environment tested

- Device model, browser, and operating-system version

- Preconditions and relevant account state

- Numbered steps to reproduce

- Expected versus actual results

- Frequency or reproducibility

- Severity and likely customer impact

- Screenshots, screen recordings, or other supporting evidence



You will also:



- Distinguish release-blocking defects from minor issues.

- Reproduce and investigate inconsistent problems.

- Verify reported fixes rather than assuming they work.

- Reopen defects that are incomplete or cannot be verified.

- Create separate linked bugs when testing reveals an issue outside the original feature’s scope.

- Maintain regression cases so previously fixed problems do not return.



Release readiness



For each release candidate, provide a clear written result:



- PASS

- PASS WITH KNOWN RISKS

- FAIL

- BLOCKED



The report must identify:



- The exact build tested

- Devices, browsers, and operating systems covered

- Test cases completed

- Tests that failed or could not be completed

- Open defects

- Known limitations

- Remaining release risks

- Your GO/NO-GO recommendation



QA provides the evidence and recommendation. Final merge, deployment, and production decisions remain with the authorized release owner.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



- At least two years of professional manual software QA experience.

- Experience testing both mobile applications and web applications.

- Experience testing complete end-to-end workflows.

- Strong knowledge of functional, regression, exploratory, usability, and release testing.

- Experience using Jira or a similar issue-tracking platform.

- Ability to create organized test plans, test cases, checklists, and release summaries.

- Excellent written English. Bug-report clarity is extremely important.

- Strong spoken English for meetings and defect discussions.

- Excellent attention to detail and analytical judgment.

- Ability to work independently and take ownership of assigned testing.

- Comfortable collaborating with developers, product owners, and customer-support staff.

- Reliable computer, stable high-speed internet, backup internet or power plan, and screen-recording capability.

- Ability to handle confidential information and follow security and test-data procedures.



TESTING-DEVICE PREFERENCE



Preference will be given to applicants who already own an iPhone Pro or iPad Pro with LiDAR capability.



Applicants must state the exact model and current iOS/iPadOS version of every Apple device they can use for testing. Do not provide a serial number or IMEI.



Owning a compatible Pro device is strongly preferred but is not an absolute requirement. A company-owned testing device may be provided to an exceptional candidate after successful completion of the interview, reference-check, and paid-assessment process.



Candidates will never be required to purchase company equipment using their own money.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE



The following experience is helpful but not required:



- TestFlight and prerelease iOS application testing

- SaaS or business-software testing

- Role and permission testing

- File upload, camera, sensor, scanning, or LiDAR-based application testing

- Testing workflows that cross between a mobile application and administrative web portal

- Basic API or application-log inspection

- Working directly with remote U.S. development teams



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 40 hours per week

- Monday through Friday

- Consistent daily schedule

- At least four working hours must overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours

- Exact schedule will be agreed upon before employment begins

- Additional coordination may occasionally be needed during major releases

WHAT WE DO



We make short videos and photos of products — clothes, shoes, bags, home goods. We don't shoot them. We generate them with AI.



This is an example of what we create.





THE JOB



We send you a screenshot of a shot we like, plus photos of the product. You:



- Write the prompt

- Make image versions in Higgsfield

- Pick the best one

- Turn it into a short video

- Send us the finished clips



VOLUME



10 finished videos per day. That means 10 we approve, not 10 tries. Expect to redo shots that come out wrong.



PAY



$300 per month. We pay for the Higgsfield subscription. You just do the work.



YOU NEED



- Good English, spoken and written. Prompts are long and detailed. Sloppy wording gives bad output.

- Experience with Higgsfield or a similar AI image/video tool

- A good eye — you can look at a photo and see why it works

- Patience. Most shots take a few tries.

- Care about detail. If the product doesn't match our photos exactly, we can't use it.

- Steady output, and a heads up if a day will fall short



NICE TO HAVE



- You know what does well on TikTok and Instagram

- Basic photo or video editing









OUR STYLE RULES



We have a set of rules every shot has to follow — how to keep the product accurate, how to frame it, how the motion should work. We'll go over them with you once you're hired.



TO APPLY



Answer these two questions:



1. What tools have you used?

2. What other AI videos have you made? Send examples.



THE TEST



We will provide:



- A reference video — one we made. This shows the style we want: the camera angle, the lighting, how the person moves, how the product is shown.

-  Screenshots of a product — something different from what's in our video.



Your job: make a video of that product in the same style as our reference.



That means:



- Study the reference video first. Look at the angle, the framing, the lighting, and the movement.

- Build an image of the new product in that same setup

- Turn that image into a short video with the same kind of slow movement

- The product must look exactly like the screenshot we sent — same color, material, and details. Do not change it.



Send us the finished video. If you had to try a few times, tell us how many.

title: Financial Controller | UK-based
description:
A CFO overseeing a portfolio of fast-growing, product-based and retail brands across the UK is looking to build up the capability of the finance function properly, not just keep it running as is.



Right now, the CFO handles the bulk of the accounting personally, bookkeeping through to forecasting, across every business in the portfolio. We're hiring a Financial Controller to take full ownership of that function and build it into something stronger, working closely with the CFO throughout rather than inheriting it in isolation.



This is a senior, hands-on role built around real ownership, not a narrow, single-client bookkeeping job. The portfolio is kept deliberately focused, so the role is about doing the work well, not managing volume.



Because the businesses in the portfolio vary in size, sector and complexity, the scope of this role will shift as needs change. You'll need to be comfortable adapting to what each client requires rather than working from a fixed, unchanging list of tasks.



Important



This role isn't suited to someone who wants to keep their head down and do the basics. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of problems from discovery through to resolution, who questions how things are done and pushes for a better way when something doesn't add up, and who can hold a confident, informed conversation with the CFO about the numbers.



This is not a client-facing role. The CFO keeps direct client relationships and calls; your focus is on building and running the finance function itself.



What You'll Be Responsible For



Financial Reporting & Accounting

- Month-end close and management reporting across multiple client accounts

- Maintaining accurate financial records and reconciliations

- Supporting year-end accounting



Inventory & Operational Finance

- Inventory and landed cost accounting

- Retail deductions and operational finance support

- Managing and reconciling large datasets across multiple systems



Forecasting & Analysis

- Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts and cash flow projections

- Investigating and resolving discrepancies and variances independently

- Ad hoc financial and operational analysis



Process & Relationship Ownership

- Improving finance processes and workflows across the portfolio

- Running the day-to-day finance function with minimal oversight

- Bringing issues and improvement ideas to the CFO with confidence, not just waiting to be asked



What We're Looking For

- Genuinely proactive: you notice when something doesn't add up or a process doesn't make sense, and you push to fix it rather than working around it

- Proven experience running a finance function independently, not just contributing to one within a larger team

- Experience managing the finance function across multiple client accounts or entities at once, comfortable prioritising and moving between businesses of different sizes and complexity

- Genuine hands-on experience building management accounts and forecasts from scratch

- Comfortable producing forward-looking analysis and insight, not only reviewing and flagging issues in bookkeeping

- Strong accounting background with real exposure to product-based or inventory-heavy businesses

- Hands-on experience with inventory accounting, landed costs, reconciliations and operational finance workflows

- Experience with Amazon or e-commerce accounting operations and large transaction datasets

- Fluent in tools such as Xero, Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online and BI or reporting platforms

- CPA preferred or other similar certifications

- A confident, articulate communicator who is comfortable pushing back and defending their analysis with sound reasoning

- Naturally investigative, someone who wants to understand a business well enough to question its numbers, not simply record them

- Retail or wholesale accounting experience is a strong advantage



Working Setup

Working Setup

This is a fully remote, full-time position working UK business hours. To be considered for this role, you must have:

- A reliable computer suitable for remote work

- A fast, stable primary internet connection, with a backup option available in case of an outage

- A quiet, professional workspace free from background noise and interruptions

- A good quality headset for clear communication

- A dedicated work environment where you can attend meetings and work without distractions



What Success Looks Like In This Role

Success in this role means leadership can confidently rely on you to own the numbers, reporting, forecasting, and finance operations without needing constant oversight.

title: Senior UI/UX Designer — Streaming Platform Redesign (Web + Mobile App, Figma)
description:
We are a media and personal development company. Our streaming platform hosts documentaries, original series, masterclasses and a podcast around conscious living, health and personal growth. We have thousands of paying members, we are preparing an English-language international launch, and we are rebranding the platform.

Think of us as sitting somewhere between Gaia and Masterclass curated, direct, and built around a real community rather than an endless library.

Our current platform works, but the design does not match the quality of what we put on it. That is what you are here to fix.



The project

A complete redesign of the member-facing experience across three surfaces:

1. Desktop web — the full logged-out and logged-in experience

2. Mobile web — responsive, treated as a first-class surface and not an afterthought

3. Native mobile apps — iOS and Android



The platform runs on a third-party OTT solution. We want ambitious work that our development partner can actually implement. We will give you access to the current product and technical context so you can design against real constraints.

We have an existing brand: fonts, colours, tone of voice and visual direction are set. You are designing within it and sharpening it, not replacing it.

Screens and flows in scope

Logged-out / acquisition:

* Landing and homepage (conversion-focused)

* Plan selection and pricing page for three membership tiers

* Sign-up, onboarding and payment flow

* Free trial entry and conversion moments

* Campaign landing pages driven by
 and paid social

Logged-in / member experience:

* Browse and discover, including hero, rails and carousels

* Category, collection and curated-selection pages

* Title detail pages for films, series and documentaries

* Video player interface and all its states

* Search, filtering and empty states

* Continue watching, watchlist and viewing history

* Masterclass and live session pages, including registration and reminders

* Community section

* Account, profile and subscription management, including upgrade, downgrade and cancellation

App-specific:

* Native navigation patterns for iOS and Android

* Downloads and offline viewing

* Audio-only / podcast mode

* Push notification and permission moments

* Casting to TV

What you will deliver

* High-fidelity UI designs in Figma for every screen and state listed above, in light and dark theme. We will give you guidance in how we want it!

* A design system — components with variants and auto layout, colour and typography tokens, spacing scale, iconography, states and interaction rules, documented so a developer can read it without asking you

* Responsive specifications — breakpoints and behaviour rules for desktop, tablet and mobile web

* Developer handoff documentation — clean, organised, annotated Figma files with naming conventions our development partner can work from

Everything lives in a single well-structured Figma file or project that we own.

How we work

* Weekly review calls, with written async updates in between

* We work in phases. Each phase is approved before the next starts.

* You will get direct access to decision-makers. Feedback is fast, direct and honest. we expect the same from you. If you think a request is wrong, say so.

Requirements

* 3+ years designing consumer-facing digital products, both web and native mobile

* Expert-level Figma — auto layout, components, variants, variables and tokens, prototyping. This is not negotiable; we will look at your file structure, not just your screens.

* A portfolio showing at least a few responsive web products and at least a few native mobile apps you designed end to end

* Genuine understanding of video and OTT interface patterns — content rails, player controls, browse hierarchies, continue watching, metadata density

* Working knowledge of iOS Human Interface Guidelines and Material Design, and the discipline to respect platform conventions rather than copy-pasting one design across both

* Understanding of subscription and conversion design — you know that a pricing page is a commercial instrument, not decoration

* Experience building or maintaining a design system

* Accessibility fundamentals — contrast, focus states, touch targets, WCAG AA awareness

* Comfortable designing inside an existing brand and within platform limitations

* Strong written English and self-directed async communication

* Able to overlap at least 3 hours per day with Central European Time (CET/Amsterdam)

* Reliable internet, your own computer, and a stable working setup

Nice to have

* Experience with streaming, OTT, membership or e-learning products

* Motion and micro-interaction design, Lottie

* Experience designing around white-label or templated platforms and their constraints

* Multi-language interface design (English and Dutch)

* Basic understanding of front-end implementation, enough to know what is cheap and what is expensive to build

How to apply

Start your reply with the word TTS. Applications that do not begin with TTS will not be read. We want to know you actually read this.

Then include:

1. A link to your portfolio. Live Figma files or full case studies tell us far more than image galleries. show us your thinking, not only your pixels.

2. One specific example of a redesign you did where you can explain the problem, your decision and the result.

3. Your answer to this question: which streaming or membership product do you think has the best user experience right now, and what is the single thing it does that most others get wrong?

4. Your rate, your availability per week, and the earliest date you can start.

5. Which time zone you work in and your normal working hours.

Please do not send a generic or AI-written application. We read every reply and we can tell.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a video call and a short paid test assignment. So we can both see how we work together before committing to the full project.

- Create and improve processes, checklists, SOPs, and documentation



Preferred Experience & Skills



- Previous management, supervisory, team-lead, operations, or project-management experience

- Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills

- Engineering, computer science, information technology, mathematics, statistics, data analysis, or similar technical background

- Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

- Experience supporting an Amazon or e-commerce business

- Experience with Canva, photo editing, or video editing

- Experience creating SOPs, checklists, processes, and quality-control systems

- Ability to communicate clearly, respectfully, and professionally

- Self-starter who takes initiative and thinks ahead

- Engineering degree or professional engineering experience

- Computer science, programming, or IT experience

- Data analytics or business intelligence experience

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets experience

- SQL, Python, scripting, Google Apps Script, or similar technical skills

- Workflow automation experience

- Experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools for business applications

- Amazon PPC campaign management experience

- Amazon FBA inventory management

description:

We are looking for a reliable and proactive Full Stack and Mobile Developer to join our team on a long term basis. The position can be part time or full time, but in both cases we expect strong commitment, consistent availability and genuine ownership of the work.

You will contribute to websites, web applications, mobile applications, internal tools, dashboards, API integrations and AI powered features. You will often receive a business objective, design, concept or existing prototype and be responsible for turning it into a reliable, maintainable solution.

This is not a short term freelance project. We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of our team and grow with the agency.



Your responsibilities

Build and maintain frontend, backend and mobile features.

Develop responsive web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, React and Next.js.

Develop and maintain mobile applications using React Native, Flutter or native technologies.

Build backend functionality using Node.js and/or Python.

Translate designs, prototypes and business concepts into production ready solutions.

Integrate third party APIs, databases, webhooks and external platforms.

Design logical data flows between frontend applications, backend systems, databases and external services.

Build AI powered features and automations using Claude, ChatGPT and related APIs.

Work with Claude Code, Cursor or comparable AI assisted development tools.

Improve prototype and AI generated code before it is used in production.

Debug technical issues and take responsibility for the reliability of what you deliver.

Write clean, tested and maintainable code.

Use Git and GitHub professionally and contribute to code reviews.

Communicate progress, challenges and technical decisions clearly.

At least 2 years of professional experience in full stack development.

Strong JavaScript and TypeScript skills.

Professional experience with React and preferably Next.js.

Professional mobile development experience with React Native, Flutter or native technologies.

Backend development experience with Node.js and/or Python.

Experience integrating REST APIs, JSON, webhooks and third party services.

Good understanding of databases, data modelling and SQL.

Ability to connect frontend, backend, mobile applications, databases and external platforms.

Experience with Git, GitHub and modern deployment workflows.

Hands on experience building AI features, agents, integrations or automations using Claude, ChatGPT or similar APIs.

Strong debugging, logical thinking and problem solving skills.

Ability to work confidently within existing codebases.

Communicates clearly and professionally.

Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar development tools.

Vercel and cloud deployment.

n8n, Make, Zapier or similar automation platforms.

Figma and a basic understanding of UX and responsive design.

Whether you are applying for a part time or full time position.

Your GitHub profile, portfolio or examples of relevant work.

title: Head of Operations – Dubai Holiday Homes
description:
Head of Operations – Dubai Holiday Homes



Location: Dubai, UAE

Employment Type: Full-Time

Industry: Holiday Homes / Short-Term Rentals



We are looking for an experienced Head of Operations to take full responsibility for the day-to-day operations of our Dubai holiday-home business.



This is a senior, hands-on operational role for someone who has already worked in Dubai's holiday-home industry and understands what it takes to run a short-term rental portfolio in practice.



We are not looking for a VA, assistant, coordinator or someone who simply follows instructions.



We are looking for someone who can take over the operational function, manage the people and resources available to them, make decisions independently, solve problems and continuously improve the way the business operates.



The ideal candidate should be able to take the operation and say:



"I'll handle it."



About the Role



You will be responsible for the complete operational side of the business.



This means overseeing everything required to keep our properties running smoothly and ensuring that guests receive a good experience.



You will work with our existing on-ground team, cleaners, technicians, managers and vendors, but you will also be expected to build additional resources whenever required.



You will have the authority to make routine operational decisions and will be expected to use good judgment rather than waiting for approval for every small matter.



The owner should not have to become involved in routine operational problems.



If something needs to be done, you are expected to make sure it gets done.



Your Responsibilities

1. Overall Operations



You will have overall responsibility for the operational performance of the portfolio.



This includes:



Managing the day-to-day operation of all properties

Making sure properties are ready for every check-in

Managing check-outs and turnovers

Coordinating cleaners and maintenance

Managing the on-ground team

Monitoring operational issues across properties

Following up on outstanding tasks

Handling urgent situations

Managing vendors and contractors

Ensuring operational standards are maintained

Identifying problems before they become major issues

Improving operational processes and procedures



You should have a clear understanding at any given time of:



What needs to be done, who is doing it, when it will be completed and whether it has actually been completed properly.



2. Housekeeping & Cleaning



You will take responsibility for the housekeeping operation.



This includes:



Scheduling cleaners according to check-ins and check-outs

Ensuring every property is cleaned on time

Checking cleaning quality

Handling cleaning complaints

Organizing deep cleaning

Managing cleaner performance

Building a reliable pool of backup cleaners

Managing linen and towel requirements

Coordinating laundry

Ensuring cleaning supplies are available

Conducting quality-control checks

Replacing cleaners who consistently underperform



If we suddenly have more bookings and don't have enough cleaners, you are expected to solve the problem.



For example, you may need to:



Search Dubai cleaning groups on

Contact individual cleaners

Speak to cleaning companies

Interview or screen cleaners

Negotiate rates

Arrange trial cleanings

Build a backup pool



You should not simply tell management:



"We don't have enough cleaners."



You should come back with:



"I've found three additional cleaners and arranged their trial shifts."



3. Maintenance & Repairs



You will oversee the entire maintenance function.



This includes:



AC issues

Plumbing

Electrical problems

Appliances

TVs and electronics

Internet/Wi-Fi issues

Furniture

Locks and access systems

Painting

General handyman work

Emergency repairs

Preventive maintenance



We have in-house technical resources, but you are not limited to them.



If our technician cannot solve a problem, you are expected to find someone who can.



For example, if an in-house technician cannot repair a television:



You should be able to identify the problem, search for suitable Dubai vendors, contact them, compare availability and pricing, arrange the repair and follow up until the issue is resolved.



The same applies to any other specialist service.



If we don't currently have a suitable vendor, you find one.



4. Building & Managing Vendors



A strong Operations Head should continuously build a reliable network of vendors.



You will be expected to develop relationships with vendors for services such as:



AC specialists

Plumbers

Electricians

TV/electronics repair

Appliance repair

Locksmiths

Pest control

Painters

Handymen

Furniture repair

Cleaning companies

Laundry companies

Emergency contractors

Other specialist services



You can source vendors through:



Google

 groups

Local business networks

Recommendations

Existing contacts

Vendor referrals

Other suitable channels



You should also maintain information about reliable vendors, pricing, response times and quality.



If a vendor repeatedly performs poorly, replace them.



5. Guest Support & Escalations



You will not be expected to personally answer every routine guest message.



However, when a guest has a serious or complicated operational issue, you are expected to take ownership.



This may involve calling the guest directly.



Examples include:



Guest cannot access the property

AC has stopped working

Property has a serious maintenance problem

Cleaning was not completed properly

Guest is missing an essential item

Guest has an urgent complaint

A technician needs to be sent immediately

A problem is not being resolved by the normal team



You should be comfortable speaking directly with guests, understanding the problem, coordinating the appropriate resources and following the issue through to resolution.



The objective is not simply to respond to the guest.



The objective is to solve the problem.



6. On-Ground Team Management



You will manage and coordinate the operational resources available to the business.



This may include:



Cleaners

Technicians

Property managers

Inspectors

Maintenance staff

Laundry resources

External contractors

Other support staff



You will be responsible for d
 how resources are deployed.



For example:



A property has a maintenance issue at 12 PM and another property has a turnover at 1 PM.



You should be able to assess the situation, d
 which resource should go where, arrange the required support and make sure both issues are handled.



You should not need management to coordinate every operational movement.



7. Procurement & Operational Purchases



You will be responsible for ensuring the business has the supplies and equipment it needs.



This can include:



Cleaning supplies

Towels

Bed linen

Toiletries

Kitchen supplies

Maintenance materials

Replacement items

Small appliances

Property consumables

Other operational requirements



You will have access to company resources for legitimate operational purchases, subject to company policies and accounting procedures.



If you notice that stock is running low, you should order it before it becomes an emergency.



We want someone who thinks ahead rather than waiting until something is completely finished.



8. Property Inspections & Quality Control



You will be responsible for maintaining standards across the portfolio.



This includes ensuring:



Properties are properly cleaned

Furniture is in good condition

Appliances are working

AC is functioning properly

Bathrooms and kitchens are maintained

Linen is available and in good condition

Consumables are stocked

Maintenance issues are identified

Properties are ready before guest arrival



You should establish proper inspection and quality-control procedures rather than relying entirely on guest complaints to discover problems.



9. Preventive Maintenance



We don't want an operation where we only repair things after guests complain.



You will be expected to identify recurring problems and introduce preventive measures.



For example:



If an AC repeatedly develops an issue, you should investigate why.



If the same appliance repeatedly fails, you should determine whether it needs replacement.



If a particular property consistently has plumbing issues, you should investigate the underlying cause.



The goal is to reduce recurring problems and emergency call-outs.



10. Recruitment & Building the Team



As the business grows, you will be responsible for identifying operational staffing requirements.



If we need more:



Cleaners

Technicians

Handymen

Inspectors

Property staff

Other operational resources



you should be capable of finding and screening suitable people.



You may use
 groups, referrals, recruitment platforms, agencies, local networks and other appropriate channels.



You will also be expected to identify underperforming staff and make recommendations regarding replacement, training or restructuring.



11. SOPs & Operational Systems



You will be expected to improve the way the company operates.



This includes developing and maintaining SOPs for areas such as:



Check-in preparation

Check-out procedures

Cleaning

Inspections

Maintenance

Emergency situations

Guest complaints

Inventory

Laundry

Vendor management

Staff responsibilities

Property readiness



If a process repeatedly creates problems, you should identify the reason and improve the process.



The Type of Person We Want



We are looking for someone who is:



Proactive

Independent

Practical

Decisive

Resourceful

Organized

Comfortable managing people

Comfortable dealing with vendors

Comfortable speaking with guests

Good under pressure

Good at prioritizing

Strong at follow-up

Comfortable making decisions

Focused on solving problems



Most importantly, you must take ownership.



If you don't know how to solve something, you find someone who does.



If we don't have a vendor, you find one.



If we don't have enough cleaners, you recruit them.



If the existing technician cannot solve the issue, you find a specialist.



If a guest has a problem, you make sure it gets resolved.



Mandatory Experience

Dubai holiday-home experience is required.



You must have previously worked for a Dubai holiday-home / short-term rental company in a senior operations position.



We are specifically looking for someone who has previously held a position such as:



Head of Operations

Operations Head

Senior Operations Manager



within a holiday-home company.



You should already understand the practical realities of operating holiday homes in Dubai.



Experience managing properties listed on Airbnb, 
 and other short-term rental platforms is highly relevant.



Candidates without previous senior Dubai holiday-home operations experience will not be considered.



General hotel experience alone is not sufficient.



General office-management experience is not sufficient.



Long-term property management experience alone is not sufficient.



This Is NOT a VA / Assistant Position



We want to be very clear about this.



You will not be sitting around waiting for management to send you a list of tasks.



You will be expected to create your own priorities based on what is happening in the operation.



If you see something that needs to be done, you should deal with it.



If you see a recurring problem, you should fix the process.



If you see that the team is short-staffed, you should address it.



If you see that a vendor is unreliable, you should find an alternative.



If you see that something can be done more efficiently, you should improve it.



We are hiring someone to run operations, not someone to assist the person running operations.

Compensation



Salary: Competitive and based on experience.



The final package will depend on your previous Dubai holiday-home experience, portfolio size managed, team size managed and overall operational responsibility.



Application Process



We are keeping the application process simple.



1. Send us a private message



If you are interested, simply contact us privately and state that you are applying for the Head of Operations position.



2. We will send you a private interview link



You will receive a link to complete our initial interview.



3. Complete the interview



The interview will focus heavily on real-world operational situations and your previous experience.



We want to understand how you actually handle problems, people, vendors, guests and day-to-day operations.



4. Selection



Candidates will be assessed based on their experience, operational knowledge, judgment, leadership, problem-solving and ability to independently run a Dubai holiday-home operation.



If you have genuinely run operations for a Dubai holiday-home company and believe you can take complete ownership of the role, send us a private message to receive the interview link.
