You will also assist with as-built documentation and produce clean, professional markups for owner and GC submissions.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or a closely related field. At least three years of professional experience in civil, structural, or construction engineering. Strong proficiency in AutoCAD; Revit and Bluebeam Revu experience strongly preferred. Comfortable reading commercial construction drawings and specifications across architectural, structural, and MEP disciplines. Solid understanding of takeoff methods and construction means and methods. Excellent written and spoken English — you will be communicating directly with US-based staff and occasionally with clients. Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work environment, and a computer capable of running CAD software smoothly.



Nice to Have

Experience with US building codes (IBC, IRC) and ASCE 7. Familiarity with roofing systems (TPO, EPDM, modified bitumen), flooring assemblies, or solar PV layouts. Experience with PlanSwift, RoofSnap, or similar takeoff tools. Prior experience working with American contractors or design-build firms.



What We Offer

Competitive pay benchmarked to your skill level and experience, with raises tied to performance. Long-term, stable work — we are looking to build a relationship, not fill a one-off project. Paid time off after probation. Christmas bonus (13th month equivalent). Direct mentorship from experienced US-based PMs and estimators. Flexible schedule once you're up to speed.



How to Apply

Please send (1) your updated CV, (2) a portfolio or 2–3 sample drawings you have personally produced (PDF preferred), (3) a brief paragraph describing your most challenging project and your specific role on it, and (4) your expected monthly salary in USD.



In the subject line of your application, please write "Civil Engineer – [Your Name]" so we know you read the full posting. Applications without a portfolio sample will not be reviewed.



We look forward to meeting you.

title: Shopify Junior Manager
description:
Shopify Store Localization Specialist & Web Designer



Full-Time Remote | $500 USD/Month Starting Salary | Fox Ecom LLC



About Us



Fox Ecom LLC is a US company growing an international e-commerce business in men’s hair care. Our brand, Depura, launched in Italy, and we are now expanding into markets worldwide.



We are looking for someone who can transform our existing Shopify store into a fully localized, launch-ready store for each new market. You will handle translation, visual assets, design adjustments, store configuration, app setup, testing, and final quality checks.



This position starts at junior-level compensation, with the opportunity to progress into a senior role over the coming months based on your performance, independence, and ability to take on greater responsibility.



Your Main Responsibility



Complete one fully localized, launch-ready Shopify store per working day, using our existing store, established design, and supplied assets as your starting point.



You will deliver a finished store that does not require our executives or another team member to complete the setup, correct avoidable mistakes, or finish outstanding work.



What You Will Do



1. Translate and Localize the Entire Store



Translate product descriptions, headlines, buttons, banners, FAQs, announcements, forms, and all other customer-facing content.

Use DeepL, supported by AI tools and careful proofreading, to produce natural translations that preserve the original meaning and marketing message.

Maintain consistent terminology, product names, tone, formatting, and brand identity.

Localize customer
s, order notifications, and app-generated content, checking the complete shopping journey for untranslated text.



2. Translate and Adapt Images Using AI



Use AI image-generation and editing tools to localize infographics, promotional graphics, badges, product packaging text, and other visual assets.

Preserve the original composition, colors, branding, product appearance, and design quality.

Ensure translated text is accurate, sharp, readable, and correctly positioned, including text on bottles and packaging.

Correct distorted letters, visual artifacts, and layout problems. Prepare images in suitable dimensions and formats, balancing quality with loading speed.



3. Configure Shopify for Each Market



Set up and verify products, collections, variants, pricing, currencies, product handles, and internal links.

Configure markets, languages, domains, shipping zones, shipping rates, delivery information, payment methods, and checkout settings.

Apply company-provided requirements for taxes, duties, and other market-specific settings.

Build and check navigation menus, footer links, contact pages, and customer support details.

Adapt shipping, returns, refunds, privacy, terms, and guarantee pages using approved company policies and business information.

Localize page titles, meta descriptions, and image alt text where applicable.



4. Configure and Localize Shopify Apps



Kaching: Configure bundles, quantity discounts, and promotional offers. Translate customer-facing text and verify product selection, pricing, and discount behavior across product pages, the cart, and checkout.

Track123: Configure and localize the order-tracking page, tracking messages, and available notifications. Add tracking links to navigation and the footer, and test the customer experience.


: Configure and localize review widgets, star-rating badges, review forms, and review-request
s. Translate reviews faithfully, prepare and validate import CSVs, map reviews to the correct destination-store products, and resolve import or display errors.

Other apps: Configure and localize any additional tools used for upsells, cart functionality,
 marketing, customer support, or other store features.

Check app integrations, language, currency display, and appearance on desktop and mobile. Identify required subscriptions or access early.



5. Test and Deliver the Finished Store



Review the entire store on desktop and mobile, checking typography, spacing, image quality, and responsive behavior.

Test menus, links, product options, variants, add-to-cart, bundles, discounts, shipping calculations, tracking, and checkout.

Verify payment configuration and complete a test purchase using the appropriate test setup.

Submit a concise handover with the store link, completed checks, and any outstanding issues.

What “Completed” Means



A store is complete when all required content and images are localized, Shopify settings are correct, required apps are configured, and the shopping journey has been tested successfully. There should be no unfinished sections, broken links, incorrect product associations, or unresolved issues that prevent launch.



You must identify missing information or access early, clearly request what you need, and follow each issue through to resolution. We expect independent execution without constant reminders or supervision.



Salary, Schedule and Daily Target



Starting salary: $500 USD per month. Schedule: eight scheduled working hours per day, five days per week. Daily target: one completed, quality-checked Shopify store.



Once your assigned store meets all completion criteria and you submit your handover, you may finish your working day, even if you have worked fewer than eight hours.



If you anticipate missing the deadline, notify management before the end of your scheduled working hours. Explain the blocker, what remains, and your estimated completion time. A short extension can be agreed where necessary. Finishing early is welcome, provided the required quality standard is met.



Required Experience and Skills

At least one year of hands-on experience building, managing, or localizing Shopify stores.

Strong working knowledge of Shopify themes, products, markets, languages, shipping, navigation, policies, payments, and checkout.

Practical experience with DeepL and AI tools, particularly translation, image generation, and image editing.

Experience configuring Kaching, Track123, 
, or comparable Shopify apps, including troubleshooting integrations and review imports.

A good eye for web design, typography, visual consistency, and mobile usability.

Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and basic Liquid sufficient to resolve common theme and layout issues.

Clear written English, reliable internet, a suitable computer, and the ability to manage your workload independently.

Attitude and Growth



We want someone open-minded, motivated to grow, and willing to discuss ideas, ask questions, and accept constructive feedback. You should enjoy learning new tools, improving your workflow, and taking ownership of results.



Complete transparency is essential. Report mistakes, delays, uncertainties, and blockers promptly. Never hide an issue or mark incomplete work as finished. Be clear about what you have completed, what you have checked, and what still needs attention.



As you demonstrate reliable execution and stronger technical skills, you may progress into a senior role helping manage Depura’s Shopify stores worldwide. Future responsibilities may include overseeing multiple stores, improving our localization processes, and helping coordinate additional team members.



How to Apply



Send your application via WhatsApp to 
.



Your first message must begin with “Depura Global” to confirm that you have read the entire job posting.



Please include:



A brief introduction and a summary of your relevant Shopify experience.

Links to two or three stores you have worked on, explaining your exact responsibilities.

Examples of translated store pages or localized images you have created.

The AI and translation tools you use, including your experience with DeepL, Kaching, Track123, and 
.

A short explanation of how you would prepare an existing Italian Shopify store for a new country.

Your availability, time zone, and confirmation that you understand the $500 USD starting monthly salary, work schedule, and daily delivery target.

title: Recruitment Resourcer / Candidate Sourcing Specialist
description:
We are a fast-growing UK recruitment and technology business looking for a motivated Recruitment Resourcer to join our team.



Your main responsibility will be supporting the candidate side of our recruitment process — sourcing, screening and managing candidates against live vacancies. This is not a phone-based role; you won't be making or taking calls, the focus is on research, sourcing and keeping our systems accurate and up to date.



This is a fast-paced role where you will work closely with our recruitment team to build strong, high-quality candidate pipelines.



What You'll Be Doing



Sourcing candidates on LinkedIn Recruiter and job boards against live vacancies

Screening CVs and shortlisting candidates against role criteria

Managing candidate pipelines and keeping our CRM fully up to date

Posting and managing job adverts across our job board accounts

Following up with candidates to keep pipelines moving

Adding new candidates and accurate information to our database

Working closely with the wider recruitment team to build a strong pipeline of quality candidates

Continuously looking for ways to improve the quality of our sourcing and shortlisting

Working towards clear individual and team targets



What We're Looking For



Excellent written English is essential. You will be communicating with candidates directly and keeping records our UK team relies on, so your written communication must be professional, natural and accurate.



We are looking for someone who is:



Proactive, motivated and hard-working

Confident using LinkedIn Recruiter and online job boards

Comfortable working towards daily and weekly targets

Extremely organised with strong attention to detail

Able to work independently and use initiative

Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

A positive team player who wants to contribute to the growth of the business



Previous experience in recruitment, resourcing or candidate sourcing is essential for this role — please only apply if you have hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter and/or online job boards.



About the Role



This is not simply a data-entry position. We want someone who can understand what makes a strong candidate for a role and use their own initiative when sourcing and screening.



For example, you might spot that a candidate's experience is a strong match for a live vacancy even though their CV doesn't use the exact same wording, and know to shortlist them and explain why. You will receive full training on our systems and processes, but over time we want you to develop your own judgement and become excellent at identifying high-quality candidates.



Why Join Us?



You will be joining a friendly and ambitious UK team where your work directly contributes to the growth of the company.



We work hard, move quickly and enjoy setting ambitious targets. You'll have plenty of support, but you'll also be encouraged to bring your own ideas, improve how we work and take ownership of your results.



There is plenty of opportunity to develop your skills in recruitment, sourcing and candidate management as the company continues to grow.



SKILL REQUIREMENT: Recruiting, Sourcing, LinkedIn Recruiter, CRM, Candidate Screening

title: Shopify Ecommerce Inventory & Merchandising Specialist
description:
Full-Time | Remote | US$280 per Week | Australian Business Hours



We’re hiring an experienced Shopify Ecommerce Inventory & Merchandising Specialist to support the Australian and New Zealand ecommerce operations of a leading global headwear and lifestyle brand.



This is a hands-on ecommerce operations role for someone who is equally comfortable working with Shopify, inventory data, Excel and product merchandising as they are communicating clearly with a remote team.



We are specifically looking for someone who can:



- Investigate inventory discrepancies rather than simply report them

- Work confidently with large product and stock datasets

- Maintain accurate Shopify product and merchandising information

- Identify stock risks before they become customer or operational issues

- Communicate problems, findings and next steps clearly

- Take ownership of issues and follow them through to resolution



This is not a customer service role, general virtual assistant position or basic Shopify data-entry role.



You’ll report to the Head of Digital AU & NZ and collaborate closely with Ecommerce, Planning, Marketing and Operations.



Compensation and Schedule

Pay: US$280 per week

Payment: Weekly

Hours: 40 hours per week

Schedule: Monday to Friday, aligned with Australian business hours

Location: Fully remote

Engagement: Full-time, long-term opportunity



The advertised rate is fixed. Please only apply if you are comfortable with the compensation and schedule.



Key Responsibilities

Ecommerce Inventory Management

- You will be expected to work directly with inventory data and help maintain accurate stock information across the ecommerce business.



Responsibilities include:

- Maintain and monitor accurate stock-on-hand information in Shopify

- Assist with inventory reconciliation between Shopify and SAP

- Investigate discrepancies between systems and identify the likely cause

- Monitor sell-through, weeks of cover, aged stock, out-of-stocks and overstock risks

- Maintain recurring inventory health and exception reports

- Support replenishment and back-in-stock processes

- Identify unusual stock movements or data inconsistencies

- Escalate inventory risks clearly and early

- Follow inventory issues through until they are resolved



We need someone who can look at inventory data, recognise when something does not make sense, investigate why, and communicate what needs to happen next.



Shopify Product Management

- Create, enrich and maintain Shopify product listings

- Maintain descriptions, imagery, specifications, tags, metafields and categorisation

- Assign products to the correct collections

- Maintain accurate filters, navigation and collection structures

- Conduct regular checks for missing, incorrect or outdated product information

- Troubleshoot product-data and website-display issues

- Support new product launches, seasonal updates and promotional activity

- Ensure product information remains accurate as inventory and ranges change



Reporting and Analysis

- Produce recurring inventory and merchandising reports

- Report on stock on hand, out-of-stocks, aged inventory and sell-through

- Support weekly and monthly ecommerce trading reports

- Analyse large datasets and identify exceptions or unusual results

- Highlight stock risks, opportunities and data-quality issues

- Turn raw data into clear and practical recommendations

- Help improve or automate recurring Shopify and SAP reports



Site Merchandising

- Manage Shopify collections and product sequencing

- Maintain collection sorting based on stock availability and trading priorities

- Identify and fix broken collections, incorrect links and miscategorised products

- Ensure unavailable or low-stock products are appropriately merchandised

- Support basic website updates where required



A dedicated local team member manages most content execution, so advanced graphic design or content-production experience is not required.



Essential Experience



To be considered, you must have demonstrated experience in both Shopify ecommerce operations and inventory management.



You must have:

- Strong, hands-on Shopify administration experience

- Practical ecommerce inventory or stock-management experience

- Experience investigating and resolving inventory discrepancies

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Confidence working with large product and inventory datasets

- Experience creating, enriching and maintaining ecommerce product listings

- Experience with Shopify collections, tags, metafields and product categorisation

- Understanding of stock availability, sell-through, out-of-stocks and inventory health

- Strong written and spoken English

- Excellent attention to detail

- Strong problem-solving skills

- Full-time availability during Australian business hours



Customer service experience alone will not be sufficient for this position.



Excel Skills

You should be comfortable using Excel or Google Sheets for inventory analysis rather than basic data entry.

We are particularly interested in candidates who regularly use tools such as:

- XLOOKUP or VLOOKUP

- INDEX/MATCH

- SUMIFS and COUNTIFS

- IF statements

- PivotTables

- Filters and sorting

- Conditional formatting

- Data cleaning and reconciliation

- Large CSV or product-data exports

- SAP / ERP Experience



SAP experience is highly regarded but is not mandatory.



Strong Shopify and inventory capability is more important. The successful candidate can be trained in the company's SAP processes.



Experience with another ERP, inventory-management or warehouse system is also valuable.



Highly Regarded

- Fashion, apparel, footwear, accessories or lifestyle-brand experience

- Multi-channel ecommerce inventory experience

- Shopify Plus experience

- Advanced Shopify metafields

- ERP or inventory-management systems

- Reporting automation

- Power BI or other data-visualisation tools

- Ecommerce trading or merchandising experience

- Product launches and promotional trading support

- The Working Style We Need



Technical skills alone will not be enough for this role.



Because this is a remote position, you must be a clear, proactive and dependable communicator.



We are looking for someone who:

- Gives clear and concise updates

- Raises problems early rather than waiting to be asked

- Explains what they found when investigating an issue

- Confirms next steps and follows through

- Asks sensible questions when information is unclear

- Works methodically and consistently

- Takes accountability for their work

- Can manage recurring responsibilities without constant reminders

- Communicates professionally with different teams



If you discover an inventory discrepancy, we do not want someone who simply reports that the numbers do not match.



We want someone who will investigate the issue, explain what they checked, identify the likely cause, recommend the next action and follow it through to resolution.



What Success Looks Like



Within your first three months, you should be able to:

- Establish a reliable inventory-monitoring routine

- Independently investigate common inventory discrepancies

- Maintain consistently accurate Shopify product information

- Deliver inventory and merchandising reports correctly and on time

- Identify and communicate stock risks before they become larger issues

- Execute product launches and merchandising updates accurately

- Provide clear updates without requiring repeated follow-up

- Build trust with the team through accuracy, communication and ownership



How to Apply



Applications that do not complete all screening questions will not be considered.



Please answer the following:



1. Please attach your most updated CV.



2. Tell us about your hands-on Shopify experience.

What Shopify tasks have you personally managed, particularly across product listings, collections, tags, metafields, merchandising and inventory?



3. Describe one specific inventory discrepancy you personally identified and resolved.

What was the issue, how did you identify it, what did you investigate, what caused it, and how did you resolve it?



4. What inventory reporting and analysis have you personally handled?

Please include the inventory metrics you have worked with (such as stock on hand, sell-through, weeks of cover, aged stock, out-of-stocks or overstock) and the Excel/Google Sheets formulas or tools you regularly use.



5. Scenario: You discover that the stock quantity in Shopify does not match the ERP or inventory report. Talk us through exactly what you would do from the moment you identify the discrepancy until it is resolved. How and when would you communicate the issue to your manager or team?



Please also confirm in your application that you are available to work 40 hours per week during Australian business hours and are comfortable with the fixed rate of US$280 per week, paid weekly.



Applications with incomplete or generic answers will not progress to the next stage.

title: Graphic & Multimedia Designer
description:
*About the Role 



We are looking for a talented and versatile Graphic & Multimedia Designer to join our creative team and support the visual needs of a growing digital marketing and web agency. 



This role is ideal for a creative professional who is confident in both graphic design and video editing and understands how strong visual content supports branding, advertising, social media, websites, and overall marketing performance. 



The right candidate should have strong design fundamentals, excellent visual judgment, and hands-on experience creating professional graphics, branded content, social media assets, digital advertisements, short-form videos, promotional videos, and other multimedia materials. 



You should be comfortable working across multiple brands and industries, adapting to different visual styles, following brand guidelines, and producing polished work that is both creative and effective. 



AI tools may be used as part of a modern workflow for brainstorming, research, ideation, or productivity support. However, this role requires genuine design ability, strong creative judgment, originality, and confidence using professional creative software. 



*Key Responsibilities 



Create high-quality visual assets for websites, landing pages, social media, paid advertising,
 campaigns, presentations, and print materials. 



Design graphics for Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram content, Google Display ads, website banners, blog graphics, thumbnails, flyers, brochures, and other marketing collateral. 



Edit and produce short-form and promotional video content for social media, digital ads, websites, and marketing campaigns. 



Create engaging video content for platforms such as Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and other digital channels. 



Edit raw video footage into polished, brand-aligned content. 



Add transitions, text overlays, subtitles, captions, music, sound effects, branded elements, and basic motion graphics to video content. 



Resize and reformat videos and graphics for different platforms, placements, screen sizes, and aspect ratios. 



Develop and support brand identity systems, including logos, color palettes, typography selections, visual styles, and brand guidelines. 



Translate creative briefs, campaign goals, and business objectives into visually effective concepts. 



Collaborate with marketing, content, social media, and web development teams to create visuals that support campaign objectives. 



Create original design assets and layouts rather than relying only on templates. 



Maintain consistency across visual assets for different clients and brands. 



Prepare production-ready files for both digital and print use. 



Maintain organized design and video project files using proper naming, storage, and version-control practices. 



Review feedback and make revisions efficiently while maintaining high creative standards. 



Manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced agency environment. 



Stay current with graphic design trends, video editing styles, social media creative formats, paid advertising standards, and evolving multimedia tools. 



*Required Qualifications 



Proven experience as a Graphic Designer, Multimedia Designer, Visual Designer, Video Editor, or in a similar creative role. 



Strong portfolio demonstrating professional work across graphic design, branding, digital marketing, social media, advertising, and video editing. 



Strong understanding of design fundamentals, including: 



-Layout 

-Visual hierarchy 

-Typography 

-Color theory 

-Composition 

-Spacing 

-Brand consistency 

-Visual storytelling 



Strong understanding of video editing fundamentals, including: 



-Pacing 

-Story flow 

-Transitions 

-Audio balance 

-Captions and text overlays 

-Basic color correction 

-Video formatting for social platforms 



Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly: 



-Adobe Photoshop 

-Adobe Illustrator 

-Adobe InDesign 



Experience with at least one professional video editing platform, such as: 



Adobe Premiere Pro 

Adobe After Effects 

CapCut 

DaVinci Resolve 

Final Cut Pro 

Similar video editing software 



-Ability to create original visual concepts and assets from scratch. 

-Experience designing for digital marketing campaigns, including Meta/Facebook ads, Instagram graphics, Google Display ads, social media content, and website imagery. 

-Experience editing short-form video content for social media and digital advertising. 

-Ability to follow brand guidelines while adapting creatively across multiple clients and industries. 

-Strong attention to detail and ability to produce polished, client-ready work. 

-Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines efficiently. 

-Strong communication and collaboration skills. 

-Ability to receive and apply creative feedback professionally. 



*Preferred Qualifications 



-Experience working in a digital marketing agency, web agency, advertising agency, or creative agency. 

-Experience with Canva for creating editable templates and client-facing assets. 

-Experience with Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar collaborative design tools. 

-Basic understanding of website design, responsive layouts, and UX/UI best practices. 

-Experience developing complete brand identity packages and visual systems. 

-Experience creating social media ad campaigns and landing page graphics. 

-Experience producing video advertisements and promotional videos. 

-Experience with motion graphics and basic animation. 

-Familiarity with Adobe After Effects is a strong plus. 

-Experience adding subtitles, captions, lower thirds, animated text, and branded motion elements. 

-Basic understanding of audio editing and sound selection. 

-Experience creating thumbnails and supporting assets for YouTube or other video platforms. 

-Experience preparing artwork for professional print production. 

-Experience designing for a variety of industries, audiences, and client types. 



*AI Tool Expectations 



We support the responsible use of AI tools as part of a modern creative workflow, but this role is not intended for someone who depends on AI to perform the core creative work. 



AI may be used for: 



-Brainstorming 

-Concept exploration 

-Research 

-Mood boards 

-Script or content ideation 

-Workflow support 

-Productivity assistance 



Final work should demonstrate strong human creative judgment, originality, brand awareness, visual consistency, and professional execution. 



Candidates should be comfortable creating high-quality graphics and multimedia content independently using professional design and editing tools. 



*What We Are Looking For 



We are looking for someone who can: 



-Think creatively while keeping marketing and business goals in mind. 

-Understand the difference between content that simply looks good and content that communicates effectively. 

-Produce visual work that is polished, intentional, professional, and brand-aligned.

-Balance creativity with speed and production demands. 

-Work independently while collaborating effectively with other team members. 

-Take direction while also contributing original ideas. 

-Adapt their style across multiple brands without making every project look the same. 

-Understand how graphics and video influence marketing performance, engagement, user experience, and brand perception. 

-Maintain strong attention to detail across both static and motion-based creative work. 



*Portfolio Requirement

We are especially interested in seeing examples of:

-Social media graphics 

-Paid ad creative 

-Website imagery or landing page design 

-Short-form video editing 

-Social media video content 

-Promotional videos or video advertisements 

-Motion graphics or animated content 

-YouTube thumbnails or video branding 

-Print collateral 

-Before-and-after design improvements 

-Original layouts demonstrating strong typography, spacing, hierarchy, and composition 

-Work showing versatility across different brands, industries, and creative styles 

-Where possible, please include examples that clearly demonstrate your individual contribution. 



*Job Type 

-Full-time



*Schedule 

9:00 PM to 1:00 AM EST

The remaining hours needed to fulfill your 40-hour weekly commitment may be scheduled at your discretion, in alignment with team needs. You are expected to work approximately 8 hours per day.



*Work Tracking Requirements:

-We use Hubstaff for time tracking.



How to Apply 



Please submit the following to 



-Your resume 

-A link to your graphic design and video portfolio 

-A short introduction describing your creative experience 

-The design and video editing tools you use most often 

-The types of design and video projects you enjoy working on most 



We may not consider applications without a portfolio.

title: Content Strategist & Scriptwriter (Short-Form & YouTube Vlogs)
description:
Niche: Real Estate, Fitness & High Performance, Lifestyle & Family



About the Role

We are looking for a sharp, creative Content Strategist & Scriptwriter to join our team and serve as the creative engine behind our media brand.



Our brand sits at the intersection of high-level business/real estate, personal fitness/discipline, and modern family life. We are expanding beyond traditional real estate marketing into an all-encompassing lifestyle network across Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube, and
 newsletters.



You will work directly with the founder to take raw ideas, daily activities, and business insights, turning them into structured, high-retention video scripts, content calendars, and written media.



What You’ll Be Doing:

- Scriptwriting (Short-Form): Write 10–15 short-form scripts per week for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Focus heavily on 3-second visual/verbal hooks, high-retention pacing, and strong calls to action.



- Long-Form Outlining (YouTube): Develop narrative beat sheets, titles, thumbnail concepts, and A-Roll/B-Roll guidelines for weekly vlogs and property/lifestyle features.



- Content Planning & Calendar: Manage a rolling 30-day content calendar across platforms, ensuring a balanced mix of our core pillars (Real Estate & Business, Health & Fitness, Family & Lifestyle).



- Repurposing Matrix: Turn long-form YouTube videos, podcasts, or raw discussions into short-form video scripts, social media captions, and newsletter entries.



- Editor Handoffs: Format scripts clearly with on-screen text overlays, sound cue notes, and B-roll suggestions so our video editing team can execute seamlessly.



Who You Are

- You Write for the Ear: You know how to write conversational, human copy that sounds natural when spoken aloud—never robotic, overly formal, or salesy.



- Hook-Obsessed: You understand short-form video psychology and know how to use curiosity gaps, bold statements, and visual cues to stop the scroll in the first 3 seconds.



- Systems-Minded: You are organized and comfortable managing script pipelines and workflows in tools like Notion, Trello, or Google Docs.



- Storyteller Across Pillars: You know how to seamlessly blend personal lifestyle themes (fitness, discipline, family) with professional authority (real estate, entrepreneurship).



Nice-to-Haves

- Experience writing for content creators, real estate professionals, or lifestyle brands.

- basic understanding of YouTube SEO, title packaging, and thumbnail design psychology.

- Familiarity with newsletter platforms (Substack, Beehiiv, ConvertKit).

title: AI Growth Builder & Outbound Marketer (we build our own): property tech + new SaaS, remote
description:
AI Growth Builder and Outbound Marketer (global outreach), remote



The short version

We are a European property-tech group, and we are building something bigger. We need someone who uses AI to reach the right people in every market and turns that reach into real action on our platforms: agents listing their properties and getting viewings booked, agencies coming on board. Think AI-driven
, AI calling, and social outreach that gets people to like and share, country by country, in the local language. Important: we build and own our systems. We are not looking for someone who rents a pile of subscriptions, we want someone who builds the engine with us so we own it and reuse it. On top of that, you can pick up the broader marketing work too: content, social, basic SEO, paid, analytics.



Who we are

We run several live rental and property platforms in the European market on one shared codebase, plus a new SaaS for the staffing and recruitment sector. We move fast, we test thoroughly, and we reward people who prove results.



How we work (important)

- We build and own our tools. We prefer building over renting. Less vendor lock-in, more control, and everything we build we reuse across our platforms.

- That means working at the level of APIs, your own scripts, and your own automations, not clicking together a stack of expensive closed services.

- You build it once, we own it, and it keeps paying off across every channel and every country.



What you will do (the core)

- Build AI-powered, multi-channel outreach that we own and that scales worldwide, market by market:
 at volume, AI calling, social, and WhatsApp where it fits.

- For the property platform: reach real estate agents in every market and bring them onto the platform, listing their properties and getting viewings booked. The AI calls and messages carry one clear call to action: visit the site and get started.

- For the SaaS: reach staffing and recruitment agencies and get them on board and active in the same way.

- It is one engine for both products. You build it once and it runs for property and for staffing, country by country.

- Make it work in any language. Build a reliable localization approach so the outreach reads native in each market, using AI translation with quality control and native review where it matters. Rough machine translation does not cut it; the message has to feel local, not foreign.

- Drive social amplification: get agents and agencies to follow, like, and share our content, so reach compounds.

- Build the lead data, sequences, and automations yourself, and keep them deliverable and legal in every market you touch: GDPR in Europe, anti-spam laws such as CAN-SPAM, and local rules on
 and automated calling. Warmed domains, clear opt-out, and consent where it is required. Compliance and deliverability are part of the job, not an afterthought.

- Measure everything: replies, signups, activations, and double down on what works.



What you will do (the bonus, all-round)

- Content and social management, basic SEO, paid campaigns, simple design, reporting.



How you build it (we like builders, not renters)

- Comfortable wiring up LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in your own workflows.

- Comfortable with self-hostable automation (for example n8n) and your own scripts over closed SaaS where it makes sense.

- Can build your own lead data, localization, and outreach pipeline instead of depending on one paid platform.

- For AI calling, you wire telephony and voice models yourself rather than relying on a closed black box.

If you already build your own automations instead of renting them, tell us. That is exactly who we want.



Who you are

- You think in systems and you build and own them.

- You have grown something real and can show it, with a number.

- You are comfortable with volume, testing, and iteration.

- You write clear English, and you have a proven way to make outreach read natively in many other languages (AI localization with quality control, native review where it matters). You do not rely on rough machine translation.

- You respect the law in each country you reach into, and you treat compliance as part of doing it well, not a brake. You know that automated calling in particular is tightly regulated and you handle it carefully, market by market.

- You are self-starting and reliable, and you keep brands safe (no spammy shortcuts that get domains blacklisted).



The deal

- Remote, full-time preferred. We start at a fair entry rate and raise it quickly for people who prove results.

- We test with a small paid task first, then move fast for the right person.

- As we scale this across both products and more markets, there is room for it to grow into more than one role.



How to apply (please read)

1. Start your message with the word GROWTH so I know you read this.

2. In a few lines, answer this: how would you reach 10,000 real estate agents in one country using AI, end to end, how would you keep it legal and deliverable there (think GDPR, anti-spam, and rules on automated calling), how would you make the outreach read natively in that country's language, and which parts would you build yourself versus rent?

3. Add one example of something you have grown, with a number.

Applications that skip these get less attention. We reply to serious ones quickly.

title: AI-Augmented Laravel + Vue 2 Developer / Engineer (EU property/SaaS-tech, remote)
description:
Role

We are looking for a strong, reliable engineer who likes to move fast with AI tools and still ships carefully. We care heavily about clear communication, good decisions, and a clean trial result.



About us

We are a European property-tech company. We maintain a long-running Laravel application with Blade, Vue 2, Bootstrap, and tenant-scoped data patterns. We use GitLab merge requests. We care about security, privacy, and small reviewable changes.



How we work

We use an AI-assisted development workflow. You are expected to use coding assistants to speed up analysis and implementation, but you treat generated output as draft work: clarify scope, plan the change, verify behaviour, keep diffs small, and prove changes with sensible and thorough checks and testing before review.



This role is a great fit if you like turning requirements into a short plan, using AI where it helps, keeping changes easy to review, and checking your work before you ask for feedback. It is not a fit if you want to ship large unreviewed blocks of AI-generated code.



What you will do

- Deliver scoped changes on a mature Laravel + Vue 2 codebase using AI-assisted methods safely.

- Open merge requests with clear descriptions, scoped commits, and tests where applicable.

- Communicate in writing about plan, trade-offs, and verification steps.



Requirements

- Demonstrable AI-assisted workflow in real product work (you can explain it concretely).

- Comfortable working in Laravel in a larger codebase, including reading and navigating existing code you did not write yourself.

- Comfortable with Vue 2 in production, or strong Vue experience with a clear plan to work within Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- Comfortable with Blade templates and web security (escaping, CSRF, safe handling of user input).

- Solid Git habits: branches, scoped commits, merge request workflow.

- Written English strong enough for async work with EU stakeholders.

- Ideally 4 to 6 hours overlap per workday with CET business hours (Monday to Friday). Please state your timezone and the CET window you can reliably cover each workday.



Nice to have

- AI-assisted work on legacy codebases (careful refactors, incremental upgrades, tenant-scoped features).

- Laravel Mix / Webpack and Docker-based local builds.

- Multi-tenant SaaS experience.



Trial (before any production access)

We run a mini-trial on a sandbox repository that mirrors our stack patterns but contains no production code or customer data. Timebox is about 4 to 6 hours, agreed upfront.



You may use AI tools during the trial, but you must not paste secrets, customer data, production logs, or private business information into external tools. You must be able to explain and defend everything you submit.



How to apply (English, no template letters)

1) Your current AI-assisted workflow: how you scope prompts, verify output, and prevent scope creep.

2) One example where an AI tool gave a wrong or risky suggestion. How did you catch it?

3) Either (A) walk us through one concrete merge request or commit you authored where AI was your primary tool: what you prompted, what came back, and what you changed before merge, or (B) if you cannot share a link, describe your first 30 minutes on an unfamiliar legacy Laravel/Vue task before you edit code.

4) How do you keep AI-assisted changes small and reviewable in a legacy monolith?

5) Multi-tenant safety: what checks would you do before changing a query that returns tenant-owned records?

6) What information must never be pasted into external AI tools? Name categories, not examples from real projects.



Do not apply if

- You are not the person who will do the work.

- You ship AI output without verification.

- You cannot describe your workflow concretely.

- You only have Vue 3 experience and cannot commit to Vue 2 patterns in this codebase.

- You would paste secrets, production logs, or customer data into external tools.

title: Crypto Business Development Manager | Partnerships & Appointment Setting
description:
How to apply

Applications missing any item are auto-rejected. Send:



1. Loom video (2-3 min): who you are, your crypto experience, the most qualified appointments you've personally booked in one month, and how you'd produce 5 qualified GMI partnership calls per week.

2. In writing (3-4 sentences): what a launchpad is and why one would want LP Bonds for its projects.

3. Scenario: "Your reps sent 250 targeted messages in one week, received 18 positive replies, and booked zero qualified calls. What do you inspect, and what do you change in the next 48 hours?"

4. One target for GMI (a DEX, launchpad, or ecosystem): why it's qualified, the exact role you'd contact, the channel, and the personalized first message you'd send.

5. Your
 handle, available hours in GMT+8, and earliest start date.



Subject line must start with: BOND OPS





At target pace this role pays roughly $1,500 to $2,500/month depending on how many appointments you book personally vs through your reps, with no cap on the upside. Base is the floor, not the offer.



About GMI

GonnaMakeIt (GMI) built LP Bonds, a live DeFi liquidity product deployed across 9+ EVM chains (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, and more).

LP Bonds lock liquidity for 20 years while giving users a tradeable Bond NFT earning
% APR. The liquidity is locked, the user is not: they can sell their Bond NFT anytime. Rewards accrue inside the bond instead of being farmed and dumped.

Our partnership targets: DEXs, token launchpads, L1/L2 blockchain ecosystems, and select token projects with strong strategic fit.

We need someone to build and run a BD engine that consistently puts qualified partnership calls on the founder's calendar.





The role

One job: produce qualified partnership calls that actually happen, every week.



The founder takes the calls and closes. You own everything before that: rep recruiting and management, target selection, qualification, outreach strategy, follow-up, pipeline, booking, call prep, and funnel diagnosis.



This is a player-coach role. You manage commission-based BD reps AND personally do outreach and book calls whenever the team is below target. Meetings, training, recruiting, and spreadsheet work do not count as output. Qualified calls held count as output.





The metric



Qualified partnership appointments held per week. After ramp: floor 2, target 5, strong 6+.



A call counts only when ALL are true: the target passes our qualification standard, the attendee is a decision-maker (or credible sponsor with direct access to one), they explicitly expressed interest in LP Bonds for their org, they know what the call is about, the call happens, a real partnership discussion occurs, and the founder confirms it was qualified.



Does NOT count: no-shows, reschedules until held, calls where they pitch their product to us, generic networking, community mods who can't advance a deal, duplicates, or projects that can't realistically use LP Bonds.





What you own

1. Rep performance. Audit the existing rep team immediately. Recruit replacements as needed. Give each rep target accounts, messaging, channels, and weekly numbers. Coach producers, cut non-producers. A rep showing no meaningful pipeline progress after 10 working days gets diagnosed and acted on, not carried for 30.

2. Targeting. At least 80% of the active pipeline is DEXs, launchpads, and L1/L2 ecosystems. Targets are EVM-compatible unless the founder approves an exception. Do not fill the pipeline with projects just because they're easy to reach.

3. Qualification. You run (or audit) our LP Bonds Partner Assessment on every interested project. Score of 5/10+ passes to the founder. Below 5 can be escalated for founder review if you believe it's a real opportunity. Before any prospect reaches the founder you confirm: real scale/traction, a genuine LP Bonds fit, a decision-maker in the loop, and explicit interest in LP Bonds for THEM. "We want to explore this for our ecosystem" is interest. "Sounds cool, let's find synergies" is not.

4. Conversion, not volume. Our history shows the exact failure you're hired to prevent: reps sending 40-60 outreaches a week, reporting "interested projects," and producing no decision-maker conversations and no calls. You own the conversion at every stage:

A. Positive reply ? meaningful advancement within 5 business days. That means a decision-maker conversation, a
 group or direct thread with the right person, or a concrete scheduled next step toward a call. If none occurs, the prospect is recycled or closed out of active pipeline. Claimed interest that never advances counts as nothing.

B. Every live opportunity has one owner, one next action, one deadline.

C. Any opportunity untouched for 5 business days gets a decision: advance, recycle, or close. Nothing sits in "waiting."

D. "Calendly shared" is not a completed task. No booking within 2 business days means follow-up happens, and the prospect is told to confirm the booking with both you and the rep.

E. If significant outreach produces no qualified calls, you identify the failure point (targets, contacts, messaging, channel, follow-up, or rep) and launch a new test within 24 hours. The same broken approach never runs for multiple weeks.



5. Pipeline control. One accurate source of truth: target, category, tier, contact and decision-maker status, owner, every touch, stage, next action, deadline, call status. Duplicate outreach prevented. All partner groups remain accessible to GMI even if a rep leaves.

6. Founder handoff. Before a call goes on the founder's calendar: a short brief covering who they are, why they're qualified, why LP Bonds fit, what interest they expressed, who d
, and the desired outcome. No Calendly shared before the qualification gate is complete.

7. Reporting and escalation. Every Friday YOU post one consolidated report: outreach sent, positive replies, qualified conversations, groups created, calls booked, calls held, conversion at each stage, per-rep results, stalled deals, next week's tests. Exact numbers and names, no narratives. Chasing reps for their numbers is your job, done before Friday, never visible to the founder.

If the week is heading to zero qualified calls, you tell the founder THAT DAY with the likely cause, the numbers, the fix being launched, and when results should show. Bad news early is rewarded. Bad news buried is a dealbreaker.



Time allocation

A. 50%+ on outreach, follow-up, and appointment conversion

B. Up to 25% managing and recruiting reps

C. Up to 25% research, reporting, and admin



Building internal tools, assigning books, refining meeting formats, and polishing trackers do not count toward anything. If the team is below target, your personal outreach time goes up.





First 30 days (paid trial)

Day 3: Full audit of every rep and the current pipeline. Immediate correction plan presented. 

Day 7: Clean pipeline and reporting system live. 100+ prioritized qualified targets. Every rep assigned accounts and numbers. Two outreach tests launched. Your personal outreach started. 

Day 14: 2+ qualified appointments held. Measurable conversion at each funnel stage. Non-performers cut or on a final clock. Zero held appointments by Day 14 triggers an immediate role review. 

Day 30 minimum: 6 qualified appointments held, 2+ in the final week, clean pipeline, producing rep core. Target: 8-10 held, exiting at a 3-5/week pace.



Hit the numbers and this grows into a larger BD leadership role with more hours and higher comp as we scale.



Compensation

A. Base: $10/hr, up to 20 hrs/week

B. $100 for every qualified appointment held that you personally booked

C. $30 override for every qualified appointment held that your reps booked

Partnership revenue, two lanes:

D. Partnerships YOU originated: you earn the full rep-tier package: 25% of upgrade fees for the first 90 days after go-live, then 10% through month 12, plus the bond bonus ladder (+$500 at $10K minted, +$1,000 at $20K, +$5,000 at $100K and every $100K after, cumulative, no ceiling).

E. Partnerships your REPS originated: you earn an override equal to 20% of your rep's commission payouts, paid by GMI on top of their commission, never deducted from them, plus $250 per partnership once $2,500 in cumulative LP Bond value has been minted in that partner's pools (USD value at time of mint, verified on-chain).

Every partnership has exactly one originator of record in our tracker, so lanes never stack on the same deal.

F, Additional bonuses possible for exceptional strategic partnerships

G. No cap on any of the above. One appointment bonus per call ($100 personal OR $30 override, not both)

H. Appointment bonuses paid after the call happens and the founder confirms it met the standard

I. Base and bonuses paid 50/50 in ETH and GMI, exact valuation method provided in writing before you start 





Requirements

A. Crypto-native: DEXs, launchpads, liquidity, TVL, ecosystems, no googling required

B. Prior crypto BD, partnerships, lead-gen, or appointment-setting experience with calls you personally booked

C. Experience managing contractors or reps against numbers, and comfortable cutting non-performers

D. Excellent written English, comfortable messaging founders and senior decision-makers

E. Organized: CRMs, trackers,
, X, LinkedIn,
, outreach platforms (we use Saleshandy)

F. 3+ hrs daily overlap with GMT+7/+8

G. Responsive within 10 minutes during your agreed working block unless on a scheduled call





Working standards

Outcomes over activity. Calls held over calls promised. Decision-makers over moderators. Explicit interest over vague networking. Exact numbers over narratives. Problems escalated the day they appear. Every opportunity has an owner, a next action, and a deadline. No hiding bad weeks. No perfecting systems that don't produce calls. The founder never manages your reps.

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

title: Full Time Video Editor - UGC & Voiceover Storyteller for Fast-Growing DTC Brand
description:
Overview



We're a fast-growing headlamp brand, one of the biggest in our category and scaling hard into the US. Most of our buyers are women buying practical gifts for the men in their lives, and our creative is built around that gifting psychology.



⚠ Please read this overview in full before applying.



We're looking for a video editor who can take raw creator footage and turn it into a story that converts. Long-term role. Real growth path if you're an A-player.





Who We Need



Someone who genuinely lives in UGC and voiceover editing. Your real craft has to be storytelling with real people, real reactions, and real moments.



If you can take a folder of raw creator footage and d
 on your own which moments matter, which reactions carry the story, and how to pace it so it feels natural, you're who we need.



If you're stronger with heavy briefs telling you exactly which clip goes where, this role might not be the right fit for you. We'd love you to only apply if UGC storytelling is genuinely your strength.





The Bar We're Setting



- Real UGC editing experience with a portfolio of ads that ran on Meta or TikTok

- Storytelling instinct: you can find the story in raw footage without being told where it is

- Deep understanding of hooks, pacing, and retention for direct response ads

- Fluent TikTok-style captions that look natural, not editor-heavy

- Confident with ElevenLabs voiceovers, choosing natural voices, matching pacing

- Comfortable using AI tools (Higgsfield, Nano Banana) when a shot needs to be generated

- Understanding English well enough to read a script and know what it's really trying to say

- Reliable, communicative, takes feedback well, delivers on time

- 2 finished ads per day, Monday to Friday





What You'll Be Doing



- Editing UGC ads and voiceover ads (this is the core of the role)

- Some founder-style and mashup ads

- Occasional AI-assisted bottom-of-funnel and top-of-funnel work

- Reviewing our top-performing ads to understand why they work

- Working closely with the team on Slack to sharpen output every week





What This Pays



Base: $35 USD per finished ad.



The better the quality of your work, the better the opportunity for higher pay over time. Quality is what we reward here.





Growth Path



The editor who delivers through Q4 becomes a senior editor on the team in 2027. Real progression: more responsibility, higher rates, leadership of newer editors, direct collaboration on creative direction.





How to Apply



Apply through our form here: 



The form takes 10-15 minutes. Every editor we've hired who's done well on our team has filled this form out. It clearly works, so please take the time to show us your best answers and your best work.



If you're a strong fit, we'll come back to you with a paid test brief using real footage from the brand. Land the trial and you're cutting paid work within the week.



Thanks,

Jack

title: Supply Chain Manager - EU experience required
description:
Olvy sells through several European marketplaces, purchases from a fixed base of suppliers in China and works with external fulfilment partners. As the number of countries, channels and partners grows, so does the complexity of the supply chain.



The Supply Chain Manager holds end responsibility for the design and the performance of this chain. The role sets the inventory strategy, safeguards availability and inventory turnover, holds suppliers and fulfilment partners to measurable performance standards, and makes sure the supply chain remains scalable as we expand into new countries and sales channels.



The role carries independent authority, works against clearly defined KPIs, and takes over substantive ownership of the supply chain from the Operations Manager. This creates a single, clear owner for inventory, partner performance and the further development of the chain.



Responsibilities:

1. Inventory and planning

- Setting and maintaining safety stock and coverage targets per product category and per channel, based on demand

variability and actual lead times.

- Setting reorder points and replenishment logic, including MOQ and container constraints.

- Building and monthly updating of the long term forecast with a horizon of at least twelve months, including seasonal

peaks and deal periods.

- Determining the purchase quantity per order, subject to approval by the Operations Manager and, above the agreed

threshold, by finance.

- Monitoring inventory turnover and inventory health, and intervening actively in cases of overstock and slow movers.

- Directing the Supply Chain Coordinator on the weekly replenishment to the fulfilment channels.



2. Network and logistics

- Owning the performance of all fulfilment partners: defining SLAs, measuring them, reporting back monthly and escalating where needed.

- Selecting carriers and negotiating freight rates, covering sea and road freight and, where required, air and rail.

- Monitoring container utilisation and shipment consolidation, against a defined target for freight cost per unit sold.

- Preparing and executing the transition of the fulfilment network towards 2027, with the Operations Manager as decision maker.

- Designing the logistics chain when expanding into a new country or channel: storage, return flows, customs, the import process and VAT registration in cooperation with finance.



3. Supplier performance

- Structurally measuring suppliers on actual lead time, production capacity, delivery reliability and quality deviations.

- Holding periodic performance reviews with the key suppliers, at least quarterly, with recorded commitments and follow up.

- Negotiating prices, payment terms and incoterms with existing suppliers, subject to approval by the Operations Manager.

- Coordinating pre shipment quality inspections and following up on findings.



4. Performance and reporting

- Owning the supply chain KPIs in the internal dashboard: their definition, the reliability of the underlying data and their further improvement.

- Monthly reporting to the management team on availability, forecast accuracy, chain costs and risks, including a concrete proposal wherever there is a deviation.

- Owning escalations towards suppliers and fulfilment partners.

- Documenting and maintaining the working processes in the chain, so that execution does not depend on individuals.







***MUST HAVE/HARD REQUIREMENTS***

1. Five to ten years of supply chain experience, including at least two years with end responsibility for inventory norms or a fulfilment network.

2. Demonstrable experience with imports from Asia into Europe: incoterms, sea freight, container planning, customs and the import process.

3. Demonstrable experience managing external fulfilment partners on the basis of SLAs.

4. Inventory planning at parameter level, not purely executional. Able to explain why a norm is set where it is.

5. Strong analytical ability with data, able to work through large datasets and to question the output of a tool.

6. Experience in e-commerce or marketplace fulfilment.

7. Fluent English, both written and in negotiation.



Nice to have, not required

1. Lean Six Sigma or a comparable process improvement background.

2. Experience with EU product compliance and import regulations.

3. Experience building a supply chain rather than only managing an existing one.

title: Ecommerce Social Media & Creative Specialist
description:
Hello! We are a growing UK women’s ecommerce fashion brand looking for an experienced Ecommerce Social Media & Creative Specialist to take day-to-day ownership of our organic social content while also producing polished Canva creative, curating existing assets and supporting creative research.



This is a hands-on execution role. A large part of the role will involve working with existing assets - selecting the strongest content, adding or adapting text and graphic elements in Canva, recreating supplied creative references, producing variations, resizing assets and turning existing photography/UGC into polished social and ecommerce creative.



You do not need to be an advanced graphic designer or senior social strategist. However, you must have strong visual judgement, excellent Canva skills and ecommerce marketing experience.



What You’ll Own

====================

1. Organic Social Media

- Own the day-to-day content calendar across
, Instagram and TikTok.

- Select the strongest photography, UGC, creator content and finished video to use.

- Create, write, schedule and publish organic posts.

- Adapt and repurpose existing content appropriately for each platform.

- Create Stories, carousels, promotional posts, product-led posts, reviews, polls and other native social content.

- Write and adapt captions, hooks and calls to action.

- Keep our channels consistent, active, current and on-brand.

- Respond to comments and community activity, escalating customer-service issues where needed.

- Spot content that performs particularly well and share useful learnings with the team.



2. Canva & Ecommerce Creative

- Create polished social and ecommerce graphics using Canva or similar tools.

- Add headlines, offers, reviews, prices, CTAs and other graphic elements to existing photography.

- Recreate supplied creative references using our own products, assets and branding.

- Create variations of existing successful creative.

- Produce product posts, Stories, carousels, promotional graphics, testimonial graphics and static Meta ad creative.

- Resize and adapt creative accurately for placements such as 1:1, 4:5 and 9:16.

- Maintain good typography, spacing, hierarchy and brand consistency.



This role is less about inventing complex designs from scratch and more about executing strong ecommerce creative quickly and to a high visual standard.



3. Asset Management & Creative Research

- Keep photography, UGC, creator content and finished creative organised and easy to find.

- Track which assets have already been used and identify strong content that can be repurposed.

- Identify content gaps and flag products lacking suitable photography, UGC, reviews or video.

- Research competitors, Meta Ad Library, Instagram and TikTok for relevant ideas, hooks, layouts and formats.

- Explain why an idea is interesting and how it could apply to our brand rather than simply saving examples.

- Share useful research with the Creative Strategist and founders.



Essential Experience

====================

- Previous professional experience working with an ecommerce/DTC brand or ecommerce clients.

- Experience managing social media for a brand, particularly
 and Instagram.
