title: SENIOR BRAND, E-COMMERCE & MARKETING LEAD
description:
SENIOR BRAND, E-COMMERCE & MARKETING LEAD



Company: SUPR Global

Employment: Full-Time | Remote

Level: Senior / Leadership

Markets: Singapore, Malaysia & Asia



ABOUT SUPR



SUPR is a growing performance and lifestyle brand built for people who want more from their everyday performance — from training and sport to recovery and daily life.



We are building beyond individual products. Our goal is to build SUPR into a recognised performance brand across Asia.



As we scale, we are looking for an exceptional Senior Brand, E-Commerce & Marketing Lead who can take ownership of our brand, marketing and commercial growth.



This is not a position for someone who only executes campaigns, posts content or waits for instructions.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand the customer, build the brand, drive revenue, lead a team and execute at a high level.



You will work closely with the Founder/CEO and play a key leadership role in the growth of SUPR.



---



THE ROLE



You will own and oversee SUPR's overall brand, e-commerce, marketing and growth direction across Singapore, Malaysia and other Asian markets.



Your responsibility is not simply to generate awareness.



Your responsibility is to help turn brand attention into customers, customers into repeat customers, and SUPR into a scalable regional business.



You will be expected to develop the strategy, build the roadmap, lead the team, execute campaigns and continuously analyse what is working and what needs to change.



---



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. BRAND STRATEGY & MANAGEMENT



Own and strengthen SUPR's overall brand positioning, identity and direction.



You will:



- Develop and maintain clear brand positioning across products and markets

- Ensure consistent brand messaging, tone and visual direction

- Understand our target customers and what drives their purchasing decisions

- Develop strong product positioning and key selling propositions

- Identify opportunities to differentiate SUPR from competitors

- Lead campaign concepts and brand storytelling

- Ensure every customer touchpoint represents SUPR correctly

- Maintain consistency across website, marketplaces, social media, advertising, packaging, creators and campaigns

- Conduct competitor and market analysis

- Help shape SUPR into a recognisable and desirable performance brand



You should understand the difference between selling products and building a brand.



---



2. E-COMMERCE & REVENUE GROWTH



Take ownership of SUPR's e-commerce performance across:



Shopify

TikTok Shop

Shopee

Lazada

Future marketplaces and regional channels



You will:



- Develop strategies to increase online revenue

- Improve conversion rates

- Improve average order value (AOV)

- Develop bundles, upsells and cross-sells

- Optimise product pages and landing pages

- Improve merchandising and product positioning

- Plan marketplace campaigns and promotions

- Analyse customer purchasing behaviour

- Identify drop-off points in the customer journey

- Work on retention and repeat purchase strategies

- Improve the overall online customer experience

- Identify new sales channels and growth opportunities



You should understand how brand, creative, advertising, pricing, promotions and customer experience work together to generate revenue.



---



3. MARKETING & GROWTH STRATEGY



Develop and own SUPR's overall marketing and growth strategy.



You will:



- Build monthly, quarterly and annual marketing plans

- Create a structured marketing calendar months ahead

- Develop customer acquisition and retention strategies

- Plan product launches and promotional campaigns

- Identify new growth opportunities

- Develop strategies for new market expansion

- Define marketing KPIs and targets

- Allocate marketing resources based on business priorities

- Analyse campaign performance and recommend improvements

- Continuously test new channels, offers, messaging and audiences



We expect you to think beyond today's tasks.



You should know what the marketing team needs to be doing this week, next month and next quarter.



---



4. PERFORMANCE MARKETING



You should have a strong understanding of performance marketing, including:



- Meta Ads

- TikTok Ads

- Retargeting

- Paid social

- Creative testing

- Audience testing

- Landing page testing

- Conversion optimisation

- Campaign scaling



You do not necessarily need to personally operate every campaign forever, but you must understand performance marketing well enough to lead, evaluate and challenge the people responsible for it.



You should be comfortable analysing:



ROAS

CAC

CPA

CTR

CPC

CPM

Conversion Rate

AOV

LTV

Retention

Repeat Purchase Rate



You should be able to identify why performance is improving or declining and determine what the team should test next.



---



5. CAMPAIGN & PRODUCT LAUNCH MANAGEMENT



Own campaigns from idea to execution.



You will:



- Develop campaign concepts

- Build campaign timelines

- Coordinate product launches

- Plan promotional strategies

- Define offers and messaging

- Coordinate creative production

- Coordinate paid advertising

- Coordinate influencer and creator activation

- Coordinate e-commerce execution

- Ensure campaigns launch on time

- Monitor performance during campaigns

- Conduct post-campaign analysis



Every major campaign should have a clear objective, audience, strategy, timeline, owner, KPI and expected outcome.



---



6. CONTENT & CREATIVE DIRECTION



You will work closely with designers, video editors, content creators and external partners.



You should be able to:



- Develop strong creative directions

- Write clear creative briefs

- Identify strong hooks and marketing angles

- Understand what content performs across different platforms

- Evaluate creative quality

- Provide useful feedback to designers and editors

- Develop content pillars

- Balance brand-building content with conversion-focused content

- Identify trends without blindly following them

- Turn customer insights into creative concepts



You don't need to personally design everything.



But you must know what good creative looks like and why it works.



---



7. CREATOR, INFLUENCER & AFFILIATE MARKETING



Develop and scale SUPR's creator ecosystem.



This includes:



- Influencer partnerships

- Athlete partnerships

- UGC creators

- Product seeding

- Affiliate programs

- TikTok affiliates

- Brand ambassadors



You will:



- Identify suitable creators

- Develop creator strategies

- Build scalable outreach systems

- Structure affiliate campaigns

- Track creator performance

- Identify high-performing UGC

- Turn successful organic content into paid advertising opportunities

- Build long-term relationships with creators who genuinely fit SUPR



---



8. CUSTOMER RETENTION & CRM



Growth doesn't stop after the first purchase.



You will develop strategies around:



-
 marketing

- Customer segmentation

- Repeat purchases

- Product replenishment

- Customer lifecycle campaigns

- Abandoned carts

- Win-back campaigns

- Loyalty and community

- Cross-selling

- Customer feedback



Your objective is to increase customer lifetime value, not simply acquire more first-time customers.



---



9. TEAM LEADERSHIP & MANAGEMENT



This is a major part of the position.



You will lead and manage members across marketing, creative, content, e-commerce and other growth functions.



You will be expected to:



- Establish clear roles and responsibilities

- Set priorities and deadlines

- Assign ownership for projects

- Set KPIs

- Monitor team performance

- Conduct regular marketing and growth meetings

- Review progress and deliverables

- Hold team members accountable

- Identify blockers early

- Resolve execution problems

- Coach and develop team members

- Improve communication between departments

- Recruit or recommend additional talent when necessary

- Build efficient workflows and SOPs

- Ensure projects move forward without constant Founder/CEO intervention



The Founder should not need to constantly chase the marketing team for updates.



You should be capable of running the department, creating structure and making sure things get done.



---



10. REPORTING, ANALYTICS & FORECASTING



You will provide clear visibility into marketing and e-commerce performance.



You should be able to produce and explain:



- Weekly performance reports

- Monthly marketing reports

- Revenue performance

- Campaign performance

- Advertising performance

- Customer acquisition costs

- Channel performance

- E-commerce conversion

- Marketing spend

- Growth forecasts

- Upcoming campaigns and priorities



We don't want reports filled with numbers without meaning.



We want someone who can explain:



What happened?

Why did it happen?

What are we doing next?



---



ASIA & SINGAPORE MARKET EXPERIENCE



SUPR is building from Singapore with ambitions across Asia.



Therefore, previous experience working with Asian markets is highly advantageous.



Experience specifically within Singapore and/or Malaysia is a strong plus.



You should ideally understand:



- Singapore consumer behaviour

- Southeast Asian e-commerce

- TikTok Shop

- Shopee

- Lazada

- Regional purchasing behaviour

- Local promotional periods

- Regional creator/influencer ecosystems

- Mobile-first commerce

- Differences between Western and Asian consumer marketing



Candidates who have successfully grown brands within Singapore, Malaysia or Southeast Asia will have a strong advantage.



---



REQUIREMENTS



We are looking for someone with:



- 5+ years of strong experience in marketing, brand, growth or e-commerce

- Previous experience in a senior or leadership position

- Proven experience managing a marketing or growth team

- Strong e-commerce experience

- Strong understanding of Shopify

- Experience with TikTok Shop, Shopee and/or Lazada is highly advantageous

- Strong understanding of Meta and TikTok advertising

- Experience developing and executing marketing strategies

- Strong brand-building ability

- Strong understanding of DTC/customer acquisition

- Experience managing product launches

- Experience with creators, influencers and affiliates

- Strong analytical and commercial thinking

- Excellent project management

- Excellent written and spoken English

- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment

- High level of ownership and accountability



Experience within sports, fitness, performance, wellness, nutrition, lifestyle, consumer products or DTC brands is highly advantageous.



---



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE



You are strategic, but you can execute.



You understand branding, but you also understand numbers.



You understand creative, but you also understand conversion.



You can manage people without needing someone else to manage you.



When something isn't working, you don't simply report the problem — you investigate it and propose what we should do next.



When sales decline, you want to understand why.



When a campaign performs well, you want to understand how to scale it.



When competitors move, you notice.



When there is an opportunity, you act.



You are comfortable working in a startup environment where things move quickly and priorities evolve.



Most importantly, you take ownership.



---



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF



- You need constant instructions before taking action

- Your experience is mainly social media posting

- You cannot confidently manage a team

- You struggle with deadlines and accountability

- You focus mainly on followers, likes and impressions instead of business outcomes

- You cannot understand marketing numbers

- You prefer maintaining existing systems rather than building and improving them

- You wait for management to identify every problem

- You are uncomfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment



We are not hiring someone simply to manage marketing tasks.



We are hiring someone to help build the company.



---



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



Success means SUPR has:



A stronger and more recognisable brand.



A structured marketing engine.



Growing e-commerce revenue.



Profitable and scalable customer acquisition.



Better customer retention.



Successful product launches.



A clear marketing calendar.



Strong creative output.



A high-performing team.



Clear reporting and accountability.



And most importantly, a marketing department that can operate and grow without the Founder having to manage every detail.



---



HOW TO APPLY



Please submit:



1. Your CV/resume

2. Portfolio or examples of brands you have worked with

3. Examples of campaigns you personally led

4. Actual measurable results you achieved

5. Examples of e-commerce businesses you helped grow

6. Team size and roles you previously managed

7. Platforms and advertising channels you have experience with

8. Experience working with Singapore, Malaysia or other Asian markets

9. Your expected monthly salary

10. Your availability/start date



Where possible, provide actual numbers such as:



Revenue growth

ROAS improvement

CAC reduction

Conversion improvement

E-commerce growth

Campaign revenue

Customer growth



Generic statements such as "I helped grow social media" will not be sufficient.



We want to understand what you personally did and what changed because of your work.



THE OPPORTUNITY



This is an opportunity to join SUPR at an early growth stage and play a major role in shaping where the brand goes next.



For the right person, this is more than another marketing job.



We are looking for someone who can become a key leader within SUPR and help build the brand across Asia.



BE SUPR.

---

---

**Desirable**

, Procore, or similar)

- Experience in high-end residential or hospitality fitout

- Working knowledge of contract frameworks (e.g. HIA, MBA, or AS4000 contracts)



---

---

title: Growth Marketing & Social Media Strategist - Meta Ads, Email & Funnels
description:
WE DO NOT NEED ANOTHER SOCIAL-MEDIA POSTER.



We need the person who knows what we should test next.



The $2 Bill Brand helps entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and experts become impossible to compare by becoming the ONLY choice in their space. Our founder, Brad Holcman, brings a Hollywood-trained storytelling and positioning perspective to personal brands and businesses.



We already have a team member who can produce and distribute content, and a GoHighLevel technical specialist who can build pages, funnels, automations, and related assets.



What we need now is a sharp, hands-on marketing strategist who can connect the dots between our offers, content, paid advertising, lead magnets,
 list, funnels, and actual results.



This is a fractional strategy and performance role. At 10 hours per week, your job is to create clarity, prioritize the highest-leverage actions, manage or improve a limited number of important marketing tests, and direct our existing execution support.



THE BASICS

Type of work: Part time, 10 hours per week

Pay: $500 USD per month

Start date: As soon as the right person is found

Location: Philippines

English level: Fluent / Advanced

Experience level: Expert. Four or more years hands-on.

Schedule: 10 hours weekly, including one weekly strategy call and one weekly execution and measurement call during mutually agreed U.S. Eastern-Time hours. Remaining hours are flexible.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



1. One clear growth plan and scorecard

You will audit our existing channels and customer journey, identify the largest growth constraints, and create a practical 90-day plan.



You will define what we should measure, where the data is unreliable, what needs to be fixed first, and what we should stop wasting time on.



Each week, you will provide a simple scorecard showing the most relevant information available: content performance, paid-media activity and spend, traffic, lead generation, funnel conversion signals,
 and list growth, and the next action we are taking.



You will explain what changed and why in plain English.



2. Paid-media strategy and focused optimization

You have hands-on Meta Ads experience and understand campaign structure, audiences, retargeting, creative testing, landing-page alignment, budget pacing, Meta Pixel and Conversions API concepts, and conversion-event quality.



You will not be expected to run unlimited campaigns or manage large budgets from day one. You will help us d
 what one or two paid-growth efforts are worth testing, set up or review the strategy, identify the right measurement, optimize what is live, and tell the team what should happen next.



3. Organic content and social-media strategy

You will build a strategic view of our founder-led content across YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok,
, and
.



You will recommend content pillars, formats, calls to action, distribution priorities, and posting rhythm based on the goal of each piece of content.



Our content VA handles most publishing and distribution. You will supply the why: whom we are speaking to, what message we need to test, which format and channel makes sense, what call to action belongs with it, and what signal tells us it worked.



4.
 list, lead magnets, and funnel strategy

You will recommend the highest-leverage ways to grow the
 list, improve lead magnets, strengthen welcome and nurture sequences, and move people from content or ads into the right next step.



You will create clear briefs for our GoHighLevel technical specialist. You are not expected to personally build every page or automation at this budget. You are expected to know what should be built, why, and how success should be measured.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 days: A concise audit, a measurement and tracking checklist, a 90-day priority plan, a first scorecard, one lead-magnet or funnel recommendation, and a focused paid and organic test plan.



Days 31-60: Weekly scorecards, clearer content priorities, one or two well-defined paid or funnel tests, and implementation briefs that the team can execute.



Days 61-90: A documented learning system. What is working, what is not, what should be scaled or stopped, and the next most valuable test.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE

You have at least four years of hands-on experience in growth marketing, paid social, performance marketing, funnel strategy,
 marketing, or a closely related role. Four years is the floor, not a suggestion. If you have two, this is not your role yet.



You have personally worked in Meta Ads Manager and can show that you understand more than posting boosts or reporting likes.



You understand how content, ads, lead magnets, landing pages, forms, CRM handoffs,
 sequences, and tracking should work together.



You have used GoHighLevel, 
, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, ClickFunnels, Webflow, or comparable tools. You know how to use Google Analytics and UTM tags, and you recognize when the data is insufficient to make a confident optimization decision.



You write excellent English, are commercially minded, bring recommendations rather than vague opinions, and can coordinate with a small team without turning strategy into a complicated document no one uses.



SKILLS THAT MATTER FOR THIS ROLE

Growth marketing, marketing strategy, Meta Ads,
 Ads, Instagram Ads, paid social, social media strategy, content strategy,
 marketing, lead generation, funnel strategy, GoHighLevel, CRM, landing pages, conversion rate optimization, Google Analytics, UTM tracking, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, retargeting, A/B testing, copywriting.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

Do not apply if your experience is only scheduling social-media posts or designing Canva graphics. We already have publishing support.



Do not apply if you expect to be paid to make a generic strategy deck and then disappear. We need someone who will help turn the strategy into a weekly operating rhythm.



At 10 hours per week, this is also not a request for you to edit every video, create every design, publish daily across every channel, build all technical funnels, write every
, or manage an unlimited number of ad campaigns.



The scope is strategic direction, focused performance work, and excellent coordination with our existing execution team.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with this exact phrase:



ONLY growth is measurable.



Applications without that phrase will not be considered.



Please include ALL of the following:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs profile and a clear statement of your actual role in each campaign or client result.



2. A two-to-three-minute Loom or video introduction explaining one paid campaign, funnel, or
-growth project you personally improved.



3. One short case study that states the starting problem, your actions, the spend range if paid media was involved, the tracking approach, the result, and what you learned. Anonymized screenshots are welcome. Do not disclose confidential client information.



4. Your answer: What is the largest monthly Meta Ads budget you have personally managed, and what conversion event did you optimize for?



5. In 250 words or fewer, visit 
 and share one audience, offer, content, or funnel hypothesis you would test first. This is how we evaluate your thinking.



6. Your hourly rate, confirmation you can work 10 hours weekly with two Eastern-Time calls, the CRM, funnel, and
 tools you have used hands-on, and two references.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid US$30 practical exercise. We will provide a fictional campaign snapshot and a short funnel description. In 45 minutes, you will tell us what data you need, what you would investigate first, what two tests you would prioritize, and how you would measure the outcome.



WHY JOIN US

You will have real influence on the growth of a distinctive founder-led brand, but you will not be expected to do everything alone.



You will work directly with Brad and coordinate with the content and GoHighLevel execution team. If you prove you can create measurable progress, this role can expand over time.

About the Role



If you are the person who reads three sources when one would do—and cannot let a “because that's how it works in this industry” go unchecked, this role may be for you.



**Rohring Results** is a US-based marketing agency providing **SEO, Google & Meta Ads, social media, content, creative,
 marketing, and web development** for clients across multiple industries.



We are hiring a **Strategy Manager** to own the strategic direction behind our client work.



This is **not a single-channel marketing role**. You will connect research, positioning, SEO, paid advertising, social media, content,
, creative, and web strategy into one coherent plan.



More importantly:



**This is a research job with a strategy title.**



Your job is to find out what is actually true about a market, a buyer, a competitive landscape, and a client's position—and then determine what the client should do about it.



When the research is strong, everything downstream becomes stronger. When the research is shallow, every channel can end up confidently solving the wrong problem.



What You'll Actually Do



1. Lead Client Strategy



You will own the strategy for new clients, including:



* Developing the overall marketing strategy and direction

* Connecting multiple channels into one integrated plan

* Identifying the client's biggest growth opportunities

* Determining what should be prioritized and why

* Translating research into clear strategic recommendations

* Making sure SEO, paid, social, content,
, creative, and web efforts work toward the same objectives



2. Conduct Deep Marketing Research



You will personally conduct or direct research involving:



* Buyer and audience research

* Customer personas

* Competitive analysis

* Industry and market research

* Brand positioning

* Audience research for paid campaigns

* Competitor messaging and offer analysis

* Market trends and opportunities



We are looking for someone who actually **does the research**, not someone who simply delegates it.



You should be able to take a research project, explain your methodology, show your sources, challenge your assumptions, and explain how you determined that your conclusions were reliable.



3. Build Brand Foundations



Many of our clients do not have clearly defined brand guidelines or positioning.



You will help establish:



* Brand positioning

* Differentiation

* Target audience

* Brand voice

* Key messaging

* Value propositions

* Messaging angles



Our copywriters and designers will use these strategic foundations to create the actual deliverables.



**You don't need to be the person writing every headline. You need to know which headline should exist and why.**



4. Review and Approve Content & Creative



You will have real strategic authority over work before it reaches the client.



You will:



* Review content and creative deliverables

* Identify when something does not align with strategy

* Give clear and actionable feedback

* Approve or reject work before client delivery

* Explain *why* something needs to change

* Ensure the final output reflects the research and strategy



You should be comfortable telling someone, including someone who does not report to you, that their work is not ready—and giving them enough direction to fix it.



5. Direct
 Campaign Strategy



You will determine:



* Target audience

* Campaign objective

* Offer

* Messaging angle

* Sequence

* Call to action



Our copywriter will write the
s.



**You provide the strategic brief and approve the final work.**



6. Analyze Client Performance



You will produce and review client performance reports using AI-assisted tools.



But generating a report is only the beginning.



You will need to determine:



* What actually happened?

* Why did it happen?

* Which numbers matter?

* Which numbers are misleading?

* What changed from the previous period?

* What should we do next?

* Does the data actually support the story the report is telling?



We need someone who can **question the report, not just format it.**



---



AI Is a Major Part of This Role



Every agency says it uses AI.



Here's what we actually mean.



Our teams already use AI to draft, research, brainstorm, and refine work. That is not what makes this position different.



**Your job is to be exceptionally good at getting reliable information out of AI tools—and knowing when the information is wrong.**



You will be expected to:



* Frame research questions that produce specific, useful answers rather than generic summaries

* Build effective prompts and research workflows

* Iterate instead of accepting the first response

* Cross-check AI-generated information

* Identify unsupported claims and hallucinations

* Understand what an AI model can and cannot reliably know

* Know when AI should **not** be used

* Use primary sources, customer reviews, forums, sales calls, interviews, analytics, and other sources when appropriate

* Turn research into documented, reusable strategic resources



**Anyone can get an answer from AI. We need someone who can determine whether the answer is actually true.**



During the hiring process, we may assess this skill directly.



If you can describe a time when an AI tool gave you an answer that *looked correct but wasn't*—and explain how you caught it—we want to hear about it.



---



What You'll Own



* Overall marketing strategy for new clients

* Integrated multi-channel strategy

* Market and industry research

* Buyer and audience research

* Competitive analysis

* Brand positioning and differentiation

* Customer personas

* Paid advertising audience strategy

* Content and creative direction

* Content and creative approval

*
 campaign strategy

* Client performance reporting

* Strategic recommendations based on performance data

* Ongoing independent research

* Documentation of research methods and strategic frameworks



Dedicated Research Time



A portion of every week will be protected for **research that is not tied to a specific client**.



This is intentional.



We want someone who actively studies markets, competitors, technology, consumer behavior, marketing trends, and emerging opportunities.



Nobody will necessarily be waiting for the output.



That's the point.



You need to be the kind of person who can take unstructured time and turn it into something valuable.



---



What We're Looking For



Required



**Multi-Channel Marketing Strategy Experience**



You have experience setting direction across multiple channels, ideally including:



* SEO

* Google Ads

* Meta Ads

* Social Media

* Content Marketing

*
 Marketing

* Brand Strategy



We are **not** looking for someone who specializes in one channel and simply coordinates the others.



Strong Research Experience



You have personally conducted work such as:



* Market research

* Competitive analysis

* Customer research

* Personas

* Brand positioning

* Audience research

* Industry analysis



Be prepared to walk us through a real project in detail.



Genuine Curiosity



One of the strongest indicators of success in this role is curiosity.



We want someone who has gone deep into a subject simply because they wanted to understand it.



It does not have to be marketing.



Strong AI Research Skills



You understand AI as a **research and reasoning instrument**, not simply a faster way to write.



You should be comfortable:



* Prompting

* Iterating

* Fact-checking

* Comparing sources

* Challenging AI outputs

* Building repeatable AI research workflows



We may assess this skill live.



### Strong Critical Thinking



You naturally ask:



* *How do we know this?*

* *What is the source?*

* *What assumption are we making?*

* *What would prove this wrong?*

* *Is there another explanation?*

* *What information are we missing?*



Comfortable Giving Direct Feedback



You will have authority over work produced by other team members.



You need to be comfortable saying:



**“This isn't right yet.”**



More importantly, you need to explain exactly **what needs to change and why.**



Self-Directed



Some of the most important work in this position will not come with a deadline.



You need to be able to identify valuable work, prioritize it, and execute without someone constantly telling you what to do next.



### Communication



* Excellent written English

* Strong analytical communication

* Comfortable working with US-based clients and colleagues

* Able to explain complex strategic ideas clearly

* Comfortable participating in client-facing discussions



---



Nice to Have



Experience with:



* Digital marketing agencies

* Google Ads

* Meta Ads

* Paid audience and targeting strategy

* Google Search Console

* GA4

* SEO platforms and analytics

* Marketing dashboards and reporting

* Competitive intelligence

* Brand strategy

* Marketing automation

* AI research workflows

* Creating documented processes that another person can follow



---



What This Job Is NOT



This may not be the right role if you are primarily looking for:



* A content writing position

* An SEO specialist position

* A paid ads specialist position

* A social media manager position

* A role where someone else provides the strategy

* A position where you simply execute instructions

* A job where AI is used primarily to generate content faster



**Our copywriters write. Our designers design. Our specialists execute.**



**You determine what should be done, why it should be done, who it should reach, and how we know it is working.**



---



About the Working Environment



This is a senior individual contributor position



There are no direct reports, but the role comes with real strategic authority.



Client-facing work does not move forward without your approval.



Rohring Results is a growing company, so not every process is perfectly established. Part of this role will involve helping us improve and document how strategy is developed and delivered.



Our delivery team primarily works on **Philippine hours**, including daily stand-ups.



Some client-facing meetings may take place during US hours. We will explain the expected schedule during the interview process.



---



How to Apply



Please submit your CV/Resume along with two short paragraphs answering the following:



1. A Research Question You Answered Well



Tell us:



* What were you trying to find out?

* How did you conduct the research?

* What sources did you use?

* How did you evaluate the information?

* How did you know your conclusion was reliable?

* What decision did the research ultimately influence?



2. A Time AI Gave You the Wrong Answer



Tell us about a situation where:



* An AI tool gave you an answer that appeared reasonable

* You discovered that it was wrong or misleading

* Explain how you identified the problem

* Explain how you verified the correct information

* Explain what you changed in your process afterward



**We read these answers before the rest of the application.**



They will tell us much more about how you think than a generic cover letter.



---

If you are naturally curious, skeptical of easy answers, comfortable with ambiguity, and genuinely enjoy figuring out *what is actually true*—we would like to meet you.



Apply with your CV and the two requested responses above. send to

title: Motion & Media Support
description:
Motion & Media Support

Full-time | Remote (Philippines) | US$280 per week | Monday–Friday



An Australian fashion / lifestyle DTC brand is looking for a Motion & Media Support hire to lead video editing across the marketing team's content output.



This role sits within Marketing & Creative and works closely with the Social/Content team, the founder, and campaign leads to turn raw footage into fast, engaging, on-brand video — from campaign launches through to everyday social and organic content.



The Opportunity

Pay: US$280 per week (fixed advertised rate; US$7.00 per hour).

Arrangement: Full-time remote contractor engagement, 40 hours per week.

Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00am–5:00pm (aligned to Australian business hours).

Start: As soon as practical. Please include your earliest start date and any notice period.

The advertised rate is fixed. Please only apply if you are comfortable with the compensation and schedule.



What you'll be responsible for

1. Campaign content — Cutting reels from campaign launch content, with a focus on hero products.

2. In-house face to camera — Cutting and editing in-house face-to-camera content (founder/talent or Social team) into publish-ready pieces.

3. Influencer content — Cutting and editing influencer content, splitting multi-look reels into individual posts for organic and paid use.

4. Stop motion — Creating stop-motion content for social hype and brand-building filler content.

5. Reactive / lower-lift content — Fast-turnaround editing of raw or lookbook footage into stories and in-the-moment posts, prioritising speed over polish.

6. Paid ad creative — Cutting multiple hook/variation edits of the same footage for A/B testing across paid social, and resizing winning organic content for paid placements.

7. Event and activation content — On-the-ground and same-day editing from activations, launches, and store openings/events for near real-time posting.

8. UGC, customer and employee content — Sourcing, editing, and repackaging customer, creator, and employee-generated content into social- and paid-ready formats.

9. Cross-channel repurposing — Adapting core footage across social, EDM/email banners/GIFs, website product and campaign video, and long-format channels.

10. Templates and batching — Building reusable cut-down templates and presets (intros, product callouts, transitions) to support higher-volume, faster-turnaround content.



Must-haves

- Fluent English (spoken and written) — required. You must communicate clearly with an Australian marketing and creative team.

- Strong portfolio/reel demonstrating social-first video editing, ideally fashion, lifestyle, or DTC retail.

- Software proficiency: Adobe, CapCut, Figma, Canva; After Effects for motion graphics, titles, and typography.

- Platform know-how across 9:16, 1:1, and 16:9 formats.

- Motion graphics within existing brand templates and visual identity (not needing full creative direction for every asset).

- Comfortable with high content volume and fast turnaround in a deadline-driven environment.

- Asset management: organising, logging, and archiving raw footage from shoots, influencer sends, studio days, and campaigns.

- Collaboration: working closely with digital and Social/Content teams, following briefs, and turning around feedback quickly.

- Sound design & music licensing awareness for social (royalty-free / trending-sound workarounds).

- Basic photography/videography for supplementary content on set, in office, or in store.



How to apply

Apply with your CV, portfolio/reel link, and brief answers:

1) Confirm fluent spoken and written English for an Australian creative team (Yes/No).

2) Share your best social-first video portfolio/reel (fashion/lifestyle/DTC preferred).

3) Which tools do you use day-to-day (Adobe, CapCut, After Effects, Figma, Canva, others)?

4) Describe a high-volume or fast-turnaround edit you owned end-to-end.

5) Confirm you can work Mon–Fri 9:00am–5:00pm AU hours at US$280 per week. Earliest start date?



Shortlisted applicants will complete a brief screen and meet the team. Applications are being reviewed now.

title: Finance Manager for a UK-based CFO
description:
A CFO overseeing a portfolio of five fast-growing, product-based and retail brands across the UK is looking to build up the capability of the finance function properly, not just keep it running as is.



Right now, the CFO handles the bulk of the accounting personally, bookkeeping through to forecasting, across all five businesses. We're hiring a Finance Manager to take full ownership of that function and build it into something stronger, working closely with the CFO.



This is a senior, hands-on role built around real ownership, not a narrow, single-client bookkeeping job. The portfolio is a focused set of five brands, sized deliberately so the role is about doing the work well, not managing volume.



Because the five businesses vary in size, sector and complexity, the scope of this role will shift as needs change. You'll need to be comfortable adapting to what each one requires rather than working from a fixed, unchanging list of tasks.



Important



This role isn't suited to someone who wants to keep their head down and do the basics. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of problems from discovery through to resolution, who questions how things are done and pushes for a better way when something doesn't add up, and who can hold a confident, informed conversation with the CFO about the numbers.



This is not a client-facing role. Your focus is on building and running the finance function itself.



What You'll Be Responsible For

1. Financial Reporting & Accounting

- Month-end close and management reporting across multiple client accounts

- Maintaining accurate financial records and reconciliations

- Supporting year-end accounting

2. Inventory & Operational Finance

- Inventory and landed cost accounting

- Retail deductions and operational finance support

- Managing and reconciling large datasets across multiple systems

3. Forecasting & Analysis

- Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts and cash flow projections

- Investigating and resolving discrepancies and variances independently

- Ad hoc financial and operational analysis

4. Process & Relationship Ownership

- Improving finance processes and workflows across the portfolio

- Running the day-to-day finance function with minimal oversight

- Representing the numbers with confidence when speaking with founders and stakeholders



What We're Looking For

- Proven experience running a finance function independently, not just contributing to one within a larger team

- Experience managing the finance function across multiple client accounts or entities at once, comfortable prioritising and moving between businesses of different sizes and complexity

- Genuine hands-on experience building management accounts and forecasts from scratch

- Comfortable producing forward-looking analysis and insight, not only reviewing and flagging issues in bookkeeping

- Strong accounting background with real exposure to product-based or inventory-heavy businesses

- Hands-on experience with inventory accounting, landed costs, reconciliations and operational finance workflows

- Experience with Amazon or e-commerce accounting operations and large transaction datasets

- Fluent in tools such as Xero, Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online and BI or reporting platforms

- CPA preferred or other similar certifications

- A confident, articulate communicator who is comfortable pushing back and defending their analysis with sound reasoning

- Naturally investigative, someone who wants to understand a business well enough to question its numbers, not simply record them

- Retail or wholesale accounting experience is a strong advantage



Working Setup

This is a fully remote, full-time position working UK business hours. To be considered for this role, you must have:

- A reliable computer suitable for remote work

- A fast, stable primary internet connection, with a backup option available in case of an outage

- A quiet, professional workspace free from background noise and interruptions

- A good quality headset for clear communication

- A dedicated work environment where you can attend meetings and work without distractions



What Success Looks Like In This Role

Success in this role means leadership can confidently rely on you to own the numbers, reporting, forecasting, and finance operations without needing constant oversight.

title: Construction Estimator / Bid Coordinator
description:
We are hiring an experienced Construction Estimator / Bid Coordinator to support a growing U.S.-based construction and facilities services company.



This is a hands-on construction role covering two major workstreams:



1. Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Supporting federal, state, and municipal solicitations as a prime contractor.



2. General Contractor / Subcontractor Bids

Preparing bids for self-performed construction and facility services for national and regional general contractors.



This is not a general administrative or data-entry position. You will work directly with construction documents, specifications, subcontractors, general contractors, pricing, bid requirements, and multiple active opportunities simultaneously.



The client typically has 6–10 active pursuits running in parallel, across multiple U.S. states, each with its own scope, documentation, subcontractors, and deadlines.



We are looking for someone with genuine construction estimating experience who can take ownership of the bid process with minimal supervision.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Government / Prime Contractor Bids

Monitor 
 and other U.S. procurement portals for relevant solicitations.

Track amendments, Q&A deadlines, site visits, and bid submission deadlines.

Review PWS, SOWs, specifications, drawings, and solicitation documents.

Extract scope requirements, forms, certifications, submittals, deadlines, and compliance requirements.

Identify required trades and subcontractors.

Research and source qualified subcontractors in the project geography, including unfamiliar markets.

Contact subcontractors by phone and
 to discuss scope and obtain pricing.

Communicate scope requirements, site requirements, payment terms, personnel requirements, and quote deadlines.

Collect, organize, compare, and evaluate subcontractor proposals.

Identify exclusions, scope gaps, pricing inconsistencies, and items requiring clarification.

Follow up persistently with subcontractors to obtain quotes before internal deadlines.

Prepare bid schedules, unit-price tables, and required government forms accurately and on time.



Phone outreach is a significant part of this position. You must be comfortable speaking directly with U.S. subcontractors and contractors.



General Contractor / GC Bids



The client also bids self-performed work directly to national and regional general contractors, including:



Post-construction cleaning

Rough and final cleaning

Interior and exterior glass

Pressure washing

Division 9 and Division 10 scopes

Related facility and finishing services



You will:



Monitor invitations to bid through
 and GC bid platforms.

Review ITBs, plans, specifications, and project schedules.

Identify the complete scope of work, including requirements located in other specification sections.

Complete GC bid forms accurately, including alternates, unit prices, allowances, sales tax treatment, bond and insurance requirements, union status, parking requirements, and project-specific exhibits.

Prepare and submit proposals to GC estimating and preconstruction contacts.

Confirm receipt of submitted bids.

Follow up consistently with GCs until the opportunity is awarded or closed.

Track bid-date changes, competitiveness, expected award timing, and feedback.

Maintain a live log of outstanding GC quotes, including project, GC, contact, value, submission date, last contact, next follow-up date, and status.

Support scope clarification and change-order documentation on awarded projects.



ESTIMATING & BID COORDINATION



Across both workstreams, you will:



Review lengthy construction documents and quickly identify critical requirements.

Extract and organize information from complex project documents.

Build and maintain multi-tab Excel pricing workbooks.

Use linked formulas properly rather than hardcoding values where formulas belong.

Verify that inputs flow correctly through dependent tabs before submission.

Maintain accurate estimating, bid, subcontractor, and quote records.

Manage multiple active bids and competing deadlines simultaneously.

Communicate professionally with subcontractors, vendors, GCs, contracting officers, and other stakeholders.

Use AI and other technology tools to improve document review, research, sourcing, and estimating workflows.



CONFIDENTIALITY & DOCUMENT CONTROL



Confidentiality is a non-negotiable requirement of this role.



You will be expected to:



Properly redact solicitation numbers, agency/end-client identities, and project-identifying information from documents before subcontractor outreach when required.

Ensure unredacted project details are released only when authorized.

Clearly identify documents as internal or external before sending them outside the company.

Ensure client-facing documents contain only approved billing information.

Never disclose internal cost data, margins, payroll information, or other confidential information to clients, GCs, or subcontractors.

Properly communicate and enforce non-circumvention requirements in subcontractor correspondence.



REMOTE WORK & HUBSTAFF



This is a fully remote position supporting a U.S.-based construction client.



Hubstaff will be used for time tracking and work activity monitoring.



You must be comfortable working independently in a structured remote environment and maintaining consistent productivity during scheduled U.S. business hours.



You are expected to:



Accurately track working hours through Hubstaff.

Remain available during agreed working hours.

Maintain reliable communication with the client and team.

Respond promptly to time-sensitive bid and subcontractor matters.

Meet deadlines without constant follow-up.

Take ownership of assigned bids from start to finish.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

5+ years of experience in construction estimating, bid coordination, construction procurement, or a closely related role.

Demonstrated experience reading and interpreting PWS, SOWs, specifications, plans, or other construction documents.

Hands-on experience sourcing subcontractors and discussing scope and pricing by phone.

Strong Excel skills, particularly multi-tab workbooks with linked formulas.

Strong spoken and written English.

Professional and confident phone presence.

Experience managing multiple bids, deadlines, and stakeholders simultaneously.

Strong organization and follow-through.

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Availability during U.S. business hours across multiple time zones.

Ability to make and receive calls through a U.S.-reachable phone number.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



The following are a strong advantage:



Experience with federal procurement and 
.

Familiarity with CLIN structures, set-asides, bid schedules, and wage determinations.

Knowledge of Service Contract Act (SCA) and Davis-Bacon requirements.

Experience with GC bid invitation platforms.

Experience with post-construction cleaning, Division 9/10 trades, or facility services.

Experience performing quantity takeoffs from drawings.

Familiarity with Bluebeam or construction estimating software.

Experience using AI tools for document review, research, sourcing, or estimating.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



We're looking for a construction professional who can hit the ground running.



You should be someone who:



Understands construction documents rather than simply processing them.

Can identify scope gaps and potential issues.

Is comfortable speaking directly with U.S. contractors and subcontractors.

Can source subcontractors in unfamiliar markets.

Can evaluate and normalize competing quotes.

Can manage several active bids without losing track of deadlines.

Follows up proactively instead of waiting for responses.

Takes ownership and keeps the bid pipeline moving.

Knows when to make a recommendation and when to escalate a decision.



If your experience is primarily administrative or data-entry based, this is not the right role.



If you have genuine construction estimating experience and enjoy the challenge of getting bids across the finish line, we want to hear from you.



SCOPE OF AUTHORITY



You will own the estimating and bid coordination process, but you will not have final authority over pricing or contractual commitments.



You will prepare, organize, analyze, and recommend, but you will not:



Set final pricing or margins.

Make final bid/no-bid decisions.

Sign or commit the company to a subcontractor, general contractor, or government agency.



The expectation is ownership of the process, not authority over the final number.



SELECTION PROCESS



Shortlisted candidates will be evaluated through practical work samples, not interview answers alone.



Candidates may be asked to complete:



1. Document Extraction Exercise



Given a 40–60 page PWS, produce a one-page summary within one hour identifying:



Scope

Required trades

Submittals and forms

Site visit date

Q&A deadline

Bid due date, time, and time zone



2. Subcontractor Outreach Exercise



Given a live solicitation, prepare the outreach package you would use to contact subcontractors.



3. Quote Normalization Exercise



Given three subcontractor quotes with different inclusions, exclusions, and units, prepare an apples-to-apples comparison and identify the questions you would send back to each subcontractor.



4. Live Call / Role Play



Participate in a short scope and pricing call to assess your communication skills and phone presence.



APPLICATION QUESTION



Please answer this question in your application:



Walk us through the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on. What was the project, what was your role, and what did you personally produce?



Please provide specific details about your hands-on work. Generic descriptions of your previous employer's responsibilities will not be sufficient.



READY TO TAKE OWNERSHIP OF THE BID PROCESS?



If you have real construction estimating experience, strong construction document skills, confidence communicating with U.S. contractors, and the ability to manage multiple bids independently, we'd like to hear from you.



To apply:



Complete the application form.

Upload your updated CV.

Submit your short introduction video.

Answer the application question about the most recent federal solicitation or GC bid package you personally worked on.



Please be specific about your hands-on experience. We are looking for someone who has actually worked on construction bids—not someone who has only provided general administrative support.



Apply Here –

title: Luxury Client Success Manager — Retention, Engagement & Experience
description:
Type of Work: Full-Time

Hours: 40 hours per week

Starting Compensation: $1,500 per month

90-Day Compensation: Eligible to increase to $2,200 per month following a successful performance review and consistent achievement of KPIs



Job Overview



This is not a passive customer service role.



Bonding Biology Institute™ is seeking a highly organized, emotionally intelligent, and proactive Client Success Manager who will take full ownership of the client experience after enrollment.



Your primary responsibility is to ensure our clients feel seen, supported, valued, and actively engaged throughout their Love Success Journey™. You will monitor their progress, anticipate concerns, identify disengagement before it becomes a cancellation, and coordinate with our team to ensure each client receives an elevated, personalized experience.



Our clients should never have to disappear before we realize they needed support.



The right person will notice the silence, investigate the problem, take initiative, and follow through until it is resolved. You must be a self-starter who does not wait to be told what needs attention.



This role requires leadership, excellent judgment, meticulous tracking, emotional intelligence, and the ability to turn client information into decisive action.



Your Primary Mission



Your mission is to increase client engagement, satisfaction, retention, and long-term success by ensuring that every client:



- Receives a smooth and welcoming onboarding experience

- Understands what to do next in her journey

- Feels personally recognized and supported

- Remains engaged with classes, assignments, the app, and the community

- Receives proactive outreach when engagement declines

- Has concerns addressed thoroughly and promptly

- Experiences consistent follow-through from our team

- Continues progressing toward her desired transformation



Key Responsibilities



Own the Client Journey



- Oversee each client’s experience from enrollment through onboarding, participation, completion, renewal, or ascension

- Ensure every new client receives the correct welcome materials, agreements, login credentials, orientation information, schedules, and next steps

- Conduct proactive client check-ins at key milestones

- Make sure no client becomes lost, confused, inactive, or overlooked

- Maintain a clear understanding of where every client is in her journey



Track Client Health and Engagement



- Maintain an accurate client success dashboard or CRM

- Track onboarding completion, attendance, app activity, homework participation, community engagement, support requests, client sentiment, and progress

- Identify early warning signs such as missed classes, declining participation, unresolved concerns, negative feedback, or prolonged inactivity

- Create and execute recovery plans for at-risk or disengaged clients

- Document every important interaction, concern, action taken, responsible team member, deadline, and resolution



Increase Retention and Prevent Avoidable Cancellations



- Proactively contact clients who are becoming inactive or disconnected

- Determine the actual reason behind disengagement rather than accepting surface-level answers

- Help clients reconnect with their goals, program expectations, and next steps

- Coordinate additional support when appropriate

- Identify patterns that may be affecting retention and recommend solutions

- Support continuation, renewal, and ascension opportunities through excellent service and relationship-building



Create a Luxury Client Experience



- Ensure every interaction feels warm, polished, personal, responsive, and professional

- Learn relevant client details so communication does not feel generic or transactional

- Recognize progress, birthdays, milestones, wins, and meaningful breakthroughs

- Make clients feel remembered—not processed

- Handle sensitive situations with empathy, composure, discretion, and strong boundaries

- Escalate complaints, emotional concerns, billing matters, or high-priority situations promptly



Lead Cross-Functional Follow-Through



- Serve as the connection point between clients, coaches, community support, operations, billing, and the technical team

- Assign clear ownership when another team member must resolve an issue

- Follow up until the issue is fully resolved and the client has received confirmation

- Hold internal team members accountable for client-related deadlines

- Lead client experience meetings and present clear priorities, risks, and recommended actions

- Never assume that an issue is resolved simply because it was forwarded to someone else



Strengthen Community Engagement



- Welcome new members and help them feel connected immediately

- Encourage meaningful participation in classes, assignments, community conversations, and accountability activities

- Identify members who need encouragement, recognition, or additional support

- Help create conversations that make the community feel active, intimate, and transformational

- Monitor the emotional tone of the community and address concerns before they escalate

- Work with the team to reactivate inactive members



Reporting and Improvement



- Submit accurate daily and weekly client success reports

- Report what happened, what action was taken, what remains unresolved, who owns the next step, and when it will be completed

- Monitor retention, engagement, attendance, response times, client concerns, and reactivation results

- Gather client feedback and identify recurring gaps in the client journey

- Recommend practical improvements to systems, communication, onboarding, programming, and support

- Take initiative to improve the client experience without waiting for repeated instructions



This Role Is for Someone Who



- Is a natural leader and takes ownership without being micromanaged

- Is exceptionally thorough and notices details others miss

- Follows through completely—not halfway

- Can recognize a potential problem before it becomes a crisis

- Is emotionally intelligent, warm, nurturing, and professionally firm

- Communicates clearly by phone, video,
, text, and direct message

- Is comfortable speaking with sophisticated, high-achieving clients

- Can balance compassion with standards and accountability

- Makes decisions, proposes solutions, and takes appropriate action

- Keeps immaculate notes, records, deadlines, and follow-up systems

- Can manage multiple clients and priorities without allowing details to fall through the cracks

- Understands that activity is not the same as results

- Is dependable, responsive, resourceful, and solution-oriented



This Role Is Not for Someone Who



- Waits to be reminded about responsibilities

- Only responds when a client complains

- Forwards problems without confirming they were resolved

- Submits vague reports without names, details, outcomes, or next steps

- Needs constant direction to determine what should happen next

- Avoids difficult conversations

- Becomes overwhelmed by multiple priorities

- Treats client success as basic administrative support



Preferred Experience



- Client success, account management, customer experience, member retention, or community leadership

- Coaching, wellness, personal development, relationship education, luxury services, or high-ticket programs

- Managing a client journey from onboarding through completion or renewal

- Using CRMs, spreadsheets, project-management systems, membership platforms, or community apps

- Handling escalations, reactivating disengaged clients, and preventing cancellations

- Understanding emotional regulation, attachment styles, psychology, feminine energy, or relationship dynamics is a bonus



KPIs and Success Metrics



Performance will be measured by:



- Client retention and continuation rates

- Successful onboarding completion

- Class attendance and participation

- App and community engagement

- Reactivation of inactive clients

- At-risk clients successfully recovered

- Response and resolution times

- Client satisfaction and feedback

- Accuracy and completeness of CRM records

- Completion of proactive client check-ins

- Timeliness and quality of daily and weekly reports

- Reduction in unresolved client concerns

- Quality of leadership, initiative, and team follow-through



Compensation and Growth



Compensation begins at $1,500 per month for the first 90 days.



Following a successful 90-day performance review, compensation may increase to $2,200 per month based on:



- Consistent achievement of agreed-upon KPIs

- Demonstrated leadership and independent decision-making

- Accurate client tracking and reporting

- Strong client retention and engagement results

- Reliability, responsiveness, and complete follow-through

- Ability to identify and solve problems proactively



This position offers meaningful advancement opportunities for someone who becomes a trusted leader and consistently improves the client experience.



About Bonding Biology Institute™



Bonding Biology Institute™ is a luxury love mastery and relationship technology company founded by Shay Levister, also known as Shay Your Love Diva.



Through HerPocketCoach™, AI-powered support systems, Love Blocks®, the Five Love Archetypes™, and the 7-Stage Love Framework™, we help high-achieving women heal unhealthy relationship patterns, elevate their self-worth, and attract emotionally healthy, commitment-minded love.



We are building the future of relationship transformation through psychology, neuroscience, feminine embodiment, artificial intelligence, and structured emotional growth systems.



How to Apply



Please submit to 



- Your current resume

- A short video introducing yourself and explaining why you are an excellent fit

- A description of your client success, retention, community, or account-management experience

- An example of a time you identified and solved a client problem without being instructed

- An example of how you helped retain or reactivate a dissatisfied or disengaged client

- The systems or tools you have used to track client activity, follow-up, and outcomes



Please also respond to this scenario:



A client has missed two classes, has not logged into the app for 10 days, and says she has simply been busy. Explain exactly what you would do next, how you would communicate with her, what you would document, and how you would ensure the situation was fully resolved.



Please confirm if your able to work full time and exclusively for the company. 



Applications that do not include all requested materials will not be considered.

title: Real Estate Dispositions Manager (Remote) - US$6/hour + Commission
description:

title: Executive Assistant & Founder Support VA - Full-Time
description:
THIS IS NOT A BASIC "DO WHATEVER I SEND YOU" VA JOB.



The $2 Bill Brand helps entrepreneurs, coaches, consultants, and experts become the recognized authority in their industry. Our founder, Brad Holcman, is building a business around a simple but powerful idea:



Do not be the best. Be the ONLY.



Brad has a lot of ideas, opportunities, commitments, projects, and responsibilities moving at once. He needs someone who is naturally organized and genuinely enjoys turning a messy stream of tasks, voice notes, meetings, and reminders into a calm, visible plan.



You will work directly with Brad as his Executive Assistant and Founder Support VA. Your job is to help make sure important business and personal commitments do not disappear, priorities are clear, follow-ups happen, the calendar supports what matters, and Brad knows what deserves his attention today.



This is a full-time, long-term role for someone who is hungry to learn, takes ownership, communicates clearly, and wants to become an indispensable right hand over time.



THE BASICS

Type of work: Full time, 40 hours per week

Pay: $500 USD per month

Start date: As soon as the right person is found

Location: Philippines

English level: Fluent / Advanced

Experience level: Intermediate to Advanced

Schedule: Full-time remote. Required weekday overlap of 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time. Remaining hours are flexible around agreed deliverables.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



1. Run the founder's daily operating system

You will collect tasks and ideas from messages, meetings, voice notes,
, and conversations. You will put them into one organized task system, clarify deadlines and next actions, and keep a close eye on what is due, stuck, or forgotten.



Each workday, you will prepare a short founder brief with the day's highest priorities, calendar, deadlines, follow-ups, and decisions needed. At the end of the day, you will close loops and prepare the next day so nothing important is lost.



2. Protect the calendar and inbox

You will help organize Brad's Google Calendar, schedule and reschedule meetings, add preparation details, protect focused work time, avoid conflicts, and make sure important meetings have the right information attached.



You will help organize
 and messages under agreed rules. You will flag urgent items, draft simple replies when appropriate, track waiting-on responses, and make sure people are not left without an answer. You will never send sensitive communications or make commitments without clear approval rules.



3. Keep business projects and follow-ups moving

You will track important priorities across our content, marketing, coaching, client, and team work. You will follow up with people, maintain simple status views, convert meeting notes into next actions, and alert Brad early when something needs a decision or is at risk of slipping.



You are not expected to do every specialized job in the company. Your responsibility is to make sure requests, deadlines, and decisions do not get lost.



4. Support approved personal logistics

With clear privacy boundaries, you may help research and coordinate personal appointments, travel options, family-calendar reminders, gifting, reservations, orders and returns, and other practical logistics that protect Brad's time. You will always ask before making purchases, sharing sensitive information, or doing anything outside pre-approved rules.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

First 30 days: You create one clean task/follow-up system, learn Brad's preferences, establish the daily brief, improve calendar habits, and begin reliably capturing actions from meetings and messages.



Days 31-60: You run a consistent weekly priority review, keep a forward-looking calendar view, track key projects, and proactively close routine communication loops.



Days 61-90: Brad trusts the system. He knows his priorities, important commitments are anticipated, and business and personal logistics are more organized with fewer reminders coming from him.



WHO WILL DO WELL HERE

You have at least one year of meaningful administrative, executive-support, operations-support, or project-coordination experience. You may have supported a founder, manager, small business owner, agency owner, or executive.



You do not need to have been a Chief of Staff. But you must be able to explain the system you personally used to stay organized.



You have excellent written and spoken English. You are highly reliable, calm under pressure, discreet, detail-oriented, comfortable using Google Workspace, and not afraid to ask a clear question when the next step is ambiguous.



Experience with Google Calendar, Gmail, Google Drive, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, Trello, Slack, WhatsApp, Zoom, travel research, and AI productivity tools is helpful. Strong judgment, follow-through, and communication matter more than knowing every tool.



SKILLS THAT MATTER FOR THIS ROLE

Executive assistance, administrative support, calendar management,
 management, task management, project coordination, personal assistance, Google Workspace, Google Calendar, Gmail, meeting management, online research, documentation, written English, problem solving, ClickUp, Asana, Notion, travel planning, AI productivity tools.



THIS ROLE IS NOT A FIT IF

Do not apply if you want a passive role where you simply wait for a written list of tasks. Do not apply if you cannot reliably work the required Eastern-Time overlap, have unstable internet without a backup plan, or are uncomfortable handling confidential business and personal information with maturity.



We are not looking for someone to be on call 24/7, perform every specialized function in the company, or make financial or personal decisions without approval. We are looking for a proactive, reliable assistant who wants to grow into a true right-hand support role.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with this exact phrase:



I am the Operating System.



Applications without that phrase will not be considered.



Please include ALL of the following:



1. Your resume or OnlineJobs profile and a short explanation of whom you supported in your most relevant role.



2. A two-minute Loom or video introduction. Tell us about the messiest workload you had to organize and the system you used.



3. In 250 words or fewer, answer this question: A founder sends scattered voice notes, three meeting requests, two personal reminders, and five urgent-looking
s. What do you do first, and what does your end-of-day update look like?



4. A redacted example of a tracker, agenda, calendar-preparation template, daily plan, or follow-up system you created. Never share confidential prior-employer information.



5. Your availability in Philippines Time, confirmation of the Eastern-Time overlap, internet backup plan, and expected monthly pay.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid US$20 practical exercise involving a fictional task dump and calendar. We will evaluate how you prioritize, ask questions, organize follow-ups, and communicate, not how fancy your design is.



WHY JOIN US

You will work directly with a founder who cares about growth, creativity, and building something that stands out. This is an opportunity to become a trusted part of a small, ambitious business and grow in responsibility as you prove yourself.

title: PR & Communications Executive
description:
Hi there!



I run a small communications consultancy working with corporate and consumer brands, and I’m looking for an experienced **PR & Communications Executive** to work alongside me across client projects.



This is a hands-on role covering communications, content and project management. I’m looking for someone who already has PR or communications experience, ideally within an agency or in-house communications team, so this isn’t a role where I’ll be teaching the basics from scratch.



You don’t need to be senior, but you do need to understand the work. If I give you a client brief, background documents or even a slightly chaotic set of notes, I’d like you to be able to make sense of them, do the research, ask the right questions and get a strong first draft moving.



**Working hours: 2–10 PM Manila time, Monday–Friday**



You’ll need to be consistently available during these hours as you’ll be working alongside me on active client projects.



### What You’ll Help Me With



**PR & Content**



* Drafting press releases, LinkedIn posts, internal communications, articles and other content

* Researching topics, companies, industries, media and potential story angles

* Turning briefs, notes and background materials into strong first drafts

* Proofreading and editing content

* Preparing briefing documents and other communications materials

* Supporting media relations activity and coordinating with external partners where needed



**Project Management**



* Keeping track of multiple client projects, deadlines and deliverables

* Maintaining project trackers and content calendars

* Following up on outstanding actions, feedback and approvals

* Keeping briefs, files and working documents organised

* Helping coordinate designers, suppliers and other partners

* Spotting what needs to happen next and helping keep projects moving



**Presentations & General Support**



* Creating and polishing PowerPoint and Canva presentations

* Supporting research and new-business proposals

* Helping prepare reports, meeting notes and other client materials

* General communications and project support when needed



### You’ll Do Well in This Role If You:



* Have at least 2 years of hands-on PR, communications, content or agency experience

* Have excellent written and spoken English

* Can write clear, natural copy and adapt your writing for different audiences

* Understand how press releases, corporate communications and social content work

* Are highly organised and comfortable managing several deadlines at once

* Have strong attention to detail

* Can work independently and use good judgement

* Ask questions when something isn’t clear

* Take initiative rather than waiting to be told every individual step

* Are reliable and follow through on what you say you’ll do



You should also be comfortable using AI tools. I use them myself, so I have no problem with AI being part of your workflow. But I do need someone who can think, research, write and edit independently rather than simply submitting AI-generated copy.



### Bonus Points



* PR agency experience

* Corporate communications experience

* Experience working with international brands

* Media relations experience

* Strong PowerPoint or Canva skills

* Experience managing multiple client accounts or projects



### What You Can Expect



* Direct and supportive collaboration

* Interesting work across different clients and industries

* The opportunity to take on more ownership as we build trust

* Steady, long-term work with room to grow

* Competitive pay based on experience



I’m hoping to find someone who can become a genuine long-term support to the business. Over time, I’d like to be able to hand over increasingly substantial pieces of work and trust you to get them moving.



### How to Apply



Please send:



* A short introduction telling me about your PR/communications experience

* Your CV or LinkedIn profile
