title: SEO & SEM Specialist
description:
SEO & SEM Specialist



Location: Remote, working with a Singapore-based team  



Employment type: Full-time, 44 hours per week / 176 hours per month  



Working hours: Monday to Friday, 1:00pm to 9:00pm Singapore time  



Reporting to: Senior SEO Manager and CEO  



Experience required: 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience. Singapore education, tuition or local-service experience is strongly preferred.



About Achievers Dream

- Achievers Dream is a Singapore Chemistry and Science tuition specialist. The centre supports Primary Science students and students taking O-Level, IP and JC H1/H2 Chemistry, with centres at Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan. Its growth focus is clear: help more parents discover the right programme, book a diagnostic consultation or trial, and receive a thoughtful follow-up experience.



Role overview

- The SEO & SEM Specialist will own the search roadmap for Achievers Dream. This is a hands-on role covering technical SEO, local SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), Answer Engine Optimisation (AEO), content optimisation, Google Ads, landing-page conversion and performance reporting.



You will work closely with the management, content and web teams to make sure Achievers Dream is visible when Singapore parents search for Primary Science tuition, PSLE Science tuition, O-Level Chemistry tuition, JC H2 Chemistry tuition, Chemistry practical tuition and local tuition options near its centres.



The role is not just about traffic or clicks. It is about building a reliable search engine that produces qualified parent enquiries, trial bookings and measurable learning-programme demand.



What you will do



SEO strategy and execution

- Build and maintain an SEO roadmap for Achievers Dream's core programmes: Primary Science, PSLE Science, Lower Secondary Science, O-Level Chemistry, IP Chemistry, JC H1/H2 Chemistry and Chemistry practical lessons.

- Carry out keyword research, search-intent mapping and competitor analysis for the Singapore tuition market.

- Optimise service pages, location pages, resource hubs, blog content, titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal links and calls to action.

- Improve local SEO visibility for Lorong Chuan, Bukit Timah and Kembangan, including Google Business Profile hygiene, location-page content and review signals.

- Work with the web team on technical SEO: crawlability, page speed, Core Web Vitals, redirects, canonicals, structured data, mobile UX and site migrations.

- Build content briefs that help parents and students, while improving eligibility for search results and AI-assisted search experiences.

- Own GEO and AEO improvements so Achievers Dream is easier to understand, cite and recommend across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity and other answer engines, using clear entity information, helpful FAQs, structured content and accurate on-page proof.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, indexed pages, technical issues and AI-search visibility; translate findings into a prioritised monthly action plan.



Google Ads and paid-search performance

- Build, manage and optimise Google Ads campaigns for Achievers Dream's programmes and locations.

- Structure campaigns by intent and level, for example: Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC H2 Chemistry, Chemistry Lab and local branch terms.

- Write and test search ads, assets, landing-page messages, audience signals, keyword match types and negative-keyword lists.

- Improve qualified leads by monitoring search terms, conversion quality, cost per lead, cost per booked trial and campaign-level performance.

- Run disciplined A/B tests across ads, landing pages, offers,- forms, calls to action and bidding strategies.

- Coordinate retargeting and paid social support where it is part of the approved campaign plan.

- Protect budget quality by excluding irrelevant searches such as free notes, tutor jobs, answer keys and non-target education levels where appropriate.



Analytics, reporting and conversion tracking

- Maintain reliable tracking across Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console and lead or trial-booking forms.

- Define and report the conversion journey from click to enquiry, booked trial, attendance and enrolment where CRM data is available.

- Build a simple monthly dashboard for management covering organic visibility, paid spend, qualified enquiries, cost per lead, conversion rate, booked trials and key actions taken.

- Diagnose drops or anomalies before making recommendations; clearly distinguish confirmed first-party results from platform estimates.

- Use Ahrefs, Google Ads Keyword Planner, Google Search Console, GA4, Looker Studio and crawling tools to guide decisions.



Collaboration and ownership

- Work directly with management, teachers, content writers and developers to turn search insights into better pages, campaigns and parent journeys.

- Maintain a clear backlog of SEO, SEM, content and technical actions, including owner, priority, expected impact and validation method.

- Keep up with Google Ads policy changes, search algorithm updates, local-search behaviour and AI-assisted search trends.

- Bring practical recommendations, not just reports. Explain what should change, why it matters, who owns it and how success will be measured.



What we are looking for



Required

- 3+ years of hands-on SEO and Google Ads experience.

- Proven ability to manage search campaigns that generate leads, not just clicks.

- Strong technical SEO knowledge: site architecture, redirects, canonicals, indexation, page speed, Core Web Vitals, schema and internal linking.

- Strong Google Ads experience across search campaigns, keyword strategy, bidding, search-term analysis, conversion tracking and landing-page optimisation.

- Comfort using GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Ahrefs, Looker Studio and spreadsheet-based analysis.

- Strong written English and the ability to write clear, parent-friendly search ads, briefs and reporting summaries.

- Analytical discipline: can explain the difference between a ranking, a click, an enquiry, a booked trial and an enrolled student.

- Organised, proactive and comfortable working independently in a remote team.



Strongly preferred

- Experience in Singapore local SEO, education, tuition, enrichment, healthcare or another parent-led local-service market.

- Experience optimising Google Business Profiles and multi-location local search.

- Experience working with WordPress, Astro or another modern CMS.

- Familiarity with CRM or lead-management workflows and offline conversion tracking.

- Experience producing or briefing educational content for Primary, PSLE, O-Level or JC audiences.

- Experience with GEO, AEO, AI-search visibility, entity optimisation or structured content for answer engines.



First 90 days

| Period | Focus | Expected output |

| Days 1 to 30 | Audit and foundation | Access and tracking review, SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads audit, keyword map, priority opportunity list, lead-quality baseline and 90-day execution plan. |

| Days 31 to 60 | Launch and optimise | Rebuilt or improved campaign structure, negative-keyword controls, priority landing-page improvements, local SEO actions and first content or technical tickets shipped. |

| Days 61 to 90 | Scale what works | Documented test learnings, conversion-quality review, a prioritised next-quarter roadmap and a management dashboard with agreed reporting definitions. |



KPIs for success



KPIs will be agreed after access, tracking and baseline data are verified. Likely measures include:

- Growth in qualified parent enquiries and booked trials from organic and paid search.

- Improvement in cost per qualified lead and cost per booked trial, where tracking is reliable.

- Visibility and ranking progress for agreed commercial keywords across Primary Science, PSLE Science, O-Level Chemistry, JC Chemistry and local branch terms.

- Organic clicks, impressions and conversion contribution from Google Search Console and GA4.

- Google Ads search-term quality, click-through rate, conversion rate and budget efficiency.

- Completion of agreed technical, content and landing-page priorities.

- Clear monthly reporting with recommendations, owners and follow-up actions.



Application process



Before submitting your resume, please include a concise 90-day draft plan for how you would improve Achievers Dream's SEO, GEO/AEO and Google Ads performance. This can be a one- to two-page document. We are looking for clear priorities, practical actions and how you would measure progress, not a generic proposal.



Please submit:



1. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.

2. Your 90-day draft plan, submitted together with your resume.

3. A short summary of one SEO project and one Google Ads project you personally improved.

4. A sample dashboard, report or case study, with sensitive client data removed.

5. A short response to this question: How would you approach improving qualified trial bookings for a Singapore Primary Science and Chemistry tuition centre in your first 90 days?



Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a paid practical assessment based on an anonymised Achievers Dream landing page or Google Ads account scenario.

title: Virtual Assistant, SEO Delivery
description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a part-time Virtual Assistant who sits in every meeting, captures what was agreed, and then makes sure it actually happens. The core of this job is follow-up. You will chase internal team members and external clients until tasks are closed, and you will surface a blockage early rather than reporting it after the deadline has passed.



You need enough SEO knowledge to understand what is being chased and who owns it, and to ask a sensible clarifying question in the room rather than nodding along and getting it wrong later. Admin experience helps but is not a requirement.



Engagement Terms

- Part-time, remote, paid hourly or on a fixed monthly retainer.

- You attend all scheduled internal and client meetings.

- You must be available 30 minutes before and 30 minutes after every meeting. The before block is for prep: last meeting's notes, the open action list, and anything we owe the client that is late. The after block is for output: notes circulated same day and the first round of follow-ups sent immediately, not tomorrow.

- Meeting times follow the client, so many sit within Singapore hours but some will not. You need to be flexible outside a fixed daytime schedule.

- Once you have applied with the subject line I'm your star VA and cleared the interview, you will be added to a WhatsApp group and the relevant client Slack channels.



Key Responsibilities

- Meeting support

- Ask clarifying questions during the meeting when an action item is vague, unowned or undated.

- Prepare the pre-meeting brief in the 30 minutes before: agenda, open items and their current status, and anything overdue on our side.

- Circulate notes in the 30 minutes after, structured as decisions, action items with an owner and a date, and open questions.

Follow-up and chasing

- Follow up with internal stakeholders (writers, editors, SEO specialists, developers) on task status against the agreed dates.

- Follow up with external stakeholders (clients, client-side dev and marketing teams, guest post contacts) for approvals, website access, content sign-off, information and assets.

- Maintain one live tracker of every open item with owner, date requested, date promised, next chase date and status.

- Escalate to the account lead once a chase has failed twice, with a one-line summary of what is stuck and what it is blocking. Do not simply forward the
 thread.

- Flag risk in writing before a deadline is missed, not after.

- Admin support

- Calendar management, scheduling and rescheduling across the team.

- Maintaining trackers, folder structure and file naming in Google Drive.

- Formatting and tidying decks, reports and documents.

- Light data entry into Google Sheets and the project management tool.



Preferred Skills

- Working knowledge of SEO. You do not need to run campaigns, but you should understand on-page, off-page and technical -SEO, what a brief is, what a meta title does, and roughly why rankings take time.

- Confident, persistent follow-up. You are comfortable chasing people more senior than you and clients who have gone quiet.

- Excellent written English. Your notes and chase messages go directly to clients.

- Clear spoken English, since you will be asking questions live on client calls.

- Strong organisation. One tracker, kept current, with nothing held only in your head.

- Google Sheets: filters, sorting, conditional formatting. VLOOKUP or XLOOKUP is a bonus.

- Familiarity with a project management tool (Asana, ClickUp, Trello, Monday or Notion).

- Experience with Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, GA4 or Looker Studio, even at a viewing level.

- Reliable internet with a backup connection, a quiet working space, and a plan for power outages.

title: DTC Creative Strategist – Meta Ads
description:
We’re an established DTC kids/family brand selling across the US and Europe, looking for an experienced Creative Strategist to take ownership of our Meta creative strategy.



We already have graphic designers, static ad designers and video editors ready to execute.



What we’re missing is the creative brain behind them.



Right now, the founder handles creative strategy. We’re looking for someone who can eventually take this off his plate and own the question:



What should we test next, and why?



WHAT YOU’LL DO



You’ll own the full creative strategy loop:



Research -> Insight -> Angle -> Concept -> Brief -> Launch -> Analyse -> Iterate



Your responsibilities will include:



* Researching customers, competitors, reviews, Reddit, Meta Ad Library, winning DTC brands and our own post-purchase survey data from real customers

* Turning real customer responses and voice-of-customer data into new desires, pain points, personas, hooks and untapped creative angles

* Developing creative concepts for Meta across statics, native ads, UGC, video and long-form ads

* Writing hooks, headlines, scripts, primary copy and clear creative briefs

* Giving our designers and editors clear direction on what to create and why

* Analysing creative performance and identifying why an ad won or lost

* Turning performance insights into the next round of creative tests

* Iterating winning angles and concepts instead of constantly starting from zero





WHAT YOU NEED TO UNDERSTAND



We’re looking for someone with real DTC/e-commerce and Meta advertising experience.



You should have a strong understanding of:



* Direct-response marketing

* Consumer psychology

* Customer awareness stages

* Funnel stages

* Market sophistication

* Voice-of-customer research

* Personas, desires, pain points and objections

* Angles, hooks, mechanisms and offers

* Creative testing and iteration

* Meta creative performance metrics

* Static, native, UGC, video and long-form advertising



You should understand that an unaware prospect needs different messaging from someone who is problem-aware, solution-aware or already product-aware, and be able to build creative strategy around those differences.



You should also understand how creative and messaging should change across different stages of the funnel.



And we want someone who stays on top of what is happening NOW:



* Meta advertising developments

* DTC creative strategy

* New ad formats and creative trends

* AI-assisted creative and research

* Changes in consumer behaviour

* New direct-response strategies and frameworks



We don’t want someone applying the exact same creative playbook they learned three years ago.





THIS IS NOT A DESIGNER OR VIDEO EDITOR ROLE



We already have the execution team.



You don’t need to spend your day in Photoshop, Canva, CapCut or Premiere.



Your job is to d
:



* What should we create?

* Who are we speaking to?

* What desire or problem are we targeting?

* What awareness stage are they in?

* What funnel stage are they in?

* What angle should we use?

* What should the hook be?

* Why should this concept work?

* What did we learn after testing it?

* What should we test next?



We don’t need more ads.



We need better creative decisions.





WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You’ll probably be a great fit if:



* You’ve developed Meta creative strategy for DTC/e-commerce brands

* You can explain WHY an ad works, not just whether it performed

* You’re strong at customer research and can turn raw voice-of-customer data into non-obvious creative insights and angles

* You understand both creative psychology and performance data

* You can turn research into clear, executable creative briefs

* You can recognise winning patterns and build new iterations from them

* You actively follow the latest developments in Meta and performance marketing

* You have excellent written English

* You think independently and challenge your own assumptions with data

* You’re genuinely obsessed with advertising, psychology and why people buy





HOW TO APPLY



Don’t just send us a CV.



Send something that shows us HOW YOU THINK.



For example:



1. A creative brief you wrote and why you structured it that way



2. A Meta ad or concept you personally developed that you’d defend, including the strategy behind it



3. A winning creative you developed and any performance data you can share



4. A teardown of a Meta ad explaining the audience, awareness stage, angle, hook, psychology and why you believe it works



Please also include:



* Your portfolio

* Examples of DTC Meta ads you personally strategized

* Any performance results you can share (spend, CPA, ROAS, CTR, revenue, etc.)

* Your exact role in those creatives

* Your expected monthly salary in USD



We care much more about how you THINK than how impressive your CV looks.



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid creative strategy test.



We’re looking for someone long-term who can eventually take full ownership of creative strategy and become a key part of our growth team.

title: Instagram Followers Growth Content Strategist
description:
About us



We are a coaching practice working with high achievers who might look like they have it all on the outside but feel privately stuck, stressed, anxious, unfulfilled, or disconnected. 



Our work helps them come back to themselves and build a life that actually works across all the areas that count: mental and physical health, business, relationships, and lifestyle. Our approach is based on neuroscience, nervous system work, psychology, and ancient wisdom.



We are building this into something bigger. A practice, a body of work, and a community of people who want to live with more depth, clarity, and aliveness. The social media presence on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube is a core part of how we reach the people we are meant to work with.



We are looking for someone who feels drawn to this mission and wants to be part of building it with us. Experience or at least strong interest in the field of mental health, neuroscience, and/or nervous system work is a big plus.





Youtube: 



## The role



You will work closely with Patrice and Chloé as the person who proactively researches and generates fresh ideas for posts every week, leads the content team, posts the content, analyzes the results and reports them once a month. For now organic only, we are not working with paid marketing. 



Our goal is to go from 9,000 followers (Instagram) to 50,000 by December 2026.



You will lead a small content team: our scriptwriter writes what you brief, our video editor produces it, Patrice records it. You own the process, the plan and the numbers.



This is a role that starts at 10 hours per week and grows. We are ideally looking for someone who wants to grow into a larger role over time, in stages, as the business expands and as we get to know each other and both feel it is a good fit.



## What you will do



- Understand our work: Finding the best positioning, learning our coaching method, the theory behind it, target group, core topics and guidelines are documented. You should be able to explain the method in your own words. This is key. Patrice will take time to explain the key elements to you.

- Come up with ideas every week: We keep a database of reels and videos we like. Use it as a starting point, but what we really want are your own creative ideas. Bring 15 to 20 concrete video ideas every week across different formats: reels, carousels, infographic posts, b-roll with text. In the weekly call we d
 together which ones we produce.

- Prepare & manage production: Brief our scriptwriter on every approved idea, review the scripts before they reach Patrice, and hand everything to our video editor after Patrice filmed it. The idea is that everything other than the filming (and feedback) is not on Patrice and Chloe’s table anymore.

- Keep our Notion content database up to date: so every piece has a card and a clear status.

- Report every month on what performed, where we are compare to our goal, what did not perform, and propose what we need to change.



## What we are looking for



- A real track record with instagram followers growth.

- Prior experience in the field of mental health, neuroscience, or nervous system work is a  plus. Strong interest to really learn about this field is a requirement.

- Organised, reliable, proactive, creative. You feel comfortable doing research and coming up with ideas proactively and creatively.

- You can research a topic you do not know well and come back with a point of view you can defend.

- Fluent in English and a good sense for language. You will be writing briefs that another writer has to work from, and review what they produce.

- You are comfortable with data and social media KPIs.



## Working setup



Fully remote, your own schedule mostly works. No strict overlap with Berlin (CET) time required, but we will likely have 1-2 weekly calls of 30-60 minutes.



## How to apply



No CV, no long application text, no LinkedIn is needed. Just send us the following.



Note: Include the word “avocado” in the title of your application otherwise your application will not be opened.



We need to see:

1) Go on our instagram page, copy and past one of our hook

2) Show us accounts you worked on and what happened to the numbers as a direct consequence of your work (if you worked in the space of coaching or mental health already, please make sure to include those examples).

3) Your answer to this question in two or three sentences: what are the key elements of a viral video?

No CV, no long application text, no LinkedIn is needed. Just send us the following.



*Note: Include the word “mango” in the title of your application otherwise your application will not be opened.*



We need to see:



- Examples of your work: scripts, captions, carousels, links to finished talking-head videos, your portfolio, whatever gives us the best feeling for how you write and who you have written for. If you have experience in the field of coaching or mental health, please make sure to include those examples.

description:
Hi, nice to meet you!



We are a small team building a dog supplement brand for the US market. We love what we do, we move fast and we test a lot. Every week we run new video ads, all of them in English.



The concepts, scripts and raw clips are already done on our side. What we are missing is a good editor who turns that raw material into finished ads we can actually run. That is where you come in.



This is a long-term, ongoing role, not a one-off project. If it works well, there is a steady flow of work every week.



Your job in one sentence: you get raw clips, text and a written spec, sometimes explained in a short Loom video, and you deliver finished ads that are ready to run. When we want to try new ideas, we often work with references. Long term, you can also generate AI clips yourself using our frameworks.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Turn raw clips into finished, ready-to-run ads for Meta and Instagram

- Cut, time and assemble footage so it holds attention from the first second

- Add subtitles and on-screen elements

- Judge whether a clip is usable and clearly flag any video or sequence that is not

- Name every final upload exactly as specified (this is essential)



WHAT WE PROVIDE

- Finished concepts and copy

- A written spec, or a Loom walkthrough

- References when we explore new ideas



WHAT YOU DO NOT NEED

- To develop concepts

- To write or change copy



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Several years of experience editing video ads. Most of ours run 10 to 45 seconds, some may get longer

- Full understanding of Meta and Instagram safe zones. You know what gets cut in Feed, Stories and Reels, and you place things correctly without being told

- A sharp eye for faults in footage, AI-generated or real

- Good written English

- Reliable delivery times



We do not require a specific editing program. Use whatever you are fast in.



OUR TOOL STACK

Slack, Asana, Airtable and Google Drive. Nothing special, but we keep a clear structure and expect all files and statuses to stay tidy.



HOW WE START

If your application looks like a fit, we send you two example ads so you see exactly what we mean, and then we start with a small paid trial project.



WHAT YOU GET

- A long-term role with a steady flow of work every week

- Clear specs, finished copy and raw clips, so you can focus on editing

- Higher rates and more hours as we grow together

- Reliable payment, always on time



HOW WE START

If your application looks like a fit, we send you two example ads so you see exactly what we mean. Then we start with a small paid trial project. The trial does not guarantee an ongoing contract.



TERMS

- Around 5 to 10 hours per week to start, more later if it works well

- We work async. We are based in Europe (CET), no fixed hours needed

title: Social Media Content Creator – Women’s Pole Dancing Studios
description:
We’re looking for a creative, proactive Social Media Content Creator to help manage the social media content for our two women-only pole dancing studios in Australia.



This is an ongoing part-time role, initially around 5 hours per week, with the potential for the role to grow.

Our studios are fun, supportive, empowering and a little bit sassy. We want our social media to reflect that — fun, confident, sexy, welcoming and real, rather than corporate or generic.



The role

We already have plenty of great students, instructors, classes and raw content.

What we need is someone who can take much more ownership of the thinking, planning and creation behind our social media.

We don’t want to have to come up with every Reel idea ourselves and then simply hand footage over to be edited. We want someone who can research what’s working, spot trends, come up with ideas and present us with great options.

We will choose the ideas that feel fun, suitable for our brand and realistic for us to film. You can then tell us what footage you need, we’ll film it, and you can take it from there.



What you’ll be doing

• Researching Instagram and TikTok for current trends, sounds, Reel formats and content ideas

• Finding trending ideas that could be adapted creatively for our pole dancing studios

• Coming up with original content ideas

• Presenting us with ideas to choose from rather than waiting for us to tell you what to create

• Providing simple instructions for what we need to film once an idea is approved

• Reviewing our raw footage and identifying the best clips

• Editing engaging Reels and short-form videos

• Selecting photos for posts

• Writing captions and on-screen text that suit our personality

• Creating simple graphics and quote posts

• Planning and scheduling content

• Keeping an eye on what is working for dance, fitness, lifestyle and women-focused accounts

• Helping us develop and improve our social media strategy over time



The goal is for you to eventually take a significant amount of the social media thinking and workload, while still working within our brand and getting approval for content ideas.



Who we’re looking for

You’ll ideally be someone who:

• Has genuine experience creating social media content

• Has a strong creative eye

• Understands Instagram and TikTok trends

• Knows what makes someone stop scrolling

• Is confident editing Reels and short-form video

• Can look at raw footage and recognise what will make good content

• Can generate ideas without needing constant direction

• Has excellent written English

• Can learn a brand’s personality and write in its voice

• Is organised, dependable and communicates well

• Can work independently and use good judgement

• Is comfortable creating content featuring pole dancing, sensual movement and women expressing confidence and sexuality



Experience with dance, fitness, beauty, lifestyle or female-focused brands would be a bonus.



We care much more about your creativity, judgement and the quality of your work than formal qualifications.

Hours



We expect to start at approximately 5 hours per week.



We’ll agree on an hourly rate and weekly hours in advance. There may be opportunities for additional hours as the role develops.



How to apply



Please start your application with the words POLE SOCIAL so we know you’ve read the full job description.

Then answer the following:

1. Tell us briefly about your social media/content creation experience.

2. Share links to 2–3 examples of your best Reels or short-form videos. Please choose examples that best demonstrate your editing and creative skills.

3. Imagine you were creating content for our women-only pole dancing studios. Give us 3 Reel/TikTok ideas you think would work well for us. These can be current trends you would adapt or original ideas. Briefly tell us what we would need to film for each one.

4. How do you normally find new trends and content ideas for the accounts you manage?

5. What tools do you use for video editing, graphics, content planning and scheduling?

6. Approximately how long would it normally take you to turn supplied raw footage into a polished 20–30 second Reel?

7. What is your hourly rate in USD, and approximately how many hours per week are you looking for?

Shortlisted applicants may be offered a small paid trial task before we choose someone for the ongoing role.

Please don’t send a generic application. We’re looking for someone who can think creatively, bring us ideas and take initiative, not simply wait to be told what to post.

title: Motion Designer / Animator – Explainer Videos

* Adobe After Effects

* Strong graphic design and typography

* Storyboarding and visual concept development

title: Full-Time WFH Customer Success and Retention Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Full-Time WFH Content Feedback Manager  — $1,000–$1,200/month + Bonuses

Senior CFMs earn $1,500+ after 6–12 months.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.



ABOUT US



Young Publisher – 



We are an international digital marketing company working with content creators and online brands. The company has over 85 employees around the world. We've been in the industry since 2019. We're currently serving over 1,000+ high-ticket clients per year.



We provide an 80% done-for-you content and monetization system that helps creators grow, go viral, and turn views into income using short-form content, AI tools, and proven strategies. Our clients are typically beginners or early-stage creators looking to build their brand, gain followers, and generate income online.



We focus on structure, accountability, and long-term growth.

We focus strongly on client delivery and producing client results.



BENEFITS



- Full-time position: 7.5 hours daily, Monday-Friday; 37.5 hours a week

- Flexible schedule: Choose your own hours, as long as you show up for the daily meeting (MANDATORY)

- Stable income: Long-term role with regular, on-time payments

- Supportive team: Collaborative environment without micromanagement

- Growth path: Opportunities to increase responsibilities and earnings

- 100% remote: Work-from-home setup



TASKS



Content & Client Feedback



- Review 50-100 short-form client videos (Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) per day in our Slack feedback channel -before they are published

- Give constructive, actionable feedback on hooks (verbal/headline/visual), scripting, pacing, editing, and CTA, making sure each client knows exactly how to improve

- Cross-reference each piece of content with client niche, experience, and goals as outlined in their files

- Review previous feedback to ensure consistency and avoid contradictions

- Quality-control content ideas created by our Content Research Experts before delivery to the client, ensuring fit with niche, experience, and likely performance

- Oversee workload balance among Content Research Experts and make sure no one on the team is overloaded or underutilized

- Respond to client questions or tech issues in Slack within 24 hours

- Be tough but fair—only approve content that meets quality standards



Progress Tracking



- Complete daily End-of-Day (EOD) reports

- Attend daily team meeting (mandatory, 3pm CET)

- Keep internal feedback and client progress records up to date



REQUIREMENTS (MUST-HAVE)



- C1+ English (written), with perfect grammar and clear, professional responses

- Significant experience creating or reviewing short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Organized and detail-oriented

- Reliable internet and a quiet, professional home workspace

- Accountability mindset and deadline commitment

- Long-term commitment, eager to master a workflow and have direct impact on client success



BONUS SKILLS (NOT REQUIRED)



- Experience supporting creators and social media beginners, especially ages 45+

- Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.

- Strong understanding of trends/strategy for Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts



WHY JOIN US?



- Monthly Performance Bonuses: Rewarding high-quality feedback, consistent task completion, and strong teamwork.

- Fully Covered Software: Access to all necessary premium tools and software provided.

- Great Work-Life Balance: Sustainable hours with no graveyard shifts.

- Professional Growth: Accelerate your skill set through regular feedback and advanced training.



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form to apply: 
/to/O40RINeW



Important note: Put "CFM" + [Your Name & Family Name] in the "Name" field in the form.

title: Personal Assistant to the Founder (start in Customer Service) — Australian fashion brand
description:
Hamilton Island Boutique is an Australian women's fashion brand, founder-led and growing. We are preparing to scale over the coming months, with more markets and a second store planned. You will work directly with the founder.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS



This is a Personal Assistant role. You will become the founder's right hand: the person who runs day-to-day operations, keeps an overview of everything that happens in the business, and reports to the founder. We train you into that role through customer service, because that is where you learn the business, the customers and the supplier. We begin with a few hours per week, and your hours and responsibilities grow as the work grows: from customer service into disputes, supplier follow-up, admin, and eventually running operations.



We are not looking for someone who answers
s. We are looking for someone who understands that the job of customer service is to keep revenue inside the company and to protect the reputation of the brand, and who genuinely cares about the result.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Handle customer
s and messages in our internal dashboard.

- Handle refund requests the right way: find out what the customer actually needs and offer a real solution before a refund is ever on the table.

- Handle payment disputes and chargebacks: gather the facts, respond, and resolve them in the company's favour.

- Follow up with our supplier on orders that need attention.

- Report to the founder at the end of every shift.

- As you grow: listing checks, admin, keeping our procedures up to date, and more responsibility as the company expands.



WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU



- At least 1 year of customer service for a Shopify or dropshipping store, including refunds and disputes.

- You have handled PayPal or card disputes before and you know how to win them.

- Excellent written English: clear, warm, and written for the person in front of you, not copied from a template.

- You ask when you are not sure instead of guessing.

- You are structured and reliable: nothing gets forgotten, and you report without being reminded.

- You are comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude in your work.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Part-time to start, growing into more hours as the business grows.

- Hourly pay that grows with your responsibilities, plus bonuses tied to results. The more revenue you keep inside the company and the better things run, the more room there is for bonuses and raises. We reward good work.

- Direct line to the founder, proper training, and a clear path to running operations.

- A brand that is about to scale, with a second store on the way.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word BOUTIQUE on the first line, then answer these five questions. Applications that skip a question will not be read.



1. Describe a case where a customer demanded a full refund and you kept the sale. What exactly did you offer, and what was the result?

2. A customer opens a PayPal dispute for "item not received", but the tracking shows it was delivered. What do you do, step by step?

3. Which Shopify stores have you worked for, for how long, and what did you handle there?

4. Why should we NOT hire you?

5. Your earliest start date and the hours you are available per day.



Everything you see in this role stays inside the company.
salary: $3.50/hour, growing as you take on more

title: Customer Support Manager – AI-Driven (Shopify E-commerce)
description:
Own the customer experience end to end, not just the tickets that come your way. We're a fast-growing e-commerce brand hiring a manager to run point on resolution quality, the AI workflow behind it, and the processes and sheets the team runs on.



You are not here to clear a queue and clock out. You are here to own the outcome of every ticket you touch, catch what the process and the AI miss, and then fix the process itself so it stops happening. This is a hands-on managerial role, not a hands-off one. You'll work tickets yourself, and you'll turn what you see in them into concrete fixes for the AI agent, the sheets, and the workflows the rest of the team depends on.



We're not a traditional support team stacking human review on top of every ticket. Our AI agent resolves most tickets on its own, and this role exists to make it smarter, not to double-check it.



* What You'll Own

* The outcome of every ticket you touch. Not just closing it, actually solving it.

* The harder cases the AI escalates: disputes, refunds, anything needing judgment.

* Making the AI better. Improve its guidance from real tickets so the same issue doesn't come back twice, for you or anyone else working the queue.

* The processes and sheets support runs on. Tighten what's inefficient, fix what's broken, and keep everything current as the business changes.

* The patterns. Spot recurring friction early and bring the fix, not just the complaint.



Must-Haves (be ready to show evidence, not just claim these)



* 3+ years in e-commerce customer support manager position, with a specific example of a process, sheet, or workflow you improved that no one asked you to.

* Real Shopify depth. You can diagnose an order or payment problem from the admin, not just read a customer their tracking number.

* A helpdesk you've worked in daily (we use Commslayer). Quick on new tools.

* Hands-on experience with an AI system that takes action on tickets, not a writing assistant like ChatGPT. You trust a well-trained AI's output over manually re-verifying it against the source system, and when it's wrong, you know how to fix its guidance instead of working around it.

* Comfortable without SOPs or step-by-step checklists. We operate on principles, not scripts. If you need a checklist to feel confident doing the job, this isn't the role, and it definitely isn't the role if you're the one expected to write the checklist for others.

* Problem solving to root cause. You reason through an unfamiliar system to figure out how it behaves instead of escalating.

* Strong written English. Clear, warm, precise.

* Full-time, exclusive, long-term. Monday to Friday, (8-hour shift plus a 1-hour break).



Not for You If
